notes.title: Portable Power Packets - Interstellar Rift Development Update 146
notes.content:
[b]We’re hitting the live game with another update! This time bringing the new portable batteries and the heavy railgun.[/b]

The heavy railgun is exactly what the name implies, a larger version of the railgun we already have. The railgun fires heavy rail gun ammo, made from tungsten, and the newly added titanium. Inflicting even more damage it’s heavier and requires more power, but it’s also a significant upgrade in firepower. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/92a733144662de9e9fc323d06bf8b7ae60ee1ecd.jpg[/img]
[i]The light and heavy railguns next to eacht other for size reference
[/i]

Additionally we are introducing a new method of power storage. Small handheld batteries that can be used to power systems or even small ships for short periods of time. New resources have been added which are required to construct the highest tier of said batteries.
The batteries themselves can be built using the 3d printer, and need to be placed in a new device called a portable battery charger, to be either charged or discharged.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/bd9084adc44a120fa1aae8ea2baa4ad000067e05.jpg[/img]
[i]Portable batteries are new, and can be charged in these wall mounted devices[/i]

Resources distribution across all star systems has been changed as well. Rare resources should be a bit more common, as they always spawn 1 of each tier now. 

Efforts have also been made to increase device stability, and some fixes have been added to prevent players from falling through the floor if disconnects or crashes happen during teleportation. We’ve also optimized the construction and modification of ships, and general performance should be a little better. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/b6feb3eb60a3578a37acffab0f4e80a4661cde0d.jpg[/img]
[i]Stars now have a visual flare that shows them from great distance[/i]

There are also new resources that can be named and spawned by server admins to be used in any way they’d like. These come stackable and non stackable versions. 

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have a fairly busy discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!


Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Power to go! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 145
notes.content:
[b]It’s time for another experimental update! This time around we have new portable batteries that will enable power transfer between ships, and allow much smaller ship designs to become viable. On top of that there’s also the new Heavy Rail Gun, stretching 36 meters long, it’s the biggest weapon yet in Interstellar Rift. [/b]

Portable batteries are tools that can be made in a 3D printer. There are four different types, ranging from a T0 25k storage variant, to the top of the line 2.5 million storage T3 version. 

The T3 battery uses rare new resources that can only be found in the high tier star systems. Among these new resources are Titanium, Manganese, and Lithium. Titanium and Manganese can be found in small amount in random asteroids, much like the rare resources that are already in the game. Lithium ore is found in new asteroids that usually carry quite a lot of this material. 

To fill the batteries up, a portable battery charger has to be placed on board of your ship or station. Once filled, they can also be discharged using the same device. During this experimental update, we’ll be redesigning the buildable stations so batteries can used to power them. 

The new Heavy Rail Gun is a large interior/exterior device that works mostly in the same way as it’s smaller version the Light Rail Gun does. It requires a new type of ammunition that is made from tungsten and titanium, and requires a pretty hefty dose of power to operate. But when you land your shots, it has a devastating effect on any object that might be in its path.

We’ve also tweaked the spread of resources over the different solar systems a bit, so water is now back in every system, and there is a higher chance that a system has multiple rare resources. 

Behind the scenes we’ve been doing a lot of work on device stability, and performance logging,  and we’ve added in a new system that checks that you’re being placed on board of a ship properly. So you’ll hopefully never have the misfortune of dropping through the floor after being disconnected in an ill-timed moment again.  

For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1836811737975272938/

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you star side!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift BETA 0.2.5.00
notes.content:
[h1]FUNCTIONALITIES[/h1]

- added disabled state, this happens when a ship reaches 0 armor, but still has hull hit points. Once the hull has been repaired and the armor gens have come online again the ship becomes movable again

- hacking can no longer be done through shields, they need to be down before a connection can be made (warp hacking still works)

- armor generator now has a 5 minute charge up time when switched from weapon groups or when added to a cpu

- universe generator random seed in server settings

- added new tutorials:
[list]
	[*]Cargo & Trading
	[*]Ship construction
	[*]Getting a ship flight-ready
	[*]Ship flight
	[*]Ship Combat
	[*]Rifting
	[*]Mining & refining
	[*]Tools & repair
[/list]

- removed old tutorial

[h1]GRAPHICS[/h1]

- updated warp shader

- added new warp charge effect

- made displays of currency use the long value instead of int so it can go above 2 billion

[h1]BALANCE[/h1]

- gas clouds spawned by players should no longer be able to damage player ships in on PVE servers

- recipe of the TII heat sink now uses 35 silicon instead of 50 aluminium

- small armor generator now has 25,000 hit points instead of 10000, and a weight of 500

- large armor generator now has 250,000 hit points instead of 100000, and a weight of 25,000

- small shield generator now has 10,000 hit points instead of 1,000, and a weight of 500

- medium shield generator now has 30,000 hit points instead of 5,000, and a weight of 5,000

- large shield generator now has 100,000 hit points instead of 10,000, and a weight of 12,500

- standard side winder missile now does 400 damage instead of 150

- improved side winder missile now does 500 damage instead of 180

- advanced side winder missile now does 600 damage instead of 210

- railgun charge time is now 4 seconds

- railgun damage is now 200 per tick spread over 20 ticks on hit. 

- point defense turrets now do 50 base damage, 50 shield damage and 0.5 % of max shield as damage per hit. Up from only 20 base damage

- deployable turret now does 30 damage instead of 20

- combat drones now do 25 base and 15 shield damage, instead of 15 base and 5 shield

- Skrill Grunts now do 50 base damage instead of 30

- Red Skrill now does 0.2% percent of max shield as shield damage instead of 0.3%

- standard laser ammo now does 25 base and 35 shield damage, instead of 25 base and 10 shield

- advanced laser ammo now does 40 base damage and 90 shield damage, instead of 45 base and 20 shield

- ion ammo now does 75 shield damage + 0.1%, instead of 30 base damage + 0.2%

- reduced repair costs multiplier per missing hitpoint from 25 to 8

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- fixed several issues with the power transfer box

- fixed issues with the pacements of the icons in the mission list

- fixed the faction of the HydroPEX fuel trader, which could result in multiple being present at the same time

- fixed an issue with the cargo container names not showing up

- signs no longer think every tick

- fixed a bug where drones would not spawn debris on death when they had no cargo

- fixed a bug where drones would spawn resources from tiers above the one of the system they are currently in

- fixed a bug where resources are not correctly moved from the crew vault to a player vault when the crew disbands while the players are offline

- fixed an issue with collision sounds

- fixed player store when buying to a ship

- fixed footsteps not listening to volume settings

- fixed several events in the chat system not being unloaded when switching gamemodes, causing double messages

- optimize spawning debris field when a ship is destroyed (removes lag spike)

- credits can now be exited with escape

[h1]TECHNICAL[/h1]

- more debug logging on shutdown

- Havok physics is no longer initialized on the server and ghost clients

- add time between baking ships (and force a garbage collection and wait longer after baking a big ship)

[h1]NOTES[/h1]

- servers need to be updated and restarted

notes.title: Valued damage! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 144
notes.content:
[b]Alright, time to take another experimental update out of the oven, and move it over to the live branch. This week we have a bunch of balance changes, a new and more effective set of tutorials and more.[/b]

So let's dig in and start with the new combat balance changes. We’ve taken the time to make some major changes to weapon balance now that we have the majority of ship weapons in the game. First up we have:
[list]
[*] Changes to armor generators - They have a boot up time when you activate them, this makes it so you can't stack armor generators by using them in tandem and swapping them out when needed. Armor generators have also received a buff, check the patch notes for full details
[*] We’ve overhauled the entire ship disabling system. When a ship loses all of its armor the ship is considered disabled and cannot move anymore until the armor generator repairs the hull. This was done to encourage boarding enemy ships rather than outright destroying them.
[*] Hacking through shields is no longer possible you will need to take them down in order to make a connection. However you will still be able to pull other ships out of warp through hacking, and shields now have a longer downtime to give you a window of opportunity. 
[*] In addition to these changes we have made a lot of changes to weapon damage values check out the patch notes for full details[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/6e1fc07ef153fb24e43ee1b277b9e938c7c0e6d4.jpg[/img]

Next up we’ve added a range of new tutorials to replace the old one. You will find we've broken the tutorials up into smaller chunks that will be easier for people to learn the stuff they want to learn, rather than be pushed through an extended tutorial that covers everything.
There are now tutorials for trading, combat building etc.

We've also updated the warp shader, and added an effect when the ship is charging warp. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/927dffc5bb541d6904e91f6f0077d2a105a4081f.jpg[/img]

For all other things in the patch, please see the details in the patch notes linked below. 

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have a fairly busy discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

tags.balance_change: Changes to armor generators - They have a boot up time when you activate them, this makes it so you can't stack armor generators by using them in tandem and swapping them out when needed. Armor generators have also received a buff, check the patch notes for full details

We’ve overhauled the entire ship disabling system. When a ship loses all of its armor the ship is considered disabled and cannot move anymore until the armor generator repairs the hull. This was done to encourage boarding enemy ships rather than outright destroying them.

Hacking through shields is no longer possible you will need to take them down in order to make a connection. However you will still be able to pull other ships out of warp through hacking, and shields now have a longer downtime to give you a window of opportunity.
In addition to these changes we have made a lot of changes to weapon damage values check out the patch notes for full details

We've also updated the warp shader, and added an effect when the ship is charging warp.

notes.title: Damage values! - interstellar Rift Development Update 143
notes.content:
[b]With this experimental update, we’re doing things a bit differently. We’ve mostly been working on the usual, bug fixes, performance updates, etc. However we’ve also been updating the tutorial, and balancing the combat. And this is where we changed things up. [/b]

Instead of releasing the first experimental version with most of the features for the patch in place, we’re releasing it with only the combat changes. We feel like those will get the most user feedback, and are more interesting to players who actually use the experimental versions. 

So the new tutorials will be disabled, as we are still working on them. They will be released during the experimental run. We’ve scrapped the old tutorial, and started fresh with a bunch of smaller more dedicated tutorials over a range of basic topics. The idea is that you can select one and learn about that particular piece of gameplay in a short span of time, not more than five minutes per tutorial. 

Several combat related things have changed with this update, so let’s go through them one by one. 

[list]
[*] Armor generators now have a 5 minute start up time when you active or deactivate them. This limits the stacking and swapping of armor generators during combat. They have also been buffed significantly, see the patch notes for details on that. 

[*] Ships now enter a disabled state when their armor is depleted, entering a state where they can’t move and warp. It’ll stay in this state until the hull is fully repaired. Hull hit points are back, and only when the ship’s hull reaches 0 hit points, it will go into its death state mode. Blocks give significantly more hull hit points now. 
Once your ship has recovered all its hull, the armor generators will slowly turn on again, and the ship will become functional again. Weapons and such still work during this period. 

[*] In this first experimental version, you will no longer be able to hack through shields, shields have been tweaked so they stay down longer when depleted, allowing a time frame for hacking. We have some thoughts on this mechanic and will tweak it more during the experimental version, we are currently thinking of making it harder to establish a connection when the shields are up vs when they are down, but in this first release they need to be depleted for hacking to work. 
[/list]

There have been various amounts of tweaks to damage values, weight values, and hit points for shields, weapons, armor generators and other combat related devices, check the patch notes for more information on that.  

We’ve also been reworking how the nuclear reactor works behind the scenes, it should now have less issues with the states of turbines and such. 

For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1778261844034638624/

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you star side!

-The Split Polygon Team

Hull hit points are back, and only when the ship’s hull reaches 0 hit points, it will go into its death state mode. Blocks give significantly more hull hit points now.
Once your ship has recovered all its hull, the armor generators will slowly turn on again, and the ship will become functional again. Weapons and such still work during this period.

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift BETA 0.2.4.00
notes.content:
[h1]FUNCTIONALITIES[/h1]

- Vaultron passes can now be purchased on galactic banks at the faction desk, your standing with Vaultron determines the Tier of pass you can purchase

- reworked how resources spawn in star systems 
	[list][*] less different resources now spawn in systems, making them more specialized
	[*] resources are now easier to find if a system has them 
	[*] every system has a min and max value for rare and common resources of their tier
	[*] higher tiered systems include the chances for every tier below them[/list]	
- every system now has a chance to already have some prebuilt stations instead of requiring the players to build every station except for a few select static ones

- added slow mode, entities that have not been active in 30 minutes enter a slow mode, in slow mode devices ignore their update function, station shields compensate for slow mode (saving performance)

- added a Tier 1 ship for purchase at the faction desks and Store-O-Trons of Hurles Co, Sentinel Security Systems, and Galactic Trade, they can be purchased if you have more than 1k reputation for their respective factions 
	[list][*] S3 has the S3 Reaper Mk II, a medium sized battleship, equiped with plenty of weapons and salvaging equipment, available for 5 million units
	[*] HSC has the HSC Excavator Mk II, a medium sized mining vessle that was the winner of the latest design contest, available for 3 million units
	[*] GT has the GT Hauler Mk VI, a medium sized cargo hauler equiped with large cargo pods, available for 2.5 million units[/list]	
- removed christmas decorations and models

- reworked cargo drop code for drone bay and disposer

- asteroid finder can now insert resources in inactive asteroids when it can't find an asteroid that should be spawning

- added three new 1x1x1 exterior tiles

- new system name generator

- added popups when you can't purchase a ship due to low funds or low reputation ranking

- when teleporting to S3's Fort Bragg you now arrive in the main hall

- added "RefreshStarterShipsOnStartup" setting to the server.json that stops the game from checking if the purchasable ships are correct. When disabled you can change, and add, ships to be available for purchase. 

- scout events are no longer selectable when they are at the same location as a planet

- Scaverion (Drifters home solar system) is closer to the other starter systems now

[h1]GRAPHICS[/h1]

- stars now have different colours

[h1]UI[/h1]

- reworked the ship purchase interface to show multiple ships

- updated prop placement icons in the ship editor for props with offsets, more to come

- added new tier icons to multiple UIs

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- fixed an issue with the exterior view in the manned turret

- fixed an issues with the tutorial and the mission list

- fixed an issue with ships with 0 mass when spawned

- ship editor can't save ships with 0 mass anymore

- fixed a crash when failing to spawn an entity

- deviced can no longer spawn a ship with 0 mass

- drones no longer slow tick when the ship they come from is not in slow tick mode

- fixed an issue where drones would spawn far far away when being undocked

- fixed a bunch of issues with the purchasable ships

- fixed advanced heatsink not having trade stats

- fixed ACTRs still teleporting when turned off

- fixed a bug where sub targets would not cycle in the correct order

- fixed inaccessible doors on the Drifters Black Market

- fixed an issue with the life support systems when they run out of oxygen

- fixed debris not being visible

- fixed a bug where improved ammo had the stats of advanced ammo and vice versa

- fixed a bug where asteroid belts and spawners that are far away from the star of a system would not spawn any asteroids

- fixed dronebay hover tooltips

- a crash in the shipeditor

- fixed a coloring issue with the text edit fields

[h1]NOTES[/h1]

- servers need to be updated and restarted and need a full rebuild. This can be done in the game by pressing F8, and selecting the last option in the rebuild menu on your GRIP. Or it can be done via the server console, by using the "rebuildserver 2" command, as the server option starts at 0.

notes.title: New space ship dealers - interstellar Rift Development Update 142
notes.content:
[b]Time to take another experimental patch out of the oven. New features this time around including; new system generation, resulting in more specialised systems. Also, Pre-built stations spawn again in new systems, and they will have stock. Differently colored suns now light up the systems, and Vaultron passes are now purchasable with the appropriate rank at the Galactic ank. Lastly, faction headquarters now have Tier I ships available for purchase. [/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/53121d13442fd32df5ebd63772c9e129bf9bff7b.jpg[/img]

We have reworked the way that star systems are generated, which result in star systems being more specialised, and making it so that some resources are only in a handful of systems. But they will be easier to find in those systems. Additionally fully constructed space stations will now spawn again in systems outside of the 3 main faction systems. There will still be station construction events in the systems, but there will also be a random selection of space stations already present in said systems. We’ve also updated the system name generator, and the Drifter home system of Scaverion is now a little bit closer to the other starter systems. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/7d65a460f7fa7067fcc8e9b51bd0d8bc4aa97a13.jpg[/img]

We have also introduced a new optimization called slow-mode. This kicks into effect after a chunk or ship has not been visited for 30 minutes, and causes everything in that chunk to update at 1/20th the normal speed. Exclusions are drones and station shields. Mining drones have also received an update, and will now always find an asteroid with the resources they are looking for, if they couldn’t find one after searching for a while. Of course this is limited to the resources that would naturally occur in the system.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/0a780e8dabc81d0fa596246b4ac2dab9b7b30b31.jpg[/img]

And lastly we have added 3 new ships to the Store-o-Tron purchase screen; The S3 Reaper Mk II, the HSC Excavator Mk II, and the GT Hauler Mk VI. These ships are more expensive than the starter ships but they also have better Tier I equipment. These ships are made available at TI faction ranks, and unlike the starter ships can only be purchased without going into debt, so start saving. 

[b]This update requires the saves to be updated, see the notes section in the patch notes linked below for more information![/b]

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have a fairly busy discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you star-side!


-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: A Red Sun Rises - interstellar Rift Development Update 141
notes.content:
[b]Happy new year, and welcome to our first experimental update of 2019! 
This patch today brings you more specialized star systems, and new T1 purchasable star ships for all factions, among other things. [/b]

The specialized star systems will spawn less different resources, but makes them easier to find when you venture to their asteroid belts. We have also  increased the number of stations that can spawn by default in a star system. Previously there was only a small chance to get a static station like the HydroPEX Rift hub. Now you won’t have to build every station in a system, and trade drones will have more targets to go.

Vaultron has now made vault expansion passes available at the Vaultron galactic bank based on your reputation with them. So if you have a high reputation you can purchase higher tier vault expansion passes from them.

And lastly we have made new T1 ships available from the Store-O-Tron for each faction including the new Excavator made by our contest winner Insetricky97. These ships are optimized for their specific roles and should provide players with a more advanced ship than their started counterparts, and help out players who don’t want to build their ships from scratch. 

For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1742231069940211139/

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you star side!

-The Split Polygon Team



PS: We will also be streaming some more Interstellar Rift tonight at 22:00 CET (21:00 UTC) in Dev Stream #40 at https://www.twitch.tv/splitpolygon.

We'll be talking about the changes in this experimental update, and what's going to be in the next update. 

So please join us as we muck about in hyper space and answer all your questions ːsteamhappyː!

notes.title: Building Bridges - interstellar Rift Development Update 140
notes.content:
[b]All hands to battle stations, this new update delivers to you guys a much anticipated new component; “The Bridge”. The bridge is a new form of cockpit that has seats for 4 players, two pilot stations, the captains chair and an engineering station. The design of this new bridge gives you a very wide field of view as it has very large angled windows.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/ebcb0f0838ff9686270f984047cf20ffd1cf7047.jpg[/img]

The bridge features a built in holotable for planning and scanning your surroundings, as well as a status screen on the main window. The main new feature of this bridge however is the captain's chair. This new station lets you give orders to your crew by having text appear on the targeted players screen. It lets you set alert states throughout the ship, this will change the lighting and give you a notification as to what alert state you have set. And lastly the captain will have control over the ships self destruct. The self destruct timer is by default set to 5 minutes and can be increased to be as long as necessary but not shortened.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/dedbe6de09ecac9f810a49e97b62160e3421b83e.jpg[/img]

And lastly there is an engineering terminal which works exactly like the stand alone one, and can be used to keep an eye on your devices.

We have also made the captain's chair a separate device for you to place wherever you like.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/7ffb6c045f3016caebaff6b9c133add077fb8ca7.jpg[/img] 

For all other things in the patch, please see the details in the patch notes linked below. 

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have a fairly busy discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

[b]Once more, we thank you all for playing, and hope see you star-side, in 2019!

-The Split Polygon Team [/b]

notes.title: A Bridge too far - interstellar Rift Development Update 139
notes.content:
[b]The experimental version of the new update is now live, and brings with it the new bridge as well as several new features that come with the new bridge. [/b]

First up, the new bridge comes in 3 and 4 tile wide variants, so it should fit any ship design regardless of its layout. It offers 3 pilot seats with ship control access, 1 captain’s chair with the new functionalities, and a holotable. It also has a large window display, that will show warp timers and other information. 

Second, the captains chair has now been implemented allowing you to issue commands to your crew, setting custom alarm states for the ship and of course activate the self destruct.
These new features should make it easier to direct the ship in any situation you end up in.

We will also be streaming some more Interstellar Rift tonight at 22:00 CET (21:00 UTC) in Dev Stream #37 at https://www.twitch.tv/splitpolygon.

We'll be talking about this experimental patch, and we'll also announce the winners of the last ship design contest! 


For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1742228532897851410/

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift Beta 0.2.2.00
notes.content:
[h1]FUNCTIONALITIES[/h1]

- Player Vaults have been reworked:
[list]
[*]Are now limited to 500 crates by default
[*]Vault can be upgrades by purchasing a Vaultron Pass and storing it in your vault
[*]There can be 5 active passes in the vault
[*]Vault size for fleets and crew will be calculated by multiplying the default vault + any pass expansions, with the number of players in a crew or fleet
[*]The lowest tier pass can be purchased at the faction desk on any faction headquarters, higher tier passes can be found in LogiCorp Toolstores in systems with the same tier or higher.
[*]When salvaging/modifying a ship, excess resources are now handled in this order: dump on modified ship > dump in vault > dump on modifying ship > create debris field of max 400 pieces > create a large scrap asteroid
[*]Expansion passes add 100 crate capacity per pass on tier 0, 200 on tier 1, 300 on tier 2 and 400 on tier 3.   
[/list]
- reworked how some device rules work, exterior parts can no longer be build through other exterior parts

- removed editor subcategories, the item bar now expands to show all available props. 

- missions of a higher tier than the system they can be taken from will now spawn, but there will always be at least 4 missions from the same tier

- rooms can now be renamed ingame from the screens of a door leading to them

- drones can now use improved and advanced fuel

- pivot turret door now always has a chance to open, even if fully damaged

- crew and fleet vaults no longer accept mission resources

- ships with a station shield no longer allow screen shake

- adding resources to cargopods now merges crates

- added some new exterior blocks
[list]
[*]15 new 1x1x1 blocks
[*]8 new 2x1x1 blocks
[*]3 new 2x2x1 blocks
[*]3 new 2x2x2 blocks
[*]thinner versions of the existing solar panels
[/list]

- increased text chat message history to 500 messages from 150

- added a popup to ship salvaging when the vault lacks capacity

- cargo teleporters now merge crates

- new Cargo Containers, can be found under Room Edit Mode > Systems
[list]
[*]Small Cargo Container can hold up to 100 crates and costs 750 Iron and 225 Copper
[*]Medium Cargo Container can hold up to 200 crates and costs 1500 Iron and 225 Copper
[*]Large Cargo Container can hold up to 300 crates and costs 2250 Iron and 225 Copper
[*]Have an interior and exterior component
[*]Can be name with the sign above the terminal use <ResourceName> to get a resource Icon with the right color and name next to it. Example; <Hydrogen>
[/list]
[h1]BALANCE[/h1]

- reduced crew disband timer to be 24 hours

- reduced damage multiplier of pivot turret from 8 to 2

- reduced max station shield power usage from 15k to 12k per tick (when ship is over 2.5 million mass)

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- fixed Vault scrolling

- fixed a crash when quitting a single player game

- rail gun can no longer charge when warping or when it has no bullet loaded

- rift generator cartridges are now removed when using their last charge

- reworked all rules for props with both an interior and exterior component to fix some placement bugs (should not alter any existing ships)

- fixed a bug where expanding explosions would move

- optimized saving

- optimized all chat

- fixed a bug where the fleet vault would crash

- fixed a bug that caused the large cargo container to not fuction

- fixed some border offsets in the editor for prop icons

- cargo teleporter now uses the correct device names

- fixed editor buttons moving when hovering over them

- fixed a bug where crew and fleet vaults would accept mission resources

- fixed a bug where salvaging a ship would not update the vault interface correctly

- fixed a bug where cargo teleporters would not clear their visuals correctly

- fixed a crash in the Guide when you had an ammo loader on your ship

- fixed a bug where you could click through the expanding prop list in the editor

- fixed an issue with the out of range check for using the cargo containers

- fixed a crash in the pivot turret

- fixed a crash in the repair drones

- fixed a crash in the asteroid selection on certain devices

- fixed a crash in the export ship to file window

- main menu buttons now scale on resolution

- fixed bug where props could not be deleted in the editor when trying to click through the grid

- fixed a bug with the "supplies needed for expansion" mission where it would say no ship selected

- fixed a crash in the HydroPEX assistance menu

- fixed a crash in the advanced power overview window

- fixed a crash in the progress bar of some missions

- fixed a crash in the mission markers

- fixed a crash in the system event screen

- fixed a crash in the dronebay device

- fixed a crash in the ship statistics window

- fixed a crash in the diplomacy window

- better handling when the language file is missing or corrupt

- fixed a crash in the power group menu in the editor

- fixed mining drone lasers not showing

- fixed a bug where the cargo containers would not sort properly

- fixed a bug where the scout system event icons would not properly decouple from their parent planet icons

- POI icon positions update frequency fixed

- fixed a bug with the Hurles Co final system event

- dronebay drone overview screen now properly displays higher tier resources 

- fixed a bug where the ammo loader would display the wrong icons

- fixed a bug with renaming the rooms via the terminal screen on doors

- power manager should now spread drain on batteries and such equally instead of one at a time

- fixed a bug where the game would crash when trying to release gas when there was no gas in the ram scoop

- fixed a bug where the editor mouse tooltip would remain when switching editor modes

- fixed some issues with threading and added logging for aborted thread issues

[h1]NOTES[/h1]

notes.title: Padding out the cargo! - interstellar Rift Development Update 138
notes.content:
[b]Another patch is ready for prime time! This time we include the new vault limitation and cargo systems. [/b]

This patch will limit the default vault capacity to only 500 crates. The capacity can be expanded however through the use of Vaultron passes. These can be bought from faction vendors. The vault passes come in a variety of tiers. Low tiers can be bought at the faction desks in starting systems. However for the higher tier ones players will need to travel to higher tier systems. The higher the tier of the pass the more they will expand the capacity, you can have up to 5 passes active in your vault. To use the pass simply put it in the vault and the capacity will be expanded.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/78743fc7c9d62b0ffd19d3c9599de8cf54fb0781.jpg[/img]

For those of you who need even more cargo space we have now added exterior cargo pods to space ships. Players can use these small vault like devices to easily store and transfer cargo. They come in two designs and 3 different sizes each, with corresponding capacity.
The cargo pod will allow easy access to these resources at a lower weight cost than a similar box capacity in a standard cargo bay.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/facaf843c22d1f9a653998cf83a49527979bd851.jpg[/img]

And last but not least! We have added 30 new exterior blocks for you to help design your ships the way you want to. Among these new blocks are a new and much requested feature, thinner solar panels! They generate the same amount of power as bigger ones however they should fit better with a more sleek slip design!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/a5b7fc28775f7c1eec32daa46f2fcabcd56fdeec.jpg[/img]

Also, don't forget the ship design contest is still running for another week! Send in your design for a chance to have it become a new purchasable ship for Hurles Co.!

For all other things in the patch, please see the details in the patch notes linked below. 

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have a fairly busy discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!


-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Precious Cargo Space - interstellar Rift Development Update 137
notes.content:
[b]Time for another experimental patch! This week we’re pushing out the new limited vaults, cargo containers, and vault expansion passes.[/b]

From now on, the contents of the vault will be limited, this is in an effort to encourage players to create offsite storage facilities and shipyards for bigger ship construction.
Vaults will be limited to 500 crates by default, and can be expanded by simply placing a Vaultron expansion pass in your vault. Having these passes in your vault will permanently expand your vault capacity. You can have up to 5 passes active in your vault, and it will automatically select the highest tier passes first. You can buy the standard passes from the faction desk in the default tier systems, and from LogiCorp tool stores you come across in higher tier systems. 

And the second major feature are the new cargo containers. These containers can be attached to your hull and can be used for high capacity storage. Each container has an interface similar to that of the vault, and the interaction with them is essentially the same. The vaults come in various sizes from small to medium and large. And their capacity corresponds to their size starting at 40 crates, and going up to 100. 

During the experimental version of this patch we will be adding more cargo container shapes, and a whole set of new exterior blocks. 

For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1739974199627070970/

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:

tags.feature: This week we’re pushing out the new limited vaults, cargo containers, and vault expansion passes.
From now on, the contents of the vault will be limited, this is in an effort to encourage players to create offsite storage facilities and shipyards for bigger ship construction.
Vaults will be limited to 500 crates by default, and can be expanded by simply placing a Vaultron expansion pass in your vault.
Having these passes in your vault will permanently expand your vault capacity.
You can have up to 5 passes active in your vault, and it will automatically select the highest tier passes first.
You can buy the standard passes from the faction desk in the default tier systems, and from LogiCorp tool stores you come across in higher tier systems.
And the second major feature are the new cargo containers.
These containers can be attached to your hull and can be used for high capacity storage.
Each container has an interface similar to that of the vault, and the interaction with them is essentially the same.
The vaults come in various sizes from small to medium and large.
And their capacity corresponds to their size starting at 40 crates, and going up to 100.
During the experimental version of this patch we will be adding more cargo container shapes, and a whole set of new exterior blocks.

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift BETA 0.2.1.00
notes.content:
[h1]FUNCTIONALITIES[/h1]

- added warp firewall
[list]
	[*]Can only be hacked when a ship is in warp
	[*]When this firewall is down, the ship will drop out of warp and will generate a warp signature. The ship will also be unable to enter warp while this firewall is down.
	[*]Can be repaired with repair cartridges
	[*]Can be hacked from a distance that is 30 * the target's warp speed if the target's warp level is below 5
	[*]If the target's warp level is 5 or above, the range is system wide
[/list]
- added scanner signatures
[list]
	[*]every ship and other important object can leave a scanner signature
	[*]ships scan periodically for new signatures, this is sped up by enabling scanners, the duration of this is defined by the closeness
	[*]when getting closer to a scanner signature, a bar displays over the icon, when the bar reaches zero, the signature updates it's location, allowing the user to get closer to it's true location
	[*]ships generate a warp signature upon exiting warp. This signature is very precise but lasts only a couple of minutes.
	[*]signatures are now the only way to find rich asteroids and gas clouds
[/list]
- added station shield
[list]
	[*]Resource Cost: 7500 Iron , 2500 Copper
	[*]Creates a shield around the ship, rendering it invulnerable from any damage
	[*]Can only be activated within a certains distance from the system's star (differs per system as the star's size differs. The termianl on the device shos when in range.)
	[*]Upon activation, renders ship globally visible and a 15 minute timer will start to run
	[*]15 minutes after activation, the station shield activates fully
	[*]The shield is always visible and is able to be colored
	[*]Power cost scales between 300 and 15000 power, depending on the mass of the station, capping at 1 million mass. 
	[*]Requires one of 3 types of Focusing Crystal to be inserted to operate
[/list]
- added 3 new tools
[list]
	[*]Focusing Crystal TI
		[list]
			[*]lasts 24 hours in Station Shield
			[*]Can be created in 3D Printer
			[*]Costs 50 Carbon, 6 Deuterium
		[/list]
	[*]Focusing Crystal TII
		[list]
			[*]lasts 48 hours in Station Shield
			[*]Can be created in 3D Printer
			[*]Costs 50 Carbon, 50 Vectronium
		[/list]
	[*]Focusing Crystal TIII
		[list]
			[*]lasts 96 hours in Station Shield
			[*]Can be created in 3D Printer
			[*]Costs 50 Carbon, 10 Quartz
		[/list]
[/list]
- added cloaking device
[list]
	[*]Resource Cost: 1750 Iron , 500 Copper, 500 Silicon
	[*]when activated, makes a ship much harder to find. 
	[*]requires heatsinks to operate
	[*]drones and skrill no longer target cloaked ships
	[*]is disabled by any interaction with the outside of the ship (for example: mining, disposing of resources, drones docking/undocking)
	[*]is disabled by warping
	[*]is disabled when weapons are enabled
	[*]Will engage deep cloaking mode after 2 hours of continuous operation. Will render a ship completely invisible.
	[*]Power cost scales between 250 and 7500 power depending on the mass of the ship, capping at 1 million mass. 
[/list]
- holotable now shows a glowing ring around systems which contained active players in the last 5 minutes

- added option for server owners to limit system generation range
[list]
	[*]MaxUniverseGeneratorGenerationDist in serverConfig.json
	[*]Changing this can lock players in their system when they were previously outside of the range!
[/list]
- added several upgrades to Ship Flight UI
[list]
	[*]made own ships, crew ships and fleet ships globally visible
	[*]ship flight markers and text now scale with resolution (no more unreadables on 4k resolutions)
	[*]ship markers are now globally visible while they are in warp
	[*]scout markers are now properly grouped under their parent objects 
[/list]
- added Hydropex Fuel Trader
[list]
	[*]functions like the Galactic Trade Emporium but sells fuel and heatsinks
	[*]Randomly jumps into systems and releases several trade drones into the system
[/list]
- added ignore function
[list]
	[*]type /ignore <playerName> in chat to add a player to your ignore list. This will work across all servers as it is saved locally in your config file.
	[*]type /unignore <playerName> in chat to remove a player from your ignore list. This will work across all servers as it is saved locally in your config file.
	[*]type /clearignorelist in chat to clear your ignore list
	[*]ignoring a player will cause none of their chat messages to appear
[/list]
- missions can now be flagged illegal, if a ship with an illegal mission is scanned by drones, it will gain wanted level

- illegal missions yield 1.5 times more reward

- implemented new drifter mission (basically a transport mission, but it's illegal)

- dronebay automation cartridge "launch" now gives "defend" instruction if no instruction has been set

- decreased chance of warp disrupt for grunts

- added base damage values to Ammo and missile types in the encyclopedia

[h1]GRAPHICS[/h1]

- scout markers are now properly grouped under their parent objects 

- markers no longer display the T to target by default

- markers are now spaced out more when hovered over

- ship flight mouse cursor now scales with resolution

- player names above their heads are now handled the same way as in-game screens, so they can no longer be seen through walls

- flight markers now scale with resolution

- flight marker UI scale can now be controlled by a slider in the options menu

- fixed octagonal door sign being too high

- fixed crate facing the wrong way in the medium armor generator

- fixed bug where in-world markers would twitch

- fixed ram scoop button hover text

- added button to disable the text coloring in the server browser.

[h1]BALANCE[/h1]

- rebalanced hacking cartridges
[list]
	[*]Duration reduced to 3-4 minutes (both defensive and offensive)
	[*]Creation resource costs have been reduced to 10 Silicon, 1 Gold and 1 Cartridge specific rare resource
[/list]
- removed player ships from holotable if they are far away and not transponding

- emp now has a range of 2000 units, but falls off over distance. Disabling missiles still works from 800 units or closer.

- tweaked flak missile speed to more closely match combat range of other weapons

- added checks so final objectives for the main faction ultimate system events only spawn when that faction's headquarters had been built

- ship targets now untarget automatically when they are out of range

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- fixed bug where damage to devices would not work

- fixed bug where flight UI would not display Hurles Co final objective asteroid

- fixed bug where game would try to load systems that are already being loaded in the background

- fixed bug where mission locations and system event locations would not be targetable when parented to a planet, causing the planet to be unselected as well

- fixed bug where player was added to player list before successful login

- fixed bug where player login would wait for system load

- fixed bug where chat bar would scale the text if it went over the width of the text field

- fixed bug where drones had trouble selecting targets

- flak cannons should no longer fire backwards when flying backwards

- fixed bug where GT Player Trade Terminal would not always reset its scroll level upon switching pages

- fixed bug where GT Player Trade Terminal would not always display stock value

- turning scanners on or off now puts all of them in the same state as opposed to swqitching them individually

- implemented various server optimizations

- streamlined player login sequence

[h1]TECHNICAL[/h1]

- upgraded to .Net 4.7.1

[h1]NOTES[/h1]

- Server need to be updated and restarted.

notes.title: Sight unseen - interstellar Rift Development Update 136
notes.content:
[b]Time for another update! This week we have the major sensor rework! The new cloaking device and the station shield! So without further delay let's get into the details...[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/3d6bd57710ef70621be5626d90eebbf90d56fda0.jpg[/img]

First up, the new sensor rework. From now on when you’re flying around the galaxy you will see occasional signatures pop up. These signatures can be several different kinds of phenomena. From a ship dropping out of warp, to rich asteroids, gas clouds and more.
These markers become more accurate the closer you are, so you will have to fly to them in order for them to give you a more accurate location. This goes for all sensor contacts.

Using this new system it will make exploration more interesting as well as add more difficulty in tracking down players for those of you living the space pirate life!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/b91103ce8e87ad186beb905365cd0f9eb91d81d1.jpg[/img]

That said there is a nice way to counter being found using  sensors and that is the new cloaking device! The cloaking device will make it so nothing will show up on sensor contact until they are within 2 km of it. The cloaking device takes a while to fully enable and until it is fully on your ship will still leave a signature. Once it is fully enabled and it goes into deep cloak mode. It wont show up on sensor contacts anymore. You can’t kill what you cant find!
The cloak does have its limitations though, it doesn't function in warp and once you fire your weapons it will disable. This makes it a perfect tool for ambushing ships and hiding your large scale mining operations.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/304f0d47db2600bccbe8d292b4050f649068a322.jpg[/img]

And lastly there is the new station shield!
This device will let you generate an invulnerable station shield on a ship or station located near a star. It's important to note that the station shield will only function if the ship is in orbit around the sun. It takes a while to activate, and once it is activated the ship cannot move anymore.
You are however still able to use the station or ships weapons. Which is important considering once the shield is active it will make the location of the station known to everyone in the system.
The station shield uses special crystals that have a limited duration, and once they run out the station shield will have to be rebooted again. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/a242dbaca0345f8a695ab33e38ee4e8ff1d76763.jpg[/img]

The station shield is intended for stations that players don't mind being found such as trade stations, or as a hub for your fleet or crew. 

We’ve also added in the new HydroPEX fuel tanker made by EternallySlaying that will make periodic stops in every system. Also we tried to contact you EternallySlaying, to ask how you want to be credited, so please let us know. 

For all other things in the patch, please see the details in the patch notes linked below. 

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have a fairly busy discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

[i]-The Split Polygon Team [/i]


[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/363360/announcements/detail/1684803197919120792]Patch Notes for IR Beta 0.2.1.00[/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/0/1734343065627734840/]Feedback thread[/url]

[url=https://discord.gg/eMmVAgs]IR Discord Channel[/url]

notes.title: Stations Galore - interstellar Rift Development Update 134
notes.content:
[b]The experimental patch for this patch includes some new goodies that will make it easier and more secure for players to set up space stations.[/b]

The first device that we are adding is the new station shield. This device allows players to set up a space station near the sun with an invulnerability shield. This new shield requires a rare crystal (currently looking a lot like a heat sink, new graphic coming soon!) to power, and has a long start up time during which the players will need to defend it. Once the station shield is up, it will stay up until the resource depletes.

The second major addition in this patch is the cloaking device. This device hides your ship from sensors meaning it will be much more difficult to find. Unlike the station core this device requires an actual heat sink in order to operate. And it will function until the heat sink is depleted, or you use your weapons, warp, or disrupt the cloaking in any other way.

And lastly the new scanning system,

In order to combat the problem where players were able to find each other anywhere using the holo-table, we have now added a new scanning mechanic. When in the cockpit of your ship, you will now see signatures appear in space. These new signatures will lead you to points of interest or other players if you follow them. The closer you get, the more details they will display about their source. 

For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1733216261948936084/

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/


Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: From Alpha to Beta - Interstellar Rift Development Update 133
notes.content:
[b]Here we are, today our version number increase from 0.1 to 0.2 as we take Interstellar Rift to the Beta phase. With Beta all underlying systems are in place, and we will be focusing on performance, stability and expanding existing content.[/b]

With the Beta also comes a new trailer:
https://youtu.be/gnEwB3XzAAs
The upcoming Stations and Visibility patch will be the first to be released in Beta, and will add new devices that allow for secure trading stations, ship cloaking, and warp disruption among other things. We expect it to hit the experimental branch somewhere next week. 

[h1]Winner of the ship design contest![/h1]

We are also happy to announce the winner of the ship design contest. With a very thin margin we selected EternallySlaying’s “Stag” as the ship that will represent HydroPEX, and visit systems selling fuels. Here’s a workshop link to the ship for those who want to take a look.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1529718380&searchtext=stag
Special mentions go to Insetricky97, and to Nightraven and Johnno, whose designs make up the rest of our top three. Thank you to all who entered into the contest, you made it hard for us to pick a winner. We’ll have a new contest up in a couple of weeks, so there will be more opportunities to get your ships into the game!

Thank you all for playing, and see you star side!

- The Split Polygon team.

notes.title: Off the rail Weapons! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 132
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to the last Alpha patch before we head off to Beta early next week. This patch is a continuation of the combat patch and introduces more weapons, tweaks to enemies and more![/b]

First off, let’s talk about the two new weapons! The tier 2 railgun and the flak cannon! These new weapons will add more variety to your arsenal! The railgun is a large weapon that fires inert tungsten projectiles at great speeds! Dealing a lot of damage to the target. That said the railgun has a slow fire rate and limited ammo capacity. As well as a charge up time before it can fire. To fire the railgun hold down the fire key and wait for the indicator to fill up, once its filled up you can fire the gun by releasing the fire key. If you hold down the fire key too long the gun will fire automatically and if  you don't hold it down long enough it wont fire at all.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/5295a685f742332777db281e2cfbe55cd38338a5.jpg[/img]

Additionally there is the flak cannon this weapon is meant as an area suppression weapon and fires multiple explosives per shot. Which detonate after a timer runs out, a collision with an object or if the distance of your current target has been traveled by the bullets. The explosions have a area damage effect so be sure to stay clear of them when you are under fire or if you intend to fly through them yourself.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/7464d04832cd34ff6c153a2cb1b214685c5cef7b.jpg[/img]

Additionally we have rebalanced the Skrill as well as add new types of Skrill Grunts. These Grunts can now evolves when they eat certain gas clouds, and gain new abilities and strength! Skrill will evolve in a specific way, starting at normal these are the same enemies as you have known them in the past. Their next evolution will turn them green, granting them shields. Their next evolution will turn them blue and in addition to their shield, they gain more health, and they will arc lightning which can damage your shields and ship. And lastly they will turn red meaning they will have their previous upgrades plus more health and they will now also fire missiles. We plan to add similar evolutions to the other Skrill species as well. Note that in higher tier systems you may find these evolved Skrill naturally.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/8197b82ccdb053d244cb984ae416464eb26ce212.jpg[/img]

We’ve also been reworking how POIs (points of interest), are displayed on your flight hud. They are now grouped under the planets they are nearest to, and will split into different icons when you get close. We also added a new station list on the secondary monitor in the helm that allows you to target stations directly without searching for them in your hud first. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/7fabca52ee027dc3eee956708d6812d053324b77.jpg[/img]

A change that is especially relevant for fans of larger ships, is that the amount of default armor your ship has now scales with the amount of hull blocks. You can get up to 1 large armor generator (100k armor) worth of extra hit points by placing more exterior blocks.  

For all other things in the patch, please see the details in the patch notes linked below. 

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have a fairly busy discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you star-side!

-The Split Polygon Team 

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/363360/announcements/detail/1683674762066655798]Patch Notes for IR Alpha 0.1.63.10[/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/0/1734336452582077761/]Feedback thread[/url]

[url=https://discord.gg/eMmVAgs]IR Discord Channel[/url]

notes.title: An experiment in evolution - Interstellar Rift Development Update 131
notes.content:
[b]Experimental version time! This week we are introducing some new weapons, as well as a new system that re-balances the Skrill, and lets them change based on environmental conditions.[/b]

First up we have the new flak cannon and rail gun. These new tier 2 weapons expand the current arsenal. They add the ability to do both a large amount of damage with the rail gun as well as keep attackers away with the flak cannon. 

In addition Skrill have become more dangerous, they have started consuming gas clouds which is causing strange and dangerous mutations. Skrill that have evolved are tougher and have new attacks. What's worse is that these Skrill can change on the fly based on their environment.

In addition there are a bunch of new ores and materials that you can use to build the new weapons and their ammo.

And as always we made further stability and performance fixes!

For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here: 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1741094390484352022/

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you star side!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Blasting off to Beta - Interstellar Rift Development Update 130
notes.content:
[b]As you might have guessed from the title, Interstellar Rift will soon be moving to Beta.[/b] 

So, what does that mean for the you, the players? The move to Beta is mainly a change in our development schedule. We will no longer be adding features that require us to rework a lot of the code behind the scenes. Instead  we’ll focus on adding content to the existing features, polishing up things that have been added in the past, and adding features that work with the framework that we have been building.
It also marks a point where we can focus more on optimizing and stability. The repeated process of changing how large parts of how the game code works has continuously been breaking other parts of the game (as feature implementation tends to do). Which in turn would require us to fix those before moving on to new stuff. 
There will still be new additions to the game, both large and small. The main thing is that the underlying systems have been implemented, and won’t see any drastic changes anymore.   

Interstellar Rift is on sale right now, and will move to Beta shortly after the sale ends. As that happens there will also be a slight increase in the price. The game will go from € 14.99 to € 17.49, or your regional equivalent.  

Patches won’t change much, expect to still see a lot of tweaks to the game and new stuff being added. The next update for example will add in a couple of new weapons, rework the spawning and balance of Skrill, and make some changes to the default CPU and Armor values, scaling them a little with the size of your ship. 

Lastly we would like to thank everyone who tried the game over the last 4 years; from the people who play tested just the editor way back before the game even came to Steam, to those who joined us before combat was even a thing, and to the people who picked up the game in this week’s sale. Your feedback continues to be invaluable to the development of the game. 

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team 

If you have any questions, feel free to join our discord channel, we'll be more than happy to answer any of them. [url]www.discord.gg/interstellarrift[/url]

notes.title: Guns Galore! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 129
notes.content:
[b]It's here! The long awaited weapons overhaul! This massive update brings with it a whole slew of new weapons, defensive options and balance changes![/b]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mDqnjoR2xyg&feature=youtu.be
First up we have our new light arsenal. The way weapons work has been altered quite a bit.

Weapons now require CPU power. Which means players will now have to install a weapon CPU onboard their ships in order to make use of their weapons.

The weapon CPU determines how many offensive and defensive systems can be active at any given time, and thus also determines how many weapons can be fired at once. Players will need to consider whether they want to have more firepower or more defense. Weapons, shields, and the new armor generator among other devices, requires weapon CPU power. 
The new weapons we have added are all of the gimbal weapon variety. Which means they aim at where your mouse cursor is pointing while in the cockpit. This makes it so hitting fast moving targets is easier and should make combat a lot more fun and engaging. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/91ea0905a583b6642cd5ed8c3f5b8452e2e703b9.png[/img]

The new weapons we’ve added are the light autocannon, the light pulse laser and the light missile launcher.
The autocannon is similar to the old forward facing autocannon but it does less damage. It does however use the same ammunition. The light pulse laser fires a short laser beam. This weapon has no projectiles which means that it can hit what it is aiming at directly. And thus players will not need to lead the target. The pulse laser also does extra damage against shields. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/458e58376a7082120b4e7e41e64f75686b6b356e.png[/img]

And lastly the light missiles launcher fires small missiles in rapid succession which track the target. For this we’ve introduced the new missile locking mechanic. When the missiles are active when you hold on your mouse cursor over your currently selected target you will see a the missile lock indicator start to lock. Once missile lock has been acquired you will be able to fire the missiles. The torpedo launcher has also had this mechanic added.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/56edec7bb87c470d0384340a93912a3b07dc039a.png[/img]

One of the new devices we’ve added is the armor generator. These devices determine how many hitpoints your ship has. They also slowly repair your ship over time if you supply them with nanobots. The armor generator was added for balance reasons so that ships are no longer virtually immortal. They provide an upper limit to how many hit points any ship can have so that we are not balancing against infinity. We feel this will make combat much more engaging and fair.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/8ae1fca1eae8afddec2cdbafc542d0fefda03f3d.png[/img]

Lastly we have also added new countermeasures, the EMP generator allows you to disable missiles. Also if another ship is within an 800 meter radius the EMP will damage their shields and partially drain their batteries. Once fired the EMP needs to recharge for a bit before it can be fired again.

These are some of the changes and new things in this patch. For all the changes please see the patch notes. 

[b]As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have a discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback![/b]

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/363360/announcements/detail/1684796856702093460]Patch Notes for IR Alpha 0.1.62[/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/0/1734336452582077761/]Feedback thread[/url]

[url=https://discord.gg/eMmVAgs]IR Discord Channel[/url]

notes.title: A whole lot to process - Interstellar Rift Development Update 128
notes.content:
[b]Today we are introducing the first part the Interstellar Rift combat upgrade to the experimental branch. We are adding in two new weapons, the new CPU system, and the armor generator system.[/b]

First up in the editor you will see two new weapons that you can mount on your ships, the light autocannon and the light pulse laser, these two weapons work in a different manner from the weapons you are used to. They track the position of your cursor and fire in that direction. Meaning it should be easier to hit your targets. 
The autocannon fires projectiles similar to the old guns meaning the bullets have a travel time. And the lasers are hitscan, so they hit what they are aiming at when you press the button.

Additionally ships now require a CPU in order to operate equipment and weapons. So we added two new types of devices, a power CPU, and a weapons CPU. These control ship devices and weapons. Even though a ship in itself has a power CPU and weapon CPU, by default these are nowhere near as powerful as the additional CPUs you can install. For weapons only one CPU can be active at a time.

And lastly there is the armor generator. This new device determines the armor level of your ship and it needs to be equipped with the new nanobots resource. When the generator is equipped with nanobots it will slowly repair the armor overtime. Even when not equipped with nanobots the ship will still have armor so long as the device is active.

And lastly your ships hull has been downgraded to basically paper. It will offer very little protection once the armor has been destroyed, and can only tank 100 instances of damage.

These new progression systems will be iterated upon in the next few updates, so your feedback is very valuable, please let us know what you think!

For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1741090666222995319/

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- trade drones now use the right faction when spawned by stations

- fixed an issue where combat drones under attack would spawn more combat drones, in a loop until the fight ended

- fixed /setAllRes command to actually set ALL resources to a given amount

- fix for some missions missing mission targets in the HUD

- fixed a bug where the players would not be added to the system correctly after reloading the system (fixed mass death bug when desync reload kicks in)

- fixed a rare de-sync when the wrong kind of random was called

- fixed bug where the join faction button on the faction desk would not work

- ship protection now spawns drones instead of calling drones that are very far away (decreases responding time severely)

- fixed a bug where some factions would start with too much influence

- fixed a bug where the deliver resource system event would not give reputation. 

(note that the build ship system event only gives reputation when the resources to deliver are of the same tier as the system it is in. Handing in iron in a T1 system will not give reputation. This will be made more clear in upcoming updates.)

[h1]NOTES[/h1]

- Servers will have to be updated and restarted.
