notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift ALPHA 0.1.61
notes.content:
[h1]FUNCTIONALITIES[/h1]

- added new devices
[list]
[*]Faction Desk
	[list]
		[*]Can be found on starter stations
		[*]Has a store that sells specific faction Items
		[*]Is the only place to buy Rift generator enhancement cartridges
		[*]Allows the player to buy a ship
		[*]Will accept tributes from players to increase reputation
		[*]Displays faction rank and reputation information, and allows to set a faction spawn point
		[*]Provides a new home for Geoff the faction droid, and his twin brother
	[/list]
[*]Small Refinery
	[list]
		[*]Works like a regular refinery but can only refine 1 crate at a time, and is slower
		[*]Cost: 350 Copper, 350 Iron, 1200 Steel
		[*]Size: 2x2x1 Interior blocks
	[/list]
[/list]
- added new tools
[list]
	[*]RiftGenerator Enhancement T1
		[list]
			[*]Can be obtained from faction desk after reaching 1000 reputation with one of the 4 major factions (Hurles Co., Galactic Trade, Sentinel Security Systems and Drifters)
			[*]Upgrades rift generator to access Tier 1 Systems
		[/list]	
	[*]RiftGenerator Enhancement T2
			[list]
			[*]Can be obtained from faction desk after reaching 2000 reputation with one of the 4 major factions (Hurles Co., Galactic Trade, Sentinel Security Systems and Drifters)
			[*]Upgrades rift generator to access Tier 2 Systems
		[/list]	
	[*]RiftGenerator Enhancement T3
			[list]
			[*]Can be obtained from faction desk after reaching 3000 reputation with one of the 4 major factions (Hurles Co., Galactic Trade, Sentinel Security Systems and Drifters)
			[*]Upgrades rift generator to access Tier 3 Systems
		[/list]
		
	[*]RiftGenerator Enhancement T1 (used)
		[list]
			[*]Can be bought from Drifter Faction Desk
			[*]Upgrades rift generator to access Tier 1 Systems
		[/list]	
	[*]RiftGenerator Enhancement T2 (used)
			[list]
			[*]Can be bought from Drifter Faction Desk			
			[*]Upgrades rift generator to access Tier 2 Systems
		[/list]	
	[*]RiftGenerator Enhancement T3 (used)
			[list]
			[*]Can be bought from Drifter Faction Desk
			[*]Upgrades rift generator to access Tier 3 Systems
		[/list]			
[/list]
- added Tiered progression system
[list]
[*]Categorized Most things in Interstellar Rift into Tiers
	[list]
	[*]There are 4 tiers: Tier 0 (No tier), Tier 1, Tier 2 and Tier 3
	[*]Players will start at Rank 0 (which corresponds to tier 0) for their chosen faction
	[*]All resources have a tier assigned to them
	[*]Some systems will be marked as only accessable by a specific Tier and up, these will require an enhancement cartridge for the rift generator. 
		[list]
			[*]Enhancement cartridges can be obtained from a faction desk by going up a rank for any of the 4 major factions (Hurles Co., Galactic Trade, Sentinel Security Systems and Drifters)
			[*]Resources from a specific tier will only spawn in systems with corresponding tier			
		[/list]
	[/list]
[/list]
- upgraded rift generators
[list]
	[*]rift generator now shows all unreachable systems in red
	[*]added enhancement slots to all three rift generators
	[*]Rift generator route planner will only generate route through systems with a tier it can actually rift to
[/list]
- added ability for server owners to enable a popup on join, displaying server news or other information
	
- added 3 new resources
[list]
[*]Quartz
	[list]
		[*]Can be found in tier 3 systems
	[/list]
[*]Crystal Vectronium
	[list]
		[*]Can be created by combining quartz and vectronium in a refinery
	[/list]
[*]Improved Ammo
	[list]
		[*]Can be made using Assembling Machine
		[*]Recipe: 2 Standard Shell + 1 Nitrous Oxide + 1 Brass = 2 Improved ammo
		[*]has a base damage of 40
	[/list]
[/list]
- updated system events
[list]
	[*]Stations built by system events can now be upgraded to a new tier, making them bigger and adding more devices
	[*]when upgrading a station, the cost of it's previous iteration is deducted from its cost
	[*]This will require resources from the next tier
[/list]
- you can now visit the construction satellites

- added multiple new stations

- updated hsc excavator power groups

- gained reputation for missions etc now clamps to the tier limit of the star system

- loans now last for 24 in-game hours, and if it isn't repaid by then you will be fired upon until costs are recouped

- renamed fines to loans/fines in message center

- 2nd en 3rd loan are now locked behind system tier

- added ability to select crew ships for missions as well as your own

- added ability to scroll when hovering over any slider

- cargo teleporter can now teleport into crew and fleet vaults

- added ability to sit on benches

[h1]GRAPHICS[/h1]

- reworked mission GUI

- updated popup messages to allow for multi-line popups

- turret door now starts closed

- transaction notifier can now show decimals

- turret door now shows the state of the device and whether it is occupied

- re-designed holotable galaxy mode, with system tier displays

- stations with extractors now automatically mine near asteroids when no one is on board (and will add these ores to their stores)

- changed gun icon to missile icon in flight gui

- dropbox now lists system event resources as well

- F3 Cinematic Camera now hides ALL of the HUD

- decreased default inner deadzone size from 0.1 to 0.03 

- fixed bug where player would stand up for one frame when sitting in cockpit seat

[h1]EDITOR[/h1]

- fixed paint buttons not properly returning to prop mode visuals and exterior mode visuals

- made it impossible to delete rooms that aren't on the current level

- updated editor GUI to reflect tiering changes, and added colored borders to every prop to display their resource requirement tier

- added new checkboxes for tiers, enabling the player to filter specific tiers

[h1]OPTIMIZATION[/h1]

- added every single crate in the game to a single texture so they only need to load once

- updated text renderer to be about 30% faster

- updated several libraries

[h1]BALANCE[/h1]

- increased loan amounts to 750k/1250k/2000k

- Changed recipes of several resources
[list]
[*]Standard Shell
	[list]
		[*]Recipe: 1 Copper + 1 Iron = 1 Standard Shell
	[/list]
[*]Xanthium
	[list]
		[*]Recipe: 1 Beryllium + 1 Deuterium + 100 Nitrogen = 100 Xanthium
	[/list]
[*]DiXanthium
	[list]
		[*]Recipe: 1000 Xanthium + 1 Mercury + 100 Nitrogen = 100 DiXanthium
	[/list]
[*]TetraXanthium
	[list]
		[*]Recipe: 1000 DiXanthium + 1 Osmium + 100 Nitrogen = 100 TetraXanthium
	[/list]
[/list]
- Changed recipes of several tools
[list]
[*]Hack Chipset repair firewall
	[list]
		[*]Recipe: 10 Silicon, 10 Gold, 10 Brass
	[/list]
[*]Hack Chipset repair firewall %
	[list]
		[*]Recipe: 10 Silicon, 10 Gold, 10 Brass
	[/list]
[*]Hack Chipset repair firewall Pulse
	[list]
		[*]Recipe: 10 Silicon, 10 Gold, 10 Brass
	[/list]
[*]Hack Chipset repair Hacked System
	[list]
		[*]Recipe: 10 Silicon, 10 Gold, 10 Brass
	[/list]
[*]Heatsink TII
	[list]
		[*]Recipe: 50 Copper, 6 Deuterium
	[/list]
[/list]
[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- fixed bug where player got stuck in pilot seat when they got reconnected by desync

- mission list on cargo teleporter now only displays missions which need to be delivered on selected station

- fixed bug where cargo teleporter would teleport all cargo of a type instead of just what it needs when contributing a mission

- missions should now try to find a new station when it's target is destroyed instead of fine the player

- fixed crash in reputation change function

- targetting a mission marker now shows a healthbar and lead indicator if it is an entity

- fixed stats screen not updating properly when gone through a rift

- fixed ACTR not selecting the correct default resource minimum amounts if crate size is < 20

- /giveallres command now gives ALL resources

- drones spawned by ship protection now only spawn drones that can be spawned by drone controls in that system

- ship protection now resets it's cooldown every time it is invoked, even if it is on cooldown, meaning it remains on cooldown until combat is over

- fixed bug where mission objective target entities could not be targeted and would instantly un-target

- give reputation command now doesnt require a restart

- fixed crash in strobe light

- fixed lingering death state alarm sound after closing the game

- fixed crash in gas cloud

- fixed bug where power editor gui would render over the editor menu

- fixed bug where editor upper floor visuals could sometimes still be deleted

- fixed manned turret making a bullet firing sound on opening and closing the doors

- fixed bug where selling from a crew owned ship did not work correctly

- fixed options menu not being enabled when used from in-game

- options menu now doesnt scroll its page when hovering over a slider, so you can scroll the slider

- fixed bug where warp up sound would sometimes randomly play

- fixed bug where warp charge sound would sometimes play as if it is at max charge for a small duration when it starts

- fixed maneuvering thrusters not showing up in engine screen

[h1]NOTES[/h1]

- existing saves must be rebuilt using the "/rebuildServer 2" command, or the 3rd rebuild option from the F8 Menu

notes.title: Thats no moon, it's a tiered system - Interstellar Rift Development Update 128
notes.content:
[b]This patch introduces the new tiered systems into the live build. Meaning that the locations where resources can spawn is now determined by the tier of the star system! But it's not just the star systems that are tiered, ship devices now fit inside tiers as well. Which means in order to build these higher tier devices you need to get resources from these higher tier systems. [/b]

https://youtu.be/7Ef4WhJLLQU
In order to get into these higher tier systems you will need to earn enough reputation so you can acquire new rift generator cartridges which allow you access to these systems. These cartridges can be purchased from the new faction desks located in every faction base, and need to be inserted into rift generators.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/80ee0af7b406f3b3a8038d6e7e5f9cb8d6b682a2.png[/img]  

This new tiering system is put into place so that new players will be guided through the game in a more natural way. If you want to skip ahead and open a limited amount of rifts to a higher tier system, you might want to visit the faction desk on the Black Pit, as they might have some used cartridges for sale. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/9c84deea59f85041412c47f746901afdf1e19fca.png[/img]

There are also a bunch of bug fixes and game improvements which have been added suchs as filter options and a completely redesigned Vault UI. this should be much easier and more logical to navigate. We’ve also rebalanced mission rewards to better reflect the mission objective and difficulty.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/3b27ef3ee7062fb35fe7ba0de1354643711313ad.png[/img]

[i]As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback![/i]

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/363360/announcements/detail/1678037020060468979]Patch Notes for IR Alpha 0.1.61[/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/0/1727575977575311635/]Feedback thread[/url]

[url=https://discord.gg/eMmVAgs]IR Discord Channel[/url]

notes.title: A whole new universe! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 127
notes.content:
[b]This weeks experimental update brings with it quite a major change to the universe of interstellar Rift! Game progression has been cut up into separate tiers, or levels, that players will have to work towards in order to upgrade their ships and equipment.[/b]

Everyone will start at tier 0, using the equipment available at this tier players will be able to advance to tier one, two and finally three. Much like equipment is now divided into tiers, so are star systems! Meaning that each star system now has a corresponding tier level associated with it. In order to access these higher tier systems players will need to increase their reputation level with one of the four major factions, so that they will be able to purchase a tier appropriate navigation cartridge with which they can access these more dangerous star systems via the rift generator.

This also means that a lot of resources are now locked away per system, and the resource cost for a lot of devices has changed to accommodate this. Stores now only sell tier appropriate wares and missions only reference resources from their own tier. 

We are also experimenting with starting the stores empty, and have them be filled by drones and visiting stations. This is something we will be tweaking during the experimental phase of this update. 

All the starter stations now have a faction office where players can purchase basic items as well as faction navigation cartridges.

These new progression systems will be iterated upon in the next few updates, so your feedback is very valuable, please let us know what you think!

For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1727575977526474415/

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift ALPHA 0.1.60.01
notes.content:
[h1]FUNCTIONALITIES[/h1]

- added gas clouds
[list]
	[*]spawns in systems outside the starter systems (can spawn anywhere, no particular location)
	[*]can be spawned from ram scoop device
	[*]contains a random composition of 3 resources
	[*]can have some effects on the player's ship depending on their composition:
	[list]
		[*]mostly Acidium: ship will randomly take damage if shields are down or non-existant
		[*]mostly Calireon: random chance for parts of the cloud to ignite in explosions, will slowly decay into Acidium this way
		[*]mostly Fulgurium: random chance for lightning strikes, damaging shields greatly, but very low damage to armor
	[/list]
	[*]will attract attention of security drones and wanted levels upon release in no fire zone
[/list]
- added new ramscoop device
[list]
	[*]costs 750 Iron, 250 Copper, 150 Silicon
	[*]can obtain resources from gas clouds
	[*]comes in 5 different variants
	[*]can release gas resources to add to existing gas clouds, or create new ones
	[*]releasing gas in no-fire zones will trigger fines and will alert security drones
	[*]gas mining and releasing automatically stops when it is no longer possible
[/list]
- added 5 new resources
[list]
[*]Acidium
	[list]
		[*]Can be obtained from gas clouds using a ram scoop
	[/list]
[*]Fulgurium
	[list]
		[*]Can be obtained from gas clouds using a ram scoop
		[*]Will return some Acidium back into the cloud as waste when mined
	[/list]
[*]Calireon
	[list]
		[*]Can be obtained from gas clouds using a ram scoop
		[*]Will return some Acidium back into the cloud as waste when mined
	[/list]
[*]Vectron gas
	[list]
		[*]Can be obtained from gas clouds using a ram scoop
		[*]Gas cloud composition required:  30-50% Calireon, 25-45% Acidium, 15-35% Fulgurium
	[/list]
[*]Vectronium
	[list]
		[*]Created in refinery using Vectron gas and Aluminium
		[*]Used for construction of high tier devices like the drone bay
	[/list]
[/list]
[h1]GRAPHICS[/h1]

- added heat shader to hull
[list]
	[*]will show a heating effect if ship gets closer to sun (and is not in warp)
[/list]
- added temperature bar next to armor bar in helm

- added gas recipies to encyclopedia

- updated ship status screen graphics

- removed screenshake on invulnerable ships

- added some new loading screen tips

- fixed bug where some guide buttons would stay enabled even if guide was hidden

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- fixed bug where stats window would try to show the wrong ship's stats

- giveres command now works for offline players

- givetool command now works for offline players

- fixed bug where server could crash if toolstores try to sell from a device that no longer exists

- fixed bug where alien raid event would not work

- fixed bug where server could crash on invalid ship files

- fixed bug where system info screen could display the wrong information

- fixed bug where game could crash when a drone was aiming at something which has the exact same position as the drone

- added some extra logging to spawning of stations

- updated crash logging system so it reports engine crashes better

- ship which are destroyed at 0,0,0 should new be put in store-o-tron with full health

- destruction sequence is now also removed from ships which are destroyed at 0,0,0

- ships are now also put in store-o-tron when their tile pos is 0,0,0

[h1]BALANCE[/h1]

- added gas recipe for TNP 
	[list]
		[*]Gas cloud composition required:  30-50% Calireon, 10-30% Acidium, 30-50% Fulgurium
	[/list]
- advanced missiles now spawn expanding explosions (like bomber skrill)

- skrill now only spawn closer to the sun

- rift exits now spawn far away from the sun

[h1]NOTES[/h1]

- rules need to be rebuilt, via the F8 admin menu, or by typing rebuildServer 0 into the console or as a chat command.

- servers need to be updated and restarted.

notes.title: Gastronomical - Interstellar Rift Development Update 126
notes.content:
[b]Prime time! We’ve got another update for you! This time bringing in the the gas clouds and gas cloud harvesting![/b]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yfnxa50kQlg
From now on you will encounter gas clouds which you can harvest using the new ramscoop device.
These gas resources are needed for the construction of high tier devices! Such as the large drone bay and the strip miner. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/ce557dc3693aeee2ca2ebf9a3fa899d609ac7939.png[/img]

Gas clouds come in several varieties, and can be combined through the ram scoop into different colors which correspond to new types of even rarer materials. First you will need to gather these gases by using your ramscoop. Simply fly your ship into a gas cloud and check your ramscoop what types of gases can be harvested. Then you can turn on your ramscoop to gather them. If you wish to change the composition of the cloud you will need to gather the appropriate color and release it into a different gas cloud in order to get the composition that you need. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/216ac6428ccbdc3e73416fb709dc22977931b6f0.png[/img]

Gathering these new gases is not without its risks though. Blue gas clouds are electrically charged and will occasionally discharge their electricity to the nearest conductor. Which can be your ship or any other object in the cloud. Green clouds are acidic and will also start to eat away at your hull after a while. And red clouds are hot, and have random gas explosion. There is also a new heat system but those mechanics have not yet been implemented other than their visual component. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/d458609889f4e60d65840a03cf28d3cd76d35e16.png[/img]

Skrill however have decided that they no longer like the cold outskirts of systems, and now only spawn in regions of sufficient heat. This means that ships that exit a Rift will now end up far far away from the center of a system, instead of right next to the sun. 

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Nebulous encounters - Interstellar Rift Development Update 125
notes.content:
[b]This weeks’ experimental update brings you a feature of a nebulous nature. As intangible as air, yet vital for advanced ship construction! [/b]

Introducing Nebula gas clouds and the new ramscoop.

The ramscoop will be used to harvest new resources that you will find out in the galaxy! These new resources spawn in the form of gas clouds that you can harvest with the new ramscoop.
These gases come in three primary variants; Calireon (red), Fulgurium (blue), and Acidium (green), and can be mixed to create various colors. Some of these color variations correspond with new and even rarer resources such as the new Vectron Gas. 

Using the ramscoop you will be able to both suck in and release gas and thus change the composition of these gas clouds, which will let you harvest small amounts of these special resources. These new resources will be used in high tier devices such as the Strip miner and Drone bay as well as more devices that will be introduced at a later stage in the game.

For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1696048245848031519/

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift ALPHA 0.1.59.10
notes.content:
[h1]FUNCTIONALITIES[/h1]

- added Drone Control
[list]
[*]Can be found under Room Edit Mode > Admin Models
[*]Is a ceiling tile with an exterior componenent, so only visible when other ceiling tiles are visible
[*]Acts as a supervising tool for drones that can be spawned at the station the Drone Control is on, and for any other drones of the same type and faction in that solar system.
[/list]
- reworked how drones spawn
[list]
[*]Drones now check if there is a station that allows them to spawn
[*]Every station that has the ability to spawn drones has a max number of drones it supports, this number is system wide and can only be increased by a station that supports a higher number. If for example there are two HydroPEX stations that spawn trade drones, and one has a capacity of 1 and the other a capacity of 2, the max number of drones that will spawn of this type will be 2.
[*]Any extra drones that spawn for quests or because of security reasons will check every so often if they are still needed, and if not they will leave the system
[/list]
- added fines for damaging ships and stations that receive protection
[list]
[*]Fine amount is 100 times the damage done
[*]Can be payed off in the message center
[*]Fines have a timer, when this runs out, you will automatically be attacked by any Combat Drones you encounter
[*]If your ship is destroyed and you have outstanding fines, the resource value of your ship will be deducted from the fine amount
[*]fines scale on S3 faction influence (0.25 on 0 FI, 1.75 on 5000 FI)
[/list]
- new message center
[list]
[*]Separate categories for messages, fines, missions and notifications
[*]New indicators that highlight new messages
[/list]
- starter systems now also have build station objectives, but they don't increase the faction standing, and there is no final objective

- added more stations to the pool of stations that can be selected for system "station construction" events (none of these are new)

[h1]BALANCE[/h1]

- lowered standard price of beryllium from 8000 per unit to 2000 per unit

- lowered standard price of deuterium from 6000 per unit to 4500 per unit

- increased hacking terminal range to 2000m from 1000m

- rebalanced Xanthium resell prices and recipes
[list]
[*]Xanthium standard price is now 90, recipe is the same as it was
[*]Di-Xanthium standard price is now 900, recipe is now 1000 Xanthium, 1 Mercury and 100 Nitrogen
[*]Tetra-Xanthium standard price is now 9000, recipe is now 1000 Di-Xanthium, 1 Osmium and 100 Nitrogen
[/list]
- drones no longer have random hitpoints on spawning, is now a set value that depends on their type

- combat drones now prioritize ships with players on board more aggressively when searching for a contraband target

- added popup to ship editor terminal when a ship about to be modified has drones in the system

- added admin command to force retrieve an insured ship

[h1]SHIP EDITOR[/h1]

- ship editor now remembers rotations for previously used blocks and props so switching doesn't reset rotation anymore

- ship editor now remembers the previously selected exterior color, and will apply it upon placing new blocks

- added ability to ctrl+click paint an exterior block. Will paint all blocks of the same type and the same color

- added ability to shift+click paint an exterior block. Will paint all blocks of the same type regardless of color

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- fixed some balance issues with the LogiCorp deliver resource missions where it would ask for very large amounts of rare resources

- fixed some threading issues that prevented the game from shutting down in some cases

- fixed the backup order so it deletes the oldest version first when making new backups

- fixed bug where drones would sometimes fly away from their target

- fixed bug where insurance would not return a ship after it is upgraded

- fix bug where space dust wasn't working in some cases

- several fixes in drone control terminal

- fixed bug where backspace would still return to previous UI state in a text field

- fixed bug where mission windows were offset

- fixed bug where guide window was offset

- fixed teleporter lights sometimes not returning to their intended intensity

[h1]NOTES[/h1]

- to update the stations so they all have the new Drone Control Terminals, a rebuild of the systems is required. This will reset all system events and remove all non-static (faction headquarter) stations. New systems will automatically have the new stations, and newly constructed stations also have the drone control terminals. 

To rebuild an entire save use the Grip as an admin by pressing F8 and selecting the second rebuild option. Alternatively you can use the /rebuildserver command in chat or the rebuildServer command in the console, use option 1 for these two. 

To rebuild a single system, use the /rebuildsystem command in chat or the rebuildSystem command in the console. This command requires the system name, and the rebuild version you want to use. It will autocomplete system names. 

[code]Example: /rebuildsystem Vectron 1[/code]

Will rebuild Vectron Syx only.

notes.title: Fine dining - Interstellar Rift Development update 124
notes.content:
[b]It’s time to take the experimental patch out of the oven once again and serve it up! This weeks 3 course dinner consists of the new fine system, a new message system and the new drone system controllers.[/b]

For our appetizer we have the new message system. In your grip you will find that the icon for your mail center has changed a little, as it now displays the number of unread emails that you have. When going into the mail center itself you  will find its design has changed for the better. Each type of mail you receive will now be put into its own category. For example messages and fines have their own tab. This will make it much easier for  you to keep track of specific types of messages.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/b83ddca63faa85b2316d0bd9fd33637e13df41d2.png[/img]

For the main course the new fine system. Whenever you violate the rules in a system in such a way that you receive a wanted level you will also be issued a fine. How high the fine is, depends on how serious the violation is. So the more damage you inflict the more you will have to pay. Each fine will have a time limit, before which you will need to pay to avoid further penalty. If you however do not pay it on time, you will find that Sentinel Security Systems will become quite hostile towards you until you pay your fine. Additionally, If your ship is destroyed by S3 the value of your ship and cargo will be used to pay for your fines. Your fines will be paid in the order that you receive them.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/2423efe6b52a8164c564684286b9833f0ec4dae6.png[/img]

And for dessert we have the new drone system control device. This new device will be found on most stations and will determine the number of drones for each faction that can spawn.
So S3 stations will determine the number of security drones, HSC for mining drones and GT for trade drone etc. The drone controllers are admin models and cannot be placed by players.

[b]Please note[/b] that to get these new drone controllers on every station older saves will have to do at least a partial rebuild. See the notes section in the patch notes below for more information on this. 

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Fines for days! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 123
notes.content:
[b]The experimental branch has been feeling a little neglected, so it's time for another patch. This time bringing with it Fines! The new Mail Center and Drone Control systems![/b]

First up fines, whenever you commit a violation that will earn you a wanted star, you will now receive a fine. The severity of the crime and how much damage you inflict during that time will determine how heavy the fine is. The fine will show up in the new mail center along with an expiration date. Once the fine expires, Sentinel Security Systems drones will attack you on sight until the fine is paid. If however the S3 drones manage to destroy your ship, the value of your ship and its cargo will be deducted from all outstanding fines.

Next up the new mail center. When you get a new mail you will now see a red icon with the number of unread emails in them. Additionally the layout has been optimised to be easier to read, and categories have been added for each type of email.

And lastly the drone control systems, these new devices determine how many of each drone is allowed to be spawned in a system based on the station with the highest drone count in that system. So HSC stations determine the HSC mining drone count, S3 the S3 security drones etc. Constructing new stations in a system will open up new places for drones to spawn. Drone control systems are Admin Models, and server no purpose on player owned ships. They can be found on every station that has the ability to spawn drones, and can be used to see all the drones of that type and faction in the system, and what those drones are doing. 

For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here: 

https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1696046342871129134/

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Guide to the galaxy - Interstellar Rift Development Update 122
notes.content:
[b]Better check your insurance policies, because Vaultron is now accepting applications! 
The new vaultron insurance system will allow you to insure your ships in the unlikely case they are ever destroyed. [/b]

You will find the new insurance system on the vaultron loan terminals. Here you will be able to select for which ship you would like to get insurance. The cost of insurance is calculated by adding up one 5th of the ship resource cost and the weight of the ship.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/b51e6aec570fce2f24119f2363320fccabf63ba5.jpg[/img]

When you apply insurance to a ship. It will be applied to that ship in the state it is in at the time of insuring. What that means is, if you modify your ship after applying the insurance those changes will not be insured. That means if your ship gets destroyed, you will be refunded the unmodified ship. In order receive your most up to date ship you will need to update your insurance. This can also be done through the same terminal by simply selecting your ship and you will be given the option to update your insurance.

Refunded ships will always be placed in the owner’s ship storage and can be retrieved at any Store-o-Tron kiosk.

Finally, we are adding a new player guide to the game. This new system will help new players learn about the game systems as they go. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/5b1187a38acd6af75c2fd38ce73afd0b94c9aba3.jpg[/img]

The new system will give players notifications regarding the ship, the devices on it, and more. The main intent for this system is to give new players a helping hand by explaining the game’s systems as they go. That said, the new system will also have some use for veteran players since it displays which systems are damaged. Or which fuel tanks are empty. And for those who do not wish to make use of this system, don't worry you can turn it off in the options menu.

For a full list of bug fixes please see the patch notes linked below.  
https://steamcommunity.com/games/363360/announcements/detail/2996459011306617895

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift ALPHA 0.1.57
notes.content:
[h1]FUNCTIONALITIES[/h1]

- Pirate drones will now avoid ships in safe zones

- added option to enable/disable off-thread game loop

- game will now show a warning if Graphics drivers are more than a year out of date upon running into an error

- players with AMD drivers newer than 18.3.1 will now auto-disable Occlusion as AMD broke this in their later drivers

- added "/listalldronesinsystem <systemName>" command to list all currently operating drones within a system

- added new tool: PR-61 Plasma Rifle
	[list]
	[*]Can be made in a 3D printer for 50 brass, 50 steel, 50 silicon and 5 platinum
	[*]Requires Plasma Rifle ammo to function
	[*]Fully automatic
	[*]Can occasionally be bought in Logicorp Tool Stores
	[*]Does 10 damage per shot
	[/list]	
- added new tool: Plasma Rifle Ammo
	[list]
	[*]Can be made in a 3D printer for 50 brass, 50 Nitrous Oxide and 50 Hydrogen
	[*]Can occasionally be bought in Logicorp Tool Stores
	[*]Is used in PR-61 Plasma Rifle
	[/list]	
- optimized game update loop 

[h1]GRAPHICS[/h1]

- separated game loop from rendering loop, so lags in the game are no longer affect framerate

- optimized movement of entities to be smoother

- optimized flying through asteroid fields 

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- fixed bug where asteroids would twitch every so often

- fixed bug where asteroids would sometimes not be deleted

- fixed crash in reactor screen

- fixed bug where solo games could still have passwords after hosting a passworded server before starting a solo game

- updated several out-of-date libraries

- fixed crash in fusebox unload

- game builds will now automatically be uploaded to Avast, to add to their whitelisting program (should hopefully get rid of Avast flagging IR)

- fixed crash in dronebay enhancement UI

- fixed bug where point defense drone visuals didn't work

- fixed crash in editor upon loading ship

- fixed bug where players sometimes couldn't click through the editor grid

- fixed bug where depleted fuel cells were not being able to be teleported out of a reactor by an ACTR

[h1]NOTES[/h1]

- servers need to be updated, no rebuilds required

notes.title: Performance upgrades incoming! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 119
notes.content:
[b]This experimental patch is mainly under the hood changes that should improve performance considerably. [/b]

This performance increase has been in development for a while and has been sorely needed. To go into a little more detail, we disconnected the lockstep gameplay state of the game from the client sided gameplay state. What that means is that walking around and flying around is decoupled from the heavy lifting that the game does in the background. Such as; calculating asteroid collisions, handling drone AI, and updating all the devices and thrusters on your ship. In short this should cause an increase in frame rate as the rendering should not be impacted as much by the ticking of the game world. There are also a number of crash and bug fixes included, and likely more to come as we monitor the game to look for potential issues of this update. 

For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/2949168687328559629/

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift ALPHA 0.1.56
notes.content:
[h1]FUNCTIONALITIES[/h1]

- added PvE mode
[list]
[*]ignores all player-caused damage and hacking to ships and players
[*]NPC's like Skrill can still damage ships
[/list]
- added "togglePvEmode" command to switch PvE Mode

- added "toggleCreativemode" command to switch Creative Mode

- added filter options in server list to sort by server modes

- target indicator in flight UI now flashes red when the player hits the target

- ships in death state can no longer be salvaged or upgraded

- added ability for the game to send engine crash dump files automatically (can be disabled by de-selecting "Allow anonymous data gathering" in the options menu)

[h1]SOUND[/h1]

- added character movement sounds
[list]
	[*]footstep sounds
	[*]jump sounds
	[*]sounds are slightly different for male and female characters
[/list]
[h1]EDITOR[/h1]

- reworked and optimized most of the behind-the-scenes code for the editor (allowing for more improvements in the future)

- added hover text when hovering over props in interior mode

- added fly camera mode to ship editor 
[list]
	[*]hold middle mouse or Left alt while moving the mouse, and WASD to move in the direction of the camera
	[*]is not limited in height position by the current floor
[/list]	
- editor now only loads all the prop images it currently needs instead of all of them all the time

- editor can now switch between orbit and fly camera using the ToggleCamera Hotkey (default: T)

- added editor camera movement hotkeys to options menu

- fixed bug where the player could click "through" some editor menus and unintentionally place a block

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- fixed desync when a lot of collisions happened at the same time in multiple systems

- refactored drone long range asteroid finding so it doesn't lag the server anymore

- fixed bug where system was sometimes loaded twice

- server will now create crash dump file when server crashes, to allow better debugging

- server will now disconnect connected players on server crash

- optimized some behind-the-scenes code to increase world generation speed

- fixed bug where wedge shaped window would glitch

- fixed bug where left arm would disappear on some AMD GPUs

- fixed bug where lights would sometimes flicker on some AMD GPUs

- fixed bug where floor would twitch when looking down and jumping

- fixed crash in nuclear reactor

- fixed scroll speed in option menu being too slow

- fixed bug where menu button in grip would summon infinite menus

- fixed bug where tool store would scroll up when clicking an item

- fixed system name/id not showing int the log when is ship is added to a solar system through the store-o-tron rather than a command (like ship editor terminal)

- fixed rare crash in GRIP

[h1]NOTES[/h1]

- Servers will need to be updated and restarted in order for players to join after the patch. No rebuilds are required for this patch.

notes.title: A new perspective - Interstellar Rift Development Update 118
notes.content:
[b]Time for another experimental patch to receive an upgrade to live status!
This week we’re adding a truckload of bug fixes, and some cool and long overdue features such as footstep sounds, a PVE mode, and more![/b]

Starting off we have have added footstep sounds to both the male and female character which means you will now hear yourself and others around you walking. This should provide you with a slightly more immersive experience!

Next we have the PVE mode, this is a new server setting that can be toggled on and off by admins and server owners, or when creating a new galaxy. This mode will ensure  that other players cannot kill you or your ships. And only AI controlled enemies, or your own bad flying can hurt you and your ship. Using new options in the server browser, you can now filter servers based on what game mode they are.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/25bb438f5ef38dc28dd0dfbe759922c411b8c75d.png[/img]

And lastly we’ve made changes to the editor camera. You will find a new view mode toggle that will give you a flycam to use in the editor. This means the camera can move free of active level restrictions in the editor. This should make editing a ship’s hull much easier.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/d33e4e7639e6960c9f911808ed085620bbcd94f7.png[/img]

For a full list of bug fixes please see the patch notes linked below.  

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/0/1696040635927576090/]Feedback thread[/url]

[url=https://discord.gg/eMmVAgs]IR Discord Channel[/url]

notes.title: Tread lightly - Interstellar Rift Development Update 117
notes.content:
[b]Time for another experimental update! This one is a bit smaller than usual but that's because we have some bigger things in the pipeline that just aren't finished yet. But without further ado, onto the patch![/b]

This week we are adding PvE mode, Footstep sounds, and a new fly camera in the ship editor! That means that you are finally able to set your server up in a way that is more forgiving to players who just want to build and explore. In addition both male an female characters have footstep sounds mean you should hear yourself, and others, walking around you. And finally we’ve given you the ability to toggle a flycam in the ship editor which should allow you to get a better view of your ship while you’re building. It should make editing your ships hull quite a bit easier.

And ofcourse we have a new round of bug fixes and stability changes.

For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1696040635903786662/

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift ALPHA 0.1.55
notes.content:
[h1]FUNCTIONALITIES[/h1]

- added new device:
[list]
	[*]Escape pod launcher
	[list]
	[*]Can hold 1 escape pod
	[*]Cost: 5000 Iron, 1500 Copper, 250 Silicon, 250 Steel
	[*]Size 1x1 wall tile
	[*]Mass: 1200
	[*]Comes with one escape pod
	[*]Charges escape pod when escape pod is present
	[*]Uses up to 1000 power per tick if escape pod is charging
	[*]Escape pod can be re-filled at a hydroPEX station or a Store-o-Tron
	[/list]
[/list]

- networking moved to a separate thread so messages are not stalled when server or client lags

- added escape pod
[list]
	[*]launched from new escape pod launcher device
	[*]contains up to 15 million power
	[*]can warp and move until it's power is drained
	[*]cannot re-dock into the escape pod launcher
	[*]has a teleporter on board
	[*]has 
[/list]

- added ship destruction sequence:
[list]
	[*]Is initiated when a ship reaches 0 hp
	[*]lasts between 30 seconds and 10 minutes dependant on ship mass
	[*]prevents ship from blowing up until timer ends
	[*]causes ship lights to turn red and blink
	[*]damages devices periodically while active
	[*]causes ship to come to a complete stop
[/list]

- right screen of store-o-tron now has an escape pod purchase screen

- HydroPEX service station now has an escape pod purchase screen

- player inventory now clears when player dies

- added player death orb
[list]
	[*]spawns when a player dies with anything in their inventory
	[*]allows anyone to loot the dead player's inventory
	[*]players killed by admin commands will keep their inventory
[/list]

- added discord rich presence
[list]
	[*]players can now request to join other players in Interstellar Rift

notes.title: Don’t go down with your ship - Interstellar Rift Development Update 116
notes.content:
[b]Trading cards, escape pods, deathstates, oh my! The new next patch is ready for primetime! Introducing the ship deathstate, dropping your inventory on death, Steam Trading cards, Discord rich presence, and a lot more.[/b]

Ship deathstate, the escape pod and the dropping of the player inventory are closely tied together. And we had to make sure all 3 were done before we could implement any one of them  into the game. But it's all here now so Enjoy!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/cc1ea8b54d5bd416beec4a1ed9b0de9120665ea7.png[/img]

The Ship deathstate is there to give players a chance to grab their valuables and escape. But how do you escape a burning ship you ask? Why I’m glad you asked, because from now on you will be able to escape using the new escape pod! 
This new device can be placed on the side of your ship, and can be launched at any time! Once launched players will be able to fly to safety for a brief period. Escape pods can warp away quickly once launched. Additionally once you’ve gotten away you can salvage the escape pod for some resources that will help you get on your way again.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/82acf6401f3c1e1596f3e4954cb20a4604dfcf55.png[/img]

But since players now drop their inventory on death, players will now have more options to save themselves from the destruction of their ship. When you die a holographic projector droid is spawned on your position, containing all the stuff in your inventory, resources and tools. These little droids stay around for five minutes, after which they simply disappear.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/0cae5bfccf6766d1da2cb2847c94b6761756b0ea.png[/img]

The ship deathstate will last longer the bigger your ship is. Which means there will be an opportunity for the attackers to raid large ships once they have destroyed them.

But there is more as well. We’ve added in discord integration into the game. Which means you can now join your friends through discord and see what they are doing in their name tags.

And we’re also adding Steam trading cards to the game for you to collect and enjoy, these should be dropping as of posting this. 

For all the details on the changes we made, please see the link to the patch notes below. It will go into detail about the new escape pods, all the bug fixes, and some of the optimizations we’ve done this patch. 

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Abandon ship! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 115
notes.content:
[b]This weeks experimental patch brings some much needed goodies, such as the new ship death state, escape pods, player inventory drop on death, and Discord rich presence integration.[/b]

First up the new ship death state. When a ships hull reaches 0% health, the ship will no longer blow up instantly. The ship will enter a brief period in which it ceases to function, and random explosions will rock the ship. This is called the death state, during this period players will have the opportunity to gather what resources they want to save from their cargo hold, and use the escape pod to make a run for it.
Once the deathstate is over the ship will explode. And anyone onboard will be killed. Which now means that the inventories of those  players will be destroyed along with them. Hence why players will now need to use escape pods or other means of escape, if they wish to keep their inventories.

In addition if a player kills another player, a small device with the contents of their inventories will drop above their corpse allowing other players to loot their inventories, inventories will last for 5 minutes, after which they will despawn.

Escape pods will allow players to save themselves and their items from being lost when their ship gets destroyed. If a ship is equipped with an escape pod, players players will have a reliable way to escape a destroyed ship. Players can launch them by simply walking into them getting behind the controls and clicking the launch button. This will close the doors and teleport the pod away from the ship. Once launched players will have power to fly around for a brief period at maximum warp. The pod is not equipped with weapons and it is lightly armored so running away is your best option. Once you have reached safety, you will be able to salvage the escape pod for roughly 130k U-Nits worth of resources. The pod cannot be refueled once depleted. In addition pods can also be launched when the ship is in a death state, (a ship cannot move while in death state), and they can be replenished by purchasing them from HydroPEX service stations or Store-O-Tron kiosks.

For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1700541698690075993/

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: The Little Drone That Could - Interstellar Rift Development Update 114
notes.content:
[b][i]Time for another Interstellar Rift update! After simmering in the experimental branch for a little while, this new update featuring drone automation, and the new Medium Rift Generator, is ready for prime time.[/i][/b]

The new Medium Rift Generator works very similarly to the small and large rift generator, but it is able to send ships through rifts with a mass rating up to 1 million. Meaning that it can only use regular Xanthium and Di-Xanthium. This is ideal for medium ships or small ships that wish to be able to use the same rift multiple times.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/309c3d152e706e549ad55a97c5a0274241d912b1.png[/img]

In addition we are also adding automation options to the heavy drones. This will allow you to put drones to work by sending them out to gather resources, return, automatically unload their goods, and then go out again. It also allows the drones to automatically respond if the ship is attacked. Meaning they will launch by themselves, and attack anything that is attacking the ship. 

Of course you will be able to cancel their commands, and retrieve them before their programming is up. The cartridges required for these automation functionalities can be made in the 3D Printer, or bought at stores that happen to sell them. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/be4b4d62da1bbab93c31601572c7c8c3186998e0.png[/img]

We’ve also made some changes to the point defense drones that players can deploy, from now on they require drone components, and when first created they will be empty. Meaning that players will now need to add ammo to the drone. Ammo can be added in the assembling machine, which also allows you to create drones that come with a full magazine by including the ammunition with the rest of the resources. For the time being point defense drones can only use standard ammo.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/e44e5796127cbc4909428cacf1304d417f5ebd72.png[/img]

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join! 

Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift ALPHA 0.1.54
notes.content:
[h1]FUNCTIONALITIES[/h1]

- added new System events
[list]
	[*]Vaultron
		[list]
			    [*]Scout - required influence: 0
				[*]Build XT-22 Vault station - required influence: 0
				[*]Build XT-338 Rift station - required influence: 0
				[*]Build Vaultron Galactic bank - required influence: 2000
		[/list]
	[*]Logicorp
		[list]
			    [*]Scout - required influence: 0
				[*]Build Logicorp printing station - required influence: 0
		[/list]
	[*]HydroPEX
		[list]
			    [*]Scout - required influence: 0
				[*]Build HydroPEX Service Depot - required influence: 0				
				[*]Build HydroPEX Small Rift Hub - required influence: 0
				[*]Build HydroPEX Small Hub - required influence: 2000
		[/list]
[/list]
- scout system faction objectives now require to be scanned using scanners (fly close to them and enable scanners)

- added new device:
[list]
	[*]Medium rift generator 
	[list]
	[*]Can create rifts up to 1 million mass
	[*]Accepts Xanthium and Di-Xanthium as Rift Fuel
	[*]Cost: 1250 Steel, 250 Iron, 500 Copper, 500 Silicon
	[*]Size: 2x2x2 tiles
	[*]Mass: 3200
	[/list]
[/list]
- added new tool:
[list]
	[*]Automation Cartridge: Drone Bay
	[list]
		[*]Can be inserted into drone bay
		[*]Can contain up to 15 rules consisting of a condition and an action
		[*]Drone rules are executed in order
		[*]Available Conditions when docked:
			[list]
				[*]Resource Condition: 
					[list]
						[*]Can be set to any resource type
						[*]Can be set to equals, greater than or smaller than
						[*]Can be set to any of the three drone bay/drone inventories (Drone bay, Drone cargo and Drone Consumeables)
					[/list]
				[*]On Damage Condition: 
					[list]
						[*]Triggers when parent ship is receiving damage
					[/list]
			[/list]
		[*]Available Conditions when in flight:
			[list]
				[*]Mine (select resources to mine)
				[*]Recall
				[*]Attack/Defend target
				[*]Deliver to target
				[*]Repair target
			[/list]
		[*]Available Actions when docked:
			[list]
				[*]Move resource to target inventory: 
					[list]
						[*]Can be set to any resource type
						[*]Can move resources between two designated inventories
						[*]Source and Destination can be set to any of the three drone bay/drone inventories (Drone bay, Drone cargo and Drone Consumables)
					[/list]
				[*]Launch Drone: 
					[list]
						[*]Launches drone and repeats the last order
					[/list]
			[/list]
		[*]Available Actions when in flight:
			[list]
			[*]On ship damaged
			[*]On ship not damaged
			[*]Resource Condition
			[/list]
	[/list]
[/list]
- Player-deployed defense drones now have 1200 ammo and stop shooting once depleted

- Player-deployed defense drones are salvageable and will split into an ammo crate and and an empty drone

- Added new resource: Defense drone (empty)
[list]
	[*]Can be obtained by salvaging a defense drone
	[*]Can be created in assembler for 2 Drone construction components, 1 drone combat component, 1 drone electronics component
	[*]Can be combined with 1200 Ammo in the Assembling machine to create a non-empty Defense drone
[/list]
- drones launched from Drone bay now automatically repeat their last order when launched by either the new automation cartridge or a player

- drones will now defend themselves when fired upon by other players if equipped with weapons

- commands now try to find the closest match for players and systems, instead of the literal text

- mining drones now have different mine speeds per resource (now set to 5 times slower than extractor)

- re-added clear chat command

- added "giveTool <Name> <ToolType> <amount>" admin command to spawn a tool in a player's vault

[h1]GRAPHICS[/h1]

- added indicators for device inputs/outputs in editor

- all props with both an interior and exterior part now show properly in the editor

- delete key can now also be used to delete in-game mails

- added damage particle nodes for small, medium, large and extra large fuel tanks

- added damage particle nodes for Drone bay

- scout system event marker now changes to green if the player is in scan range and their scanners are turned on

- scout system event marker now changes to orange if the player is in scan range and they have no scanners or scanners are turned off

[h1]BALANCE[/h1]

- destroying drones in drone bay now returns part of the resources based on drone damage

- changed point defense drone recipe to include drone parts and bullets

- indestructible drifter entities no longer shoot at s3 entities (fixed Black pit firing at S3 Defense drones)

- increased player-deployed defense drone projectile speed to 750, from 500

- decreased player-deployed defense drone projectile spread to 5, from 10

- increased player-deployed defense drone projectile base damage to 20, from 10

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- fixed error in parsing bold text in main menu news

- fixed /killPlayer command not working properly

- fixed bug where reloading system would not correctly re-add long range objects like planets and suns (fixes disappearing sun after desync reconnect)

- salvager now properly displays entity names

- create fleet menu cancel button now works properly

- fixed potential crash in server browser

- fixed crash in engineering terminal

- reactor gui now checks whether a player has access

- fixed bug where teleporting players would sometimes crash the server

- fixed crash in rift route generation

- fixed potential crash on returning to main menu

- fixed drone not continuing to mine after it returned to drone bay once

- fixed some bugs where salvaging and upgrading would not return the correct amount of resources

- add some fixes that should make it a lot less likely for the server to crash on spawning large ships

- fixed actr not selecting the first item in device list

- fixed crash in engineering terminal

- fixed crash in hacking terminal

- fixed crash in player hud

- fixed crash in player customization UI

- fixed bug where game could crash on invalid data

- fixed bug where data core terminal would not use cartridge power correctly if no expansion bay was used

[h1]NOTES[/h1]

- Servers will need to be updated and restarted in order for players to join after the patch. No rebuilds are required for this patch.

notes.title: Cleaning out the cargo hold! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 113
notes.content:
[b][i]Happy new year everyone! Kicking things off in 2018 we are bringing you another experimental patch. This one features some new system events, drone bay automation and a lot of bug fixes.[/i][/b]

The drone bay automation will let you automatically empty the drone cargo bay, for example, and respond to attacks. This system will get a few more update before it goes live, so stay tuned and let us know what you think.

As for the system events, HydroPEX, Vaultron, and LogiCorp have now entered the real estate market, and you will now be able to build their stations as well in your system. We have also made some slight changes to the existing events, and hope to bring more diversity to them soon.

For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1621726179585535510/

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Attack of the Drones - Interstellar Rift Development Update 112
notes.content:
[b]The long awaited Drone bay is finally here! Today the drone bay hits our live branch of Interstellar Rift, bringing with it the ability for players to construct and direct their own heavy drones. [/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q1dHtUVjVh8&feature=youtu.be
Once the bay is constructed aboard your ship, you will need special drone components to build the  drones (you’ll find the recipes in your grip’s encyclopedia and in the patch notes, as well as on the drone bay terminals.)
Your drones are fully customizable, you can change the color, their name and their load out from the control console on the second floor of the bay. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/f9a1e53b18d0162af5dcd11d6108d3b2620826d4.png[/img]

Drones can serve several purposes based on their load out. A drone with cargo pods attached can carry resources around and deliver them for example, and a drone with the engine attachment can fly much longer on the same amount of fuel. If you also equip that drone with a mining laser it can gather resources for you. Or if you’re looking for a more combat oriented version. You can equip the drone with missiles and two turrets. But unlike the drones that are activated via the disposer, these require fuel and ammunition. Which can be loaded into the drone using the resource hopper.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/71edac2161338e7a2ed0a866562119d73c347dfb.png[/img]

In addition there are also a bunch of improvements to the chat system, the cursor can now be moved, the chat commands for the console and ingame chat are now unified, and we added new commands, and updated the old ones where needed.

We’ve also made some changes to the underlying code which should result in performance gains on some systems. You should also see improvements to how you see other players. Which should mean less sliding around, more fluid animations, and a reduction in micro stuttering.

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/0/2906376154317586267/]Feedback thread[/url]

[url=https://discord.gg/eMmVAgs]IR Discord Channel[/url]

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift ALPHA 0.1.53
notes.content:
[h1]FUNCTIONALITIES[/h1]

- added drone bay
[list]
[*]Can create and launch drones
[*]Can add and remove attachments from drones
[*]Can control drones
[*]Can only be assigned one drone
[*]Cost: 7500 Refined Iron, 2500 Steel, 2750 Aluminium, 750 Silicon
[*]Size: 5x8x3 blocks
[*]Launches drone from the bottom
[/list]
___________________

- added 4 new resources
[list]
[*]Drone Parts: Flight
	[list]
	[*]Recipe: 150 Aluminium, 150 Steel, 5 Platinum
	[*]Made in Assembling Machine
	[/list]
[*]Drone Parts: Construction
	[list]
	[*]Recipe: 75 Steel, 600 Iron
	[*]Made in Assembling Machine
	[/list]
[*]Drone Parts: Combat
	[list]
	[*]Recipe: 75 Aluminium, 75 Brass, 75 Steel, 75 Nitrous Oxide
	[*]Made in Assembling Machine
	[/list]
[*]Drone Parts: Electronics
	[list]
	[*]Recipe: 150 Silicon, 150 Copper, 75 Iron, 5 Gold
	[*]Made in Assembling Machine
	[/list]
[/list]
___________________

- added player-controlled drones
[list]
[*][b]Can be built in a drone bay[/b]
[*][b]Can have the following attachments:[/b]
	[list]
		[*]Drone Body
			[list]
			[*]Cost - 12 Drone Parts: Construction, 4 Drone Parts: Flight, 4 Drone Parts: Electronics
			[/list]
		[*]Drone Cargo Bay
			[list]
			[*]Cost - 6 Drone Parts: Construction, 2 Drone Parts: Electronics
			[/list]
		[*]Missile Pods
			[list]
			[*]Cost - 2 Drone Parts: Construction, 2 Drone Parts: Electronics, 6 Drone Parts: Combat
			[/list]
		[*]Engine Pods
			[list]
			[*]Cost - 4 Drone Parts: Construction, 2 Drone Parts: Flight, 1 Drone Parts: Electronics
			[/list]
		[*]Top/Bottom turret
			[list]
			[*]Cost - 1 Drone Parts: Construction, 1 Drone Parts: Electronics, 4 Drone Parts: Combat
			[/list]
		[*]Mining Laser
			[list]
			[*]Cost - 4 Drone Parts: Construction, 2 Drone Parts: Electronics, 1 Drone Parts: Combat
			[/list]	
		[/list]
	[/list]
	
[*][b]Has two inventories:[/b]
	[list]
	[*]Consumables (can contain any kind of fuel, ammo, iron for repairing, or missiles)
	[*]Cargo Hold (only if drone has a cargo attachment, can hold any type of resource or tool)
	[/list]
	
[*][b]Can be assigned several commands:[/b]
	[list]
	[*]Mine (will find selected resources in asteroid fields and mine them until it's cargo hold is full, will return to drone bay if it is) - requires Cargo Bay + Mining Laser
	[*]Defend (will orbit selected target and defend it against any attacker) - requires any kind of weapon attachment and ammo/missiles
	[*]Attack (will attack selected target) - requires any kind of weapon attachment - requires any kind of weapon attachment and ammo/missiles
	[*]Deliver (will deliver everything in the cargo hold to selected ship/station and teleport it aboard) - requires Cargo Bay
	[*]Repair (will repair selected ship/station) - requires refined Iron in consumables and a Mining Laser (for now)
	[*]Recall (will return to drone bay) - no requirements
	[/list]
	
[*][b]Will return to drone bay after it's fuel or any resource needed for it's job is depleted[/b]

[*][b]Cannot go through rifts and will be lost if their owner ship goes to another system (unless they are docked) or owner ship doesn't exist anymore[/b]
[/list]
___________________

- added new System event: Build defense drones
	[list]
	[*]Will build stationary defense turrets around a station
	[/list]

- System events can now give Faction Reputation as well

- Window title now shows if a window is a Ghost Client and for which system

___________________

- added several new chat commands:

[list]
[*]listResources (list all resources + ids)
[*]listTools (list all tools + ids)
[*]listFactions (list all factions + ids)
[/list]
___________________

- resources can now be typed in chat with <Resource Name> and will be replaced by icon + name

- tools can now be typed in chat with <Tool Name> and will be replaced by icon + name

- factions can now be typed in chat with <Faction Name> and will be replaced by icon + name

[h1]GRAPHICS[/h1]

- updated chat window

- updated text fields so that cursor can be moved with arrow keys

- fixed bug where target icon would jitter when close to a target

- fixed bug where holotable target icon would flicker on slower computers

- poi toggle buttons on cockpit center screen now actually work

- reworked cockpit GUI and fixed several bugs with it

[h1]BALANCE[/h1]

- security drones contraband check interval changed to 30 minutes instead of 1 minute

- strip miner and nuclear reactor now have authority checking on everything that is not physically picking up or dropping a crate/tool

			[/list]
		[*]Engine Pods
			[list]

			[/list]

			[list]

notes.title: “Open the drone bay doors HAL” - Interstellar Rift Development Update 111
notes.content:
[b]It’s almost here, the much anticipated drone bay is hitting experimental today![/b]

This means you will be able to build and configure your own heavy drones, and send them off into the galaxy to do your bidding. While on experimental it will still cost regular resources to build, but once it hits live there will be specialised drone components that you will have to craft in order to assemble a drone.

Over the next week or so we will be tweaking and making changes to the drone bay based on your feedback, so please feel free to let us know what you think. Please also note, that the drone bay is still a work in progress. So some graphical features and sounds might be missing, but will be added soon.

We’ve also made some changes to system event rewards and scout mission types, and we’ve made some major changes to the POI system under the hood. Which will make the system more efficient, and you should see a change in performance while piloting a ship.

For server owners we’ve also added a number of new chat command a full list of which you will find in the patch notes.

For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1489992713696908930/
Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift ALPHA 0.1.52
notes.content:
[h1]FUNCTIONALITIES[/h1]

- added Small Rift generator
	[list]
	[*]Can be found under Prop Edit mode (F2) > Devices
	[*]Bulding Materials: 500 Steel + 250 Iron + 250 Copper + 250 Silicon
	[*]Can only use Xanthium as fuel
	[*]Can create rifts up to 100k mass
	[*]Has a size of 2x1x1 tiles
	[/list]
- added four new tools
[list]
[*]Starmap Cartridge
	[list]
	[*]Can be bought from Logicorp Tool Stores
	[*]Can be made in 3d printer for 25 Silicon, 10 Gold and 5 Mercury
	[*]Contains a list of nearby starsystems to scan
	[*]Can be inserted into Data Core Terminal to scan current system and to find out which systems to go to
	[*]Uses Scanner Strength to scan systems (more strength = faster scanning, capped at 5000 scan strength)
	[*]Can be sold for more cash to Logicorp Tool Stores after scanning one of several systems
	[/list]
[*]Research Cartridge
	[list]
	[*]Can be bought from Logicorp Tool Stores
	[*]Can be made in 3d printer for 25 Silicon, 10 Gold and 5 Mercury
	[*]Can to be inserted into a Faction-owned station to be assigned a faction
	[*]Can be inserted into Data Core Terminal to scan current system
	[*]Uses Scanner Strength to scan systems (more strength = faster scanning, capped at 5000 scan strength)
	[*]Increases faction influence for the assigned faction in the system being scanned
	[*]Can be sold for more cash to Logicorp Tool Stores after scanning
	[/list]
[*]Faction Data Cartridge
	[list]
	[*]Can be bought from Logicorp Tool Stores
	[*]Can be made in 3d printer for 25 Silicon, 10 Gold and 5 Mercury
	[*]Can to be inserted into a Faction-owned station to steal encrypted data
	[*]Can be inserted into Data Core Terminal to start decrypting data
	[*]Can be sold to stations of opposing factions for U-Nits
	[/list]
[*]Local Artifact
	[list]
	[*]Can only be bought from Logicorp Tool Stores
	[*]Has a random chance to be a Counterfeit Artifact (Only Drifter station Stores will buy these, for 1/10th the price)
	[*]Can be sold to Logicorp Tool Stores which have demand for them for more U-Nits the farther it's sold from it's origin system
	[/list]
[/list]
- added four new fuel tanks
[list]
[*]Small Fuel tank
	[list]
	[*]Can store up to 10000 fuel
	[*]Building materials: 135 Iron + 30 Copper
        [*]Will automatically replace any old small hydrogen tanks. (Rotation might have to be altered so the hopper is accessible)
	[/list]
[*]Medium Fuel tank
	[list]
	[*]Can store up to 25000 fuel
	[*]Building materials: 250 Iron + 75 Copper
	[/list]
[*]Large Fuel tanks
	[list]
	[*]Can store up to 75000 fuel
	[*]Building materials: 250 Iron + 150 Copper + 500 Steel
        [*]Old large hydrogen tanks will not change, need to be replaced to use the new ones, old large tanks will keep their functionality but new hydrogen can only be added via a cargo teleporter.
	[/list]
[*]Extra Large Fuel tank
	[list]
	[*]Can store up to 150000 fuel
	[*]Building materials: 500 Iron + 300 Copper + 750 Steel
	[/list]
[/list]
- added screens to Hydrogen Tanks, showing their contents

- added button to Hydrogen tank screen to retrieve a crate of fuel or to fill inventory with fuel with one click

[h1]BALANCE[/h1]

- added Data Core Terminals to several stations

- added Data Core Terminal to GT Hauler

- removed Festivus Cartridge spawning (Already spawned cartridges will still persist)

- tweaked xanthium prices to better reflect the size of a rift it creates

- rift generator now uses power relative to the mass of the rift you want to create. power cost is five times the mass of the rift

[h1]GRAPHICS[/h1]

- server list now shows server version instead of IP

- server list now shows out of data servers as well, but at the bottom of the list and greyed out

- server list now shows Ping for the listed servers (using ICMP protocol)

- added version mismatch popup to Server List

- removed halloween models from main menu

- target indicator now changes it's position depending on how far away it's target is (should make guns a little more accurate)

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- fixed bug where Vaultron Secure Payload mission would target the incorrect ship when another player goes to the ship where the resources should be delivered

- fixed missions showing up on the wrong dropbox

- added the -inline argument to attach the output and input to the parent process for dedicated servers

- removed several lockstep tick stalls (lag spikes)

- fixed an issue where the progress bar of the research cartridge would not update

- fixed an issue with the hacking terminal where it would change the connection with a ship when going through a rift

- fixed the descriptions of hydrogen tanks, now show the correct capacity

- fixed an issue where asteroids could go over their max size in the extractor

- fixed an issue with the color of the indicators of the new hydrogen tanks in the editor

- fixed teleporter UI showing the wrong color for some ships that were in a fleet, but not in your fleet

- fixed not being able to join a local server by clicking on the local server listing in the server browser

- fixed a bug where the turbines in the nuclear reactor would sometimes disappear

[h1]NOTES[/h1]

- servers will need to be updated and restarted, no rebuilds required

notes.title: A sense of Purpose - Interstellar Rift Development Update 110
notes.content:
[b][i]This time around we’re introducing a couple of quality of life improvements such as a smaller rift generator and a series of new hydrogen fuel tanks. As well as a new cartridge progression system.[/i][/b]

First up the new small rift generator will make it more convenient for players with small ships to get from system to system. However unlike its larger counterpart it can only use regular Xanthium which means that it will only be able to rift ships with a mass up to 100.000. In the near future we will also be adding a medium rift gen to service medium sized ships.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/c669b2f900c30798a643929db75a7a7f8dfea2be.png[/img]

We’re also adding 4 new hydrogen fuel tanks! All fuel tanks will now have an input hopper where you have to insert the fuel. Which means the placement and orientation of fuel tanks will now matter if you wish to refuel them manually. Refueling with the cargo teleporter still works as it always did. In addition we’ve added buttons to the fuel tanks where you can now choose to eject just one crate or fill your entire inventory. This should give you a bit more control over how you remove hydrogen from your tanks. The new tanks also visibly show which fuel is in the tank, and have an indicator that shows how full they are.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/47f5bf40a24b78ec828f03eeedf432cca6ddcc0c.png[/img]

And lastly the new cartridge progression system, you will now be able to buy or craft several new cartridges which can be used to advance your standing with a faction or be exchanged for units.
They come in the variety of starmap, faction or research cartridge. For more information, please click the link to the patch notes below. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/7ea1508252f7b8dd7e029b45ce5e82742c4f89d2.png[/img]

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join!
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team
