notes.title: Cartridge Bonanza - Interstellar Rift Development Update 109
notes.content:
[b]Experiment time! This week we are releasing a few quality of life devices, as well as a new discovery system. We are introducing the star map, research and faction data cartridge that can be used to advance your standing, or generate some U-nits for you.[/b]

In addition we are introducing a much needed new device known as the small rift generator, and it is exactly as advertised. A smaller version of the large rift generator that can only use regular Xanthium. Meaning that it will only be useful for ships that have a mass lower than 100.000 kilograms. We have plans for a medium rift generator later down the line as well.

We’re also adding two new sizes of fuel tank, while reworking the other two fuel tanks. All hydrogen fuel tank now have a resource hopper that you will have to insert the fuel into. 

Note that these are not all of the changes we are making for the upcoming patch, in the coming days we will be looking at your feedback and making changes based on that as well as adding more balancing tweaks.

For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here: 
http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1480982971166121772/
Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift ALPHA 0.1.51
notes.content:
[h1]FUNCTIONALITIES[/h1]

- systems now start with much lower faction influences

- added system events for the four major factions
[list]
[*]When first entering a new system, objectives for the different factions will be generated

[*]Completing objectives will cause faction influence for the faction to which the objective belongs to increase

[*]When a single faction completes their final objective, no more objectives will generate and the system will be marked as owned by that faction

[*]System event objective status can be checked out on the GRIP, through a new button at the top of GRIP's main menu
[/list]
[list]
[*]Hurles Co. Objectives:
	[list]
	[*]Faction influence required: 0
		[list]
			[*]Gather Resource
			[*]Scout
			[*]Build Refinery Station
		[/list]
	[*]Faction influence required: 1000+
		[list]
			[*]Build Assembly Station
			[*]Build Trade hub
		[/list]
	[*]Faction influence required: 2000+
		[list]
			[*]Build Mining Outpost
			[*]Build industrial Complex
		[/list]
	[*]Faction influence required: 4000+
		[list]
			[*]Mine large Asteroid
		[/list]
	[/list]
	
	[*]Sentinel Security Systems Objectives:
	[list]
		[*]Faction influence required: 0
		[list]
			[*]Gather Resource
			[*]Scout
			[*]Build a Guns R Us
		[/list]
		[*]Faction influence required: 1000+
		[list]
			[*]Defend Defense Point
			[*]Kill Skrill
			[*]Kill Drifter Station
		[/list]
		[*]Faction influence required: 2000+
		[list]
			[*]Build Fort Bragg		
		[/list]
		[*]Faction influence required: 4000+
		[list]
		[*]Defend Supply Station	
		[/list]
	[/list]
	
	[*]Galactic Trade:
		[list]
			[*]Faction influence required: 0
			[list]
				[*]Gather Resource
				[*]Scout
				[*]Build GT Trade Sphere
			[/list]
			[*]Faction influence required: 1000+
			[list]
				[*]Gather Rare Resource
				[*]Gather Iron (Better reward)
				[*]Meet trade demand - Ores
				[*]Meet trade demand - refined resources
				[*]Meet trade demand - Refined resources (better reward)
			[/list]
			[*]Faction influence required: 2000+
			[list]				
				[*]Meet trade demand - Rare resources
				[*]Meet trade demand - Constructed resources
				[*]Meet trade demand - Rare ores
				[*]Meet trade demand - Rare Refined resources
				[*]Build Trade Hub
			[/list]
			[*]Faction influence required: 4000+
			[list]		
				[*]Buy Advanced Fuel
			[/list]
		[/list]
	
	[*]Drifters:
	[list]
		[*]Faction influence required: 0
			[list]
			[*]Gather Iron
			[*]Scout
			[*]Gather Scrap
			[*]Destroy any non drifter station (FI reward)
			[*]Build Mojo's Dojo
			[/list]
		[*]Faction influence required: 1000+
			[list]		
			[*]Gather Iron (Pirate drone spawnrate bonus)
			[*]Destroy S3 combat drones
			[/list]
		[*]Faction influence required: 2000+
			[list]		
			[*]Build The Black Pit
			[/list]
		[*]Faction influence required: 4000+
			[list]	
			[*]Hack station and steal hacking chipsets
			[/list]
	[/list]
[/list]

- added new resources
[list]
	[*]Advanced Fuel
		[list]
			[*]Can be bought after completing GT final objective
			[*]Can put into regular hydrogen tanks
			[*]Lasts 10x as long as normal Hydrogen Fuel
			[*]Cannot be crafted
		[/list]
	[*]Advanced Ammo
		[list]
			[*]Is spawned on S3 Supply Station after completing S3 final objective
			[*]60 damage per bullet
			[*]2400 bullets per crate
			[*]Cannot be crafted
		[/list]
	[*]Fluorite
		[list]
			[*]Is spawned in a rich asteroid for Hurles Co. Final objective
			[*]Can be mined with Strip Miner
		[/list]
[/list]

- added new tools
[list]
	[*]Advanced Heatsink
		[list]
			[*]Can be crafted in 3D Printer (cost: 50 Aluminium, 10 Beryllium, 20 Fluorite)
			[*]last 4 times as long as a T3 Heatsink
			[*]Can be used in reactor and ACTRs
		[/list]
	[*]Chipset Break Firewall (Tier II)
		[list]
			[*]Is spawned on Mojo's dojo after completing Drifter final objective
			[*]last up to 4 times as long as Tier I cartridges
			[*]can hack up to 3 times as quickly as Tier I cartridges 
		[/list]
	[*]Chipset Repair Firewall (Tier II)
		[list]
			[*]Is spawned on Mojo's dojo after completing Drifter final objective
			[*]last up to 4 times as long as Tier I cartridges
			[*]can repair up to 3 times as quickly as Tier I cartridges 
		[/list]
[/list]

- ship owners (and members of their crew) now gain U-NITS for killing skrill based on skrill type, skrill faction influence and S3 faction influence 

- rebuild commands now wait until all systems are removed (and thus saved) before notifying a rebuild is complete

- added an ingame encyclopedia to the upper left corner of the GRIP that lists all resources, tools, and devices
	[list]
		[*]click on a tool or resource to see the recipe
		[*]double click on a tool or resource to see what use they have in other recipes
		[*]filter on tools, resources, or devices
		[*]click on devices to see what resources can be made with that device
		[*]use the history buttons on the upper left to go back and forth between visited pages
	[/list]
 
[h1]BALANCE[/h1]

- decreased Skrill debris

- Skrill Grunts
	[list]
		[*]minimum burst fire delay for normal Skrill bullets is now 20 ticks (from 15)
		[*]max burst fire delay for normal Skrill bullets is now 40 ticks (from 20)
		[*]bounty: 7.5k - 30k U-NITS
	[/list]
	
- Skrill Hunters
	[list]
		[*]minimum burst fire delay for normal Skrill bullets is now 20 ticks (from 15)
		[*]max burst fire delay for normal Skrill bullets is now 40 ticks (from 20)
		[*]Shield draining bullets now fire in salvos of 3 instead of 5
		[*]bounty: 10k - 75k U-NITS
	[/list]
	
- Skrill Stingers
	[list]
		[*]Armor value: 100 - 150 (from 1000 - 1200)
		[*]bounty: 15k - 100k U-NITS
		[*]max speed: 600m/s (from 800)
	[/list]
	
- Skrill Disruptor
	[list]
		[*]Armor value: 10000 - 15000 (from 1000 - 1200)
		[*]bounty: 35k - 250k U-NITS
		[*]max speed: 500m/s (from 1000)
		[*]minimum burst fire delay for normal Skrill bullets is now 20 ticks (from 15)
		[*]max burst fire delay for normal Skrill bullets is now 40 ticks (from 20)
	    [*]normal Skrill bullets now fire in salvos of 3 instead of 5
	[/list]
	
- Drones now drop resources when destroyed regardless of whether they were carrying anything (on top of what they were carrying)

[h1]GRAPHICS[/h1]

- teleporters now show name of ship creator instead of power usage

- transponding ships now show under transponding name in teleporter

- fix position of female astral armor fore arm pieces

- reworked Hacking terminal UI and fixed several bugs with it in the process

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- fix crash in trade drone when there are no possible stations

- fixed crash in Fleet Rank member screen

- fixed two crashes in Main Menu

- fixed crash in ship flight screen

- fix ghost client crash in weapongroups

- added more logging on unintended ship removals

- fixed bug where server would crash if any entity that is not a ship tries to go through a rift

- fixed bug where loading screen would freeze if player logs in on a ship that no longer exists

- cleaned up some unnecessary loading of sounds (should save some memory)

- fixed bug where cargo on non-cargopad devices would not be included in ship construction

- fixed bug where rifts would sometimes move objects which are scheduled for deletion (killing players on arrival)

- fixed bug where galaxy meta data would not save after a full rebuild (causing player ships to not show up in store-o-tron)

- fixed divide by zero on trade drone AI

- fixed random for planet assignment for station generation to also include the last generated planet

- fixed a bug where the server could crash on destroying a drone

- fixed a bug where hacking chip sets that were used on your own ship would stop working after going through a rift 

- fixed a bug where the editor could crash on props with non-existing device types

- fixed a crash in the hacking terminal
 
[h1]NOTES[/h1]

- servers and personal saves will have to be rebuilt using the 3rd redbuild option from the F8 admin menu. ("rebuildServer 2" in server console)
this may take some time to complete depending on save file size.

notes.title: The event of a lifetime - Interstellar Rift Development Update 107
notes.content:
[b]After a longer period than usual we are happy to release patch 0.1.51 bringing with it system events.[/b]

These system events allow players of any skill level and progression to participate and help nudge a system to be controlled by their faction of choice. Players will be granted rewards for most objectives they participate in. So, for example, an objective is to help gather resources to build a station, every time they hand in resources they will be paid for it. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/e9897fd8919b3f139dc2bc5b47a647d5cdc59bab.png[/img]

System events will be present in every non-starting system which now means that in some star systems there will be no space stations until some event objectives have been completed. Note that some stations do still spawn over time in some instances.

Once all the objectives for a given faction are completed that system will become owned by that faction. And players will be granted access to special rewards resources with which they can build more efficient fuel, ammunition and more. In the near future we will be adding ways for players to retake systems for other factions. As well as investigate the possibility of player factions.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/4c265730f99a43be522ef7d6247dfb45b4abe172.png[/img]

In addition we are also adding in skrill and drone bounties, regardless of where players destroy these threats players will be granted a small amount of money for their trouble. More difficult enemies will net higher bounties. We hope this will incentivise players to help keep their systems free of skrill. The skrill have also had their movement rebalanced so that they are more in line with the recent ship flight changes.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/dc9f57492f31bfaf8d67f9b515f1fc972348ae30.png[/img]

We’ve also added a new button to the GRIP, which will allow you to access the encyclopedia. In here you will be able to find the crafting recipes and a descriptions for every item, tool and resource in the game. This should eliminate any uncertainty as to what each item costs to make, or what it does.

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join!
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift ALPHA 0.1.50
notes.content:
[h1]FUNCTIONALITIES[/h1]

 - added new event ticker window
[list]
[*]will show events like "Ship under attack" and many other messages
[*]ship event messages will now show to everyone on the ship, regardless if they are in the cockpit or not
[/list]

- added new rift generator route graphic
[list]
[*]will auto generate a route to selected system in rift generator
[/list]
 
[h1]BALANCE[/h1]

- Nerfed Skrill hunter bullets, now do 20 damage on shields and +2.5% of max shield (from 20%)

- tweaked power usage of Gravitational Anchor (from 50/t to 5/t)

- Shields now only require 25% of their charging power when they are fully charged

- Buffed Shield generator output
[list]
[*]Small Shield Generator: Max output to 1000 from 600
[*]Large Shield Generator: Max output to 10000 from 6500
[/list]

- rebalanced Skrill spawn rate and group size. 
[list]
[*]low Skrill systems have smaller groups
[*]higher Skrill systems will have far less frequent spawns
[/list]

- Skrill no longer spawn near the system's star

- rifts will now always exit near the system's star

- added shield toggle button to cockpit screen

- clicking an editor mode button twice no longer returns to previous mode

[h1]GRAPHICS[/h1]

- updated main menu patch notes and news sections

- added message when manned turret is out of power

- fixed wrong popup in Ship editor Terminal UI

- added no power/ deactivation messages to 3d printer

- device editor windows no longer overlap with upgrade resource bars in editor

- fixed chat options window mouse discrepancies

- food bar now properly disappears when finishing a health pack

- grip now shows health of device when using device manager

- paint button now also turns blue when it's mode is selected

- fixed bug where back button in advanced ship stats menu did not work

- fixed bug where resource bars in 3D printer would render on top of the resource explanation popup

- updated engine particle effects

- inventory now cannot be scrolled while holding unlock mouse key

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- fixed bug where sometimes players would get separated from their ships when going through a rift

- fixed bug in editor where one could not save if unreachable tile is detected

- fixed some issues where player data would sometimes not save

- fixed bug where stations and turrets would fire on the wrong target

- force use of dedicated GPU on AMD laptops

- fixed some issues with player login sequence

- fixed crash issue with Skrill

- fixed bug where teleporting to refinery would sometimes dupe resources

- fixed bug where stored ships position was not saved

- fixed bug where drones would sometimes target each other

- fixed bug where entities would spawn debris/play sounds/handle reputation etc for every instance of damage in the frame it died instead of once
 
[h1]NOTES[/h1]

- Servers and saves will have to be rebuild using the first rebuild option in the F8 menu (or the "rebuildServer 0" command in dedicated server console)

notes.title: Housecleaning part deux - Interstellar Rift Development Update 105
notes.content:
This week we are doing some house cleaning, we have some quality of life changes and a bunch of bugfixes.

First up there is the event ticker, in the top right part of the screen you will find a new display that will tell you about what is happening around you and your ship. This will be useful during combat, as well during normal flight as it tells you the status of your own ship as well as your target.

In addition to the ticker, we also added the rift generator route planner, you can now search for systems that are out of range of your rift generator and it will direct you to the closest system en route to that system.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/9a45c2bd0c2914e684b3a0abf6103e8ee283186d.png[/img]

Most of our efforts have gone into the upcoming Systemwide events, but we did include a bunch of bugfixes for some of the major issues that have been plaguing the game these past two weeks.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/18c4058b4e400ef9f65d56dfa86bfcc942f74e56.png[/img]

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: News from around the system! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 104
notes.content:
[b]In this experimental patch we're adding in some quality of life improvements and bug fixes, while we work on larger things behind the scenes.[/b]

While we're hard at work on the upcoming system events, this patch brings some smaller features that we've been meaning to add for some time. 

First up is a visual that helps you find the optimal route in the rift generator. Highlighting a path that you can follow from system to system when you search for one on the terminals. 

There is also a new UI element called the Event Ticker, that shows you things that happen to your ship and in your current system. It will notify you when you're out of fuel, for example, and when Eggnites have attached themselves to your ship. We are adding more events to the ticker over the coming weeks, which should help players get a better idea of the things that are happening in a system. 

There have also been balance tweaks, such as nerfing the damage Hunters do by a significant amount, and having shields drain only 25% of their normal power drain when fully charged. 

For all the details see the patch notes, where you can also leave feedback about this patch:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1496741765127170379/

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift ALPHA 0.1.49
notes.content:
[h1]FUNCTIONALITIES[/h1]

- added button in power mode of editor to assign all unassigned devices to the currently selected group

- added Data Decoder:
	[list]
	[*]Can be placed by admin
	[*]Can decode data cartridges every 60 minutes
	[*]Can be found on all faction starter locations
	[/list]
	
- added Data Cartridge:
	[list]
	[*]Can be inserted in a Data Decoder
	[*]Will give a random amount of resources
	[*]Has a chance of giving a cosmetic item as a reward in your Steam Inventory
	[/list]
	
 - added Steam Inventory functionality:
	[list]
	[*]added three new armor sets: Orion, Supernova, Astral
	[*]armor sets can be used as cosmetic overrides for default armor
	[*]a new tab has been added to the options menu where Steam items are displayed
	[*]cosmetic overrides can be equipped from the character customization screen
	[/list]
	
- mission mails are no longer able to be deleted while the mission is still in progress

- exterior camera now centers on the ship, instead of the location of the blue arrow in the editor

- reworked warp drop functionality
	[list]
	[*]Ship now checks if it's facing a planet
	[*]Steering away from the planet will allow for higher warp speeds
	[*]Added warp drop reason indicator
	[/list]
		
[h1]GRAPHICS[/h1]
 
 - ships now also show a particle when warping
 
 - added checklist to editor to give the player some construction tips
 
 - editor now shows max speed and max turn rate as a bar rather than a number
 
 - editor now shows the power requirement for warp on the top bar
 
 - editor now shows the maximum shield output the current ship can have
 
 - reworked ship flight camera movements:
	[list]
	[*]added interior camera sway
	[*]added exterior chase camera
	[/list]
	
- Added gravity well indicator:
	[list]
	[*]shows direction of nearby gravity well during warp
	[/list]
 
[h1]BALANCE[/h1]

- added idle timer which removes a delivery drone after an hour of being idle.

- ships will now accelerate to 30% of their max speed if the player set the thruster to 30% instead of whatever speed it would reach using 30% of its thrust. This should cause ships to represent player input more closesely. The same is true (and more noticable) for rotation

- added an base wanted level to the pirate drones that will never deplete

- ships no longer go faster when they move diagonally

- added linear smoothing (drag) for heavy ships

- tweaked resources that spawn on the chem plant

- added check so pirated drones do not attack players with a high drifter reputation.

- Reworked ship controls:
	[list]
	[*]Added Maximum speed (500 m/s)
	[*]Added maximum rotation thrust influence (2)
	[*]Added strafe thruster smoothing
	[*]Added roll thruster smoothing
	[*]Added weight scaling for thruster influence (heavier ship slower rotation speed)
	[*]Added weight scaling for ship acceleration/deceleration {heavier ship slower acceleration and deceleration}
	[/list]

- Reworked warp power usage:
	[list]
	[*]Warp power requirement: ship mass / 45;
	[*]charge between warp level power cost to 1.5x the mass of the ship in power (45k mass = 67.5k power)
	[/list]

- Reworked power usage of engines:
	[list]
	[*]Class 1 Ion Engine: 2 power per tick
	[*]Class 2 Ion Engine: 4 power per tick
	[*]Class 3 Ion Engine: 1 power per tick
	[*]Tech 2 Class 1 Ion Engine: 40 power per tick
	[*]Tech 3 Class 1 Ion Engine: 325 power per tick
	[/list]
	
- Reworked power usage of maneuvering thruster:
	[list]
	[*]Maneuvering Thruster: 5 power per tick
	[/list]
	
- Reworked Batteries:
	[list]
	[*]Maximum storage: 1,500,000 power
	[*]Maximum output: 300 power per tick
	[/list]
	
- Reworked Solar Panels:
	[list]
	[*]Full Solar Panel Output: 0.3 power per tick
	[*]Half Solar Panel Output: 0.15 power per tick
	[/list]
	
- Reworked Generators:
	[list]
	[*]Tech 1 Hydrogen Generator Max Output: 150 power per tick
        [*]Tech 1 Hydrogen Generator fuel consumption to 0.05 per tick
	[*]Tech 2 Hydrogen Generator Max Output: 1500 power per tick
        [*]Tech 2 Hydrogen Generator fuel consumption to 0.475 per tick
	[/list]
	
- Reworked Extractor:
	[list]
	[*]Power usage while mining: 50 power per tick
	[/list]
	
- Reworked oxygen vents:
	[list]
	[*]Power usage while mining: 0.25 power per tick
	[/list]
	
- Heatsink resource cost rebalanced
	[list]
	[*]Heatsink T1: 50 Aluminium, 6 Deuterium
	[*]Heatsink T2: 50 Aluminium, 12 Deuterium, 5 Beryllium
	[*]Heatsink T3: 50 Aluminium, 24 Deuterium, 10 Beryllium
        [*]Heatsinks now last twice as long in the ACTR
	[/list]
	
- Added additional armor value to smaller exterior blocks

- Doors power usage to 0.25 from 1

- Air vent power usage to 0.25 from 1

- increased nuclear full cell duration by 33%

- improved starter ships to function with the new ship controls

[h1]SOUND[/h1]

- added new warp level charge-up sound
 
[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- Fixed bug where drones never arrived at their destination after warp
 
- fixed bug where ships would rotate faster when rotating diagonal
 
- fixed bug where editor would not accurately display a ships max speed
 
- fixed bug where shipcontrol buttons would overwrite each others state
 
- fixed bug where attacking pirate drones would give a wanted level
 
- fixed bug where game would crash when removing then placing devices in upgrade mode
 
- fixed bug where mission count for crews would be capped at 5

- fixed bug where the wrong tool would be show in the players hand in some cases

- fixed bug where warp charge sound would be layered on top of itself

- fixed bug where server would crash

- fixed bug where admin menu ship list would be too slow

- fixed slider label values not always being the same as the actual slider value

- fixed steal TNP from logicorp missions

- fixed power bar in ship status screen

[h1]ADMIN COMMANDS[/h1]

- added console command "removeAllDronesInSystem" with argument system ID that removes all drones in a system. 

- added console command "findSystemIdForPlayer" with argument player ID, that prints the system ID that player is in. 
 
[h1]NOTES[/h1]

- Servers and saves need to be rebuilt. Use the second rebuilding option on the F8 admin menu, or use server command RebuildServer 1 in the server console window. This will regenerate any existing stations, but will leave players ships as they are.

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift ALPHA 0.1.49
notes.content:
[h1]FUNCTIONALITIES[/h1]

- added button in power mode of editor to assign all unassigned devices to the currently selected group

- added Data Decoder:
	[list]
	[*]Can be placed by admin
	[*]Can decode data cartridges every 60 minutes
	[*]Can be found on all faction starter locations
	[/list]
	
- added Data Cartridge:
	[list]
	[*]Can be inserted in a Data Decoder
	[*]Will give a random amount of resources
	[*]Has a chance of giving a cosmetic item as a reward in your Steam Inventory
	[/list]
	
 - added Steam Inventory functionality:
	[list]
	[*]added three new armor sets: Orion, Supernova, Astral
	[*]armor sets can be used as cosmetic overrides for default armor
	[*]a new tab has been added to the options menu where Steam items are displayed
	[*]cosmetic overrides can be equipped from the character customization screen
	[/list]
	
- mission mails are no longer able to be deleted while the mission is still in progress

- exterior camera now centers on the ship, instead of the location of the blue arrow in the editor

- reworked warp drop functionality
	[list]
	[*]Ship now checks if it's facing a planet
	[*]Steering away from the planet will allow for higher warp speeds
	[*]Added warp drop reason indicator
	[/list]
		
[h1]GRAPHICS[/h1]
 
 - ships now also show a particle when warping
 
 - added checklist to editor to give the player some construction tips
 
 - editor now shows max speed and max turn rate as a bar rather than a number
 
 - editor now shows the power requirement for warp on the top bar
 
 - editor now shows the maximum shield output the current ship can have
 
 - reworked ship flight camera movements:
	[list]
	[*]added interior camera sway
	[*]added exterior chase camera
	[/list]
	
- Added gravity well indicator:
	[list]
	[*]shows direction of nearby gravity well during warp
	[/list]
 
[h1]BALANCE[/h1]

- added idle timer which removes a delivery drone after an hour of being idle.

- ships will now accelerate to 30% of their max speed if the player set the thruster to 30% instead of whatever speed it would reach using 30% of its thrust. This should cause ships to represent player input more closesely. The same is true (and more noticable) for rotation

- added an base wanted level to the pirate drones that will never deplete

- ships no longer go faster when they move diagonally

- added linear smoothing (drag) for heavy ships

- tweaked resources that spawn on the chem plant

- added check so pirated drones do not attack players with a high drifter reputation.

- Reworked ship controls:
	[list]
	[*]Added Maximum speed (500 m/s)
	[*]Added maximum rotation thrust influence (2)
	[*]Added strafe thruster smoothing
	[*]Added roll thruster smoothing
	[*]Added weight scaling for thruster influence (heavier ship slower rotation speed)
	[*]Added weight scaling for ship acceleration/deceleration {heavier ship slower acceleration and deceleration}
	[/list]

- Reworked warp power usage:
	[list]
	[*]Warp power requirement: ship mass / 45;
	[*]charge between warp level power cost to 1.5x the mass of the ship in power (45k mass = 67.5k power)
	[/list]

- Reworked power usage of engines:
	[list]
	[*]Class 1 Ion Engine: 2 power per tick
	[*]Class 2 Ion Engine: 4 power per tick
	[*]Class 3 Ion Engine: 1 power per tick
	[*]Tech 2 Class 1 Ion Engine: 40 power per tick
	[*]Tech 3 Class 1 Ion Engine: 325 power per tick
	[/list]
	
- Reworked power usage of maneuvering thruster:
	[list]
	[*]Maneuvering Thruster: 5 power per tick
	[/list]
	
- Reworked Batteries:
	[list]
	[*]Maximum storage: 1,500,000 power
	[*]Maximum output: 300 power per tick
	[/list]
	
- Reworked Solar Panels:
	[list]
	[*]Full Solar Panel Output: 0.3 power per tick
	[*]Half Solar Panel Output: 0.15 power per tick
	[/list]
	
- Reworked Generators:
	[list]
	[*]Tech 1 Hydrogen Generator Max Output: 150 power per tick
        [*]Tech 1 Hydrogen Generator fuel consumption to 0.05 per tick
	[*]Tech 2 Hydrogen Generator Max Output: 1500 power per tick
        [*]Tech 2 Hydrogen Generator fuel consumption to 0.475 per tick
	[/list]
	
- Reworked Extractor:
	[list]
	[*]Power usage while mining: 50 power per tick
	[/list]
	
- Reworked oxygen vents:
	[list]
	[*]Power usage while mining: 0.25 power per tick
	[/list]
	
- Heatsink resource cost rebalanced
	[list]
	[*]Heatsink T1: 50 Aluminium, 6 Deuterium
	[*]Heatsink T2: 50 Aluminium, 12 Deuterium, 5 Beryllium
	[*]Heatsink T3: 50 Aluminium, 24 Deuterium, 10 Beryllium
        [*]Heatsinks now last twice as long in the ACTR
	[/list]
	
- Added additional armor value to smaller exterior blocks

- Doors power usage to 0.25 from 1

- Air vent power usage to 0.25 from 1

- increased nuclear full cell duration by 33%

- improved starter ships to function with the new ship controls

[h1]SOUND[/h1]

- added new warp level charge-up sound
 
[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- Fixed bug where drones never arrived at their destination after warp
 
- fixed bug where ships would rotate faster when rotating diagonal
 
- fixed bug where editor would not accurately display a ships max speed
 
- fixed bug where shipcontrol buttons would overwrite each others state
 
- fixed bug where attacking pirate drones would give a wanted level
 
- fixed bug where game would crash when removing then placing devices in upgrade mode
 
- fixed bug where mission count for crews would be capped at 5

- fixed bug where the wrong tool would be show in the players hand in some cases

- fixed bug where warp charge sound would be layered on top of itself

- fixed bug where server would crash

- fixed bug where admin menu ship list would be too slow

- fixed slider label values not always being the same as the actual slider value

- fixed steal TNP from logicorp missions

- fixed power bar in ship status screen

[h1]ADMIN COMMANDS[/h1]

- added console command "removeAllDronesInSystem" with argument system ID that removes all drones in a system. 

- added console command "findSystemIdForPlayer" with argument player ID, that prints the system ID that player is in. 
 
[h1]NOTES[/h1]

- Servers and saves need to be rebuilt. Use the second rebuilding option on the F8 admin menu, or use server command RebuildServer 1 in the server console window. This will regenerate any existing stations, but will leave players ships as they are.

notes.title: A better way to fly - Interstellar Rift Development Update 103
notes.content:
[i][b]The much needed flight model overhaul is here![/b][/i]

We’ve spent some time to improve the way ships handle for an improved ship flight experience. Although our flight system uses a Newtonian physics system under the hood, a lot of it has been tweaked in favor of gameplay and ease of handling. 

So while not physically correct, what we always hoped to achieve was a balance between fun gameplay and interesting build options. What that means for this update, is that the flight model has been tweaked in such a way that the number of thrusters and the mass of your ship correlate. So hopefully it will be easier to tweak your handling experience in the ship editor.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/ebfca20692ca31f0030ce7bf1887f809bc3c88f6.png[/img]

Speaking of the editor, we’ve now added several new features to the editor such as the new turn rate indicator that tells you what your turn rate is a gauge between 0 and 2 with 1 being what we would consider a good and easy to use turn rate. This gauge changes based on your ship's weight, and the number of thrusters.

To further improve the flight experience we’ve added a chase cam to the exterior view of the ship this should make ship flight feel easier and more natural when flying in exterior view. We’ve also added a slight amount of camera sway in the interior view.

We’ve also tweaked all of the starter ships to function properly with the new flight model and made the S3 starter ship a bit more durable for combat missions.

To help pilots out during warp, there is now a new indicator that shows you when your ship is experiencing heavy gravitational pull from nearby bodies that might drop your warp levels. Simply steer your ship away from the indicator and you should always be fine. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/9786b85ae0d28f9717b254ff04eca7f6545525ec.png[/img]

Another addition to the ship editor is ship issues indicator. When you build your ship it will now have an indicator at the top of the screen that will tell you if your ship is missing certain devices to make it viable such as a life support system. Before this would only show up if you saved your ship.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/8baf3c7d9f4fe5cce7cf41548999b437657ed1bc.png[/img]

The other major feature is the addition of [b]data cartridges[/b] which can give you special rewards such as new and unique armor skins. Theses skins will be tied to your Steam inventory and can be traded through Steam. In order to equip these armor skins you will need to enable them in the character customization menu and then when you equip a regular armor piece in game you will equip the armor piece with the attached skin instead.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/790138a4483e90d4f6f0b16764f631cc62d60fa6.png[/img]

In order to receive these items you will need to take a special cartridge which you can get from mission rewards or by looting them, and place them in a special data decoder which can be found the starting stations for each faction.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/137718d6f605a47166508c0eeabf880f729f5480.png[/img]

There's other changes in this patch, such as rebalanced power costs for a lot of devices, making non-warp flight much, much cheaper. New color palettes in the editor, optimizations, bug fixes and more! Please see the patch notes for full details. 

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join!
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Shipping and handling - Interstellar Rift Development Update 102
notes.content:
[b]This new experimental update brings with it a much needed overhaul of the ship flight model and a re-balance of ship systems.[/b]

Thrusters are now balanced based on ship weight. So heavy ships now need a lot of thrusters in order to turn while small ships need fewer. We've also taken a long hard look and changed the power consumption rates of a lot of devices in the game as well as their build costs and weight. This has the possibility that many of your ships will no longer function like you expect. And some ships such as purely solar powered ships will have trouble warping.

We’ve balanced ship flight more towards warp rather than regular flight so during normal flight your fuel is consumed at a lower rate than when you are warping. Warp is now much more costly in terms of power and increases based on your ship's weight.

In addition we are also adding a new loot mechanic which is tied in with the steam inventory. You can find new data cartridges in the world or you can receive them as mission rewards. On the starter stations you will find a new decoder terminal. Once you insert the data cartridge the decoder will analyse it and give you a random number of rewards. With a chance to receive a new armor piece skin.

These skins will be tied to your steam account and placed in your inventory they can be traded and sold in the steam marketplace just like any other steam item. 

The new armor skins can be applied to your character through the character customizations tab in the menu. Do note that you still need to build an armor set ingame and equip it before the new item shows on your character.

Note that these are not all of the changes we are making for the upcoming patch, in the coming days we will be looking at your feedback and making changes based on that as well as adding more balancing tweaks.

For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1473095331510658047/

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Shipping and handling - Interstellar Rift Development Update 102
notes.content:
[b]This new experimental update brings with it a much needed overhaul of the ship flight model and a re-balance of ship systems.[/b]

Thrusters are now balanced based on ship weight. So heavy ships now need a lot of thrusters in order to turn while small ships need fewer. We've also taken a long hard look and changed the power consumption rates of a lot of devices in the game as well as their build costs and weight. This has the possibility that many of your ships will no longer function like you expect. And some ships such as purely solar powered ships will have trouble warping.

We’ve balanced ship flight more towards warp rather than regular flight so during normal flight your fuel is consumed at a lower rate than when you are warping. Warp is now much more costly in terms of power and increases based on your ship's weight.

In addition we are also adding a new loot mechanic which is tied in with the steam inventory. You can find new data cartridges in the world or you can receive them as mission rewards. On the starter stations you will find a new decoder terminal. Once you insert the data cartridge the decoder will analyse it and give you a random number of rewards. With a chance to receive a new armor piece skin.

These skins will be tied to your steam account and placed in your inventory they can be traded and sold in the steam marketplace just like any other steam item. 

The new armor skins can be applied to your character through the character customizations tab in the menu. Do note that you still need to build an armor set ingame and equip it before the new item shows on your character.

Note that these are not all of the changes we are making for the upcoming patch, in the coming days we will be looking at your feedback and making changes based on that as well as adding more balancing tweaks.

For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1473095331510658047/

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift ALPHA 0.1.48
notes.content:
[h1]FUNCTIONALITIES[/h1]

- added player-owned stores
[list]
[*]Cost: 450 Iron, 250 Silicon, 175 Copper
[*]Mass: 400
[*]Listed under Props>Devices
[*]Can both sell and buy from assigned cargo pads or item lockers
[*]Has an internal U-Nit buffer, where all sale profits are sent to. Buying goods is also drained from this buffer. 
[*]Only players with manage rights and above can retrieve or deposit cash in the buffer.
[*]Will deny any interaction if Ship is hacked
[*]Can buy or sell from a selected ship (Crew ship or your own) as well as the player's inventory
[/list]
- new item crate and locker
[list]
[*]Cost: 120 Iron
[*]Mass 50
[*]Listed under Props>Cargo
[*]Can store up to 8 items/weapons
[/list]
- added several new drones:

Disruptor drone
[list]
[*]Has a chance to spawn if Faction Influence for S3 is higher than 2000 in a system, instead of a combat drone.
[*]Has, in addition to it's usual cannon, a hacking suite, and will hack random ship's systems.
[/list]
Missile drone
[list]
[*]Has a chance to spawn if Faction Influence for S3 is higher than 3000 in a system, instead of a combat drone.
[*]Has missile pods, and will fire missiles at it's target.
[/list]
Anti Warp drone
[list]
[*]Has a chance to spawn if Faction Influence for S3 is higher than 4000 in a system, instead of a combat drone.
[*]Has, in addition to it's usual cannon, a warp disruptor on board
[/list]
- lights now operate through a global user group instead of a user group per light

- when upgrading a ship, removed devices are now saved to a list. Adding a new device will grab a device from that list before creating a new one, meaning devices can be moved while retaining its state

- when loading a bluepring while upgrading a ship, the editor will now search for devices with of the same type on the same location with the same rotation and replace the device of the blueprint with the one being upgraded. (meaning the shipeditor wil attempt to retain devices's state of similar blueprints while loding during upgrading)
 
[h1]GRAPHICS[/h1]
 
- drones now show a little effect when they are in warp.

- fixed bug where the crate mesh was inversed on the dropbox animation
 
[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- fixed bug where deleting a system on a save with capitals in the name would crash
 
- fixed a desync issue in the Drone Warp AI

- fixed bug where generated stations would spawn with negative values

- fixed bug where all stations would spawn when rebuilding

- removed deuterium from scanner

- optimized collision alert

- fixed warp sounds location

- loan timers are now saved
 
[h1]NOTES[/h1]

- servers need to be updated and restarted. No rebuilding required.

notes.title: Sales 101 - Interstellar Rift Development Update 101
notes.content:
[b][i]Starfaring entrepreneurs your time is now! With update 0.1.48 we are adding in player stores allowing you to set up your business empire to buy and sell goods![/i][/b]

To do this you will find the new player stores in the editor. Place these on a ship and you can set them to sell or buy any item or resource. You will need to assign cargo pads so your store will have a pad to place your bought items/resources, or where it takes the items from to sell. Each store unit comes with two stalls allowing you to sell two different items/resources per store unit. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/2cd91ce4bb2e350f19c364339866a75ce2331a65.png[/img]

This patch also includes a number of new drones which have been added to the Sentinel Security Systems fleet, ready to engage anyone who commits an offense. First up we have the hacking drones, this drone will hack a random ship system when its in range. These will only spawn in systems with a S3 rating over 2000.
Next we have the Missile drone, these drones attack you with missiles. These will spawn in a system with an S3 rating above 3000.
And lastly we have the Interdictor drone, these drones will stop you going to warp while you are within range of them. These will only spawn in system with an S3 rating of 4000.
This about covers the new security drones. But there is one new drone variant which is not as law abiding. The pirate drone is a small scrappy looking drone which attacks everything. Except anything or anyone affiliated with the Drifters. 

We’ve also added in a new set of item lockers which accept all of the items. So unlike the wall locker and the weapons rack you can place everything with the exception of resources in here. They come in two varieties for now, a crate, and a more traditional locker that also includes two offset versions to allow more than one to be placed on a tile. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/67e1e82249eb9111e7459bfca2606a4ed374ca76.png[/img]

We’ve also made a few changes to the modify ship mode. When you delete a device from your ship and place it somewhere else. It will now remember what its status was before you deleted it. The same thing works when you load in a blueprint. It will try to keep as many devices with their current status intact even when placed in different locations.

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better, please leave it [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/0/1471968797464391585/]here[/url]. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join [url=https://discord.gg/eMmVAgs]here![/url] 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/363360/announcements/detail/1447198999527525626]Link to patch notes[/url]

notes.title: Setting up shop! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 100 (woohoo!)
notes.content:
[b]This experimental update will add in player run stores, these can be placed on stations and ships and will allow players to buy and sell goods from other players even when those players are offline.[/b]

Stores are supplied by assigned cargo pads. If you have a buy and sell order on those pads the resources that are bought and sold will both go to the same set of assigned pads. In addition trade drones will also interact with player stores and sell and buy goods from them. 

In addition there are also a couple of new drones such as the hacking drone, missile drone and the disruptor drone, these drones spawn based on the faction influence in a system. The higher the S3 influence the more of these special drones will spawn.

There will also be pirate drones that roam the space ways, these drones will attack on sight except when you’re a drifter. Theses drones will also attack random stations.

For all the details see the patch notes,

please leave your feedback about this patch there:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1471967615872467908/

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.content:

- added logicorp tool store
[list]
[*]provides a place to buy and sell tools and weapons
[*]added to all starter stations, logicorp printing station and logicorp chemplant

[*]go on a 300 sec countdown after being called

[*]can be loaded into any ammunition loader
[/list]

[*]Salvaged from Skrill hunters
[/list]

- zoom key is now rebindable
 
[h1]GRAPHICS[/h1]
 
- tweaked glass materials
 
[h1]BALANCING[/h1]

- ships are now invulnerable for 30 seconds after moving through a rift

- optimized system loading

notes.title: Coming to a LogiStore near you! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 099
notes.content:
[b]Prime time! After a few nasty speed bumps we are ready to push this update to live! This week we are bringing rescue drones, the long awaited tool store and a series of much needed optimizations.[/b]

First off the tool store will now let you buy and sell items such as plasma pistols, ammunition, upgrade cartridges and more. These tool stores will be found on all of the starter stations with more stations to follow in the near future. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/1122b269ff50b86ad1b04b9dd1e55c7c33b5a0c8.png[/img]

Next we have the delivery drones. These little buggers can be summoned from the “Services” menu on the GRIP to bring you fuel and to repair your ship if you are in trouble. That said these services do not come cheap. You will be paying a premium sum of U-nits for the fuel and repairs. These drones should make it a little easier for new players learning the game to not get stranded. Note that rescue drones will first have to find the fuel and resources before they will travel to help you so it make take some time before they arrive.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/a38ba7f0d033c63ef80a0b068b4569a4140a0242.png[/img]

And lastly, in the previous update we overhauled the space generation particularly when it came to asteroids, this caused the server save files to become massive and would result in very long loading times when using rifts to travel to other star systems. We’ve optimised this process and rift travel times should now be significantly less than they were before. In addition we’ve added a brief period of invulnerability to ships when leaving a rift so even if you exit the rift in the middle of a skrill swarm you will have about 30 seconds to react.

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join [url=https://discord.gg/eMmVAgs]here![/url] 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: We’re going to the hardware store! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 098
notes.content:
[b]Experiment time! This week we are adding in rescue drones which can be summoned by sending out a distress call from the grip. This way players who run out of fuel or get severely damaged can call for help.[/b]

Do note that refueling with the rescue drones and repair costs come at a premium.

We’re also introducing the tool store so you can now buy and sell items from your tool inventory such as cartridges and guns. 

In addition there is also ion ammo which does extra damage to shields. To fire ion ammo simply insert the crate into the ammo loader and all guns in the same group as this ammo loader will fire the ion ammo. As always we also have a bunch of bug fixes, and other small tweaks and balances.

For the full patch notes, click right here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/0/1458455461478668716/

Please leave your feedback about this patch there.

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you star side!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: A fashion statement - Interstellar Rift Development Update 097
notes.content:
[b]It's here! After a rather long period on the experimental branch the great big universe update is ready for prime time! Adding in character customization, a rework of the universe generation, and NPC drones which influence the in game economy! [/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/ad2265062b120ed07d5e52683fc4e7e8eb5e5e84.png[/img]

First up character customization! From now on you will be able to customize your character from the face, to the hair, bodysuit and the armor! You will be able to choose from several faces for both genders as well as hairstyles. And all can be completely customized with several color options for each. The armor items are craft-able in the 3D Printer, and can be placed in weapon racks. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/095fd87eb27a62b23dd87ad625acd22899ee28cc.png[/img]

We’ve also spend a significant amount of time in completely overhauling how space generation works, from now on, generated stations will be permanent they will not de-spawn and the types of stations that do spawn will be based on the faction influence in the star system. So the higher the influence of one faction in a solar system the more stations aligned with that faction will spawn. We are also working on a new system that will allow players to control what stations are in a system, and help construct new ones. Stay tuned for more on this system over the coming updates.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/26c2ca75502e707f608f97195cc454b9a2716bab.png[/img]

In addition asteroids will now spawn in gigantic belts around certain planets and around a star system. This means that you will no longer be able to park your ship in an asteroid belt and mine any resource indefinitely. Asteroids will deplete from your current location, but don't worry, there's no chance of running out of asteroids to mine! This means that it will take more effort to find rare resources. Players will need to use their sensors in order to prospect for the resources that they are looking for.

In addition, stations now no longer generate resources out of the blue, instead supply and demand is now met by cargo and mining drones which will mine the resources inside the star system and then supply space station stores with these resources. Stations equipped with a refinery will convert a percentage of these raw resources into refined resources. Then trade drones will ferry these resources between the other stations in the system based on the trade prices and demand of these stations. As a result players who enjoy trading resources will have compete with these drones.

In a future update these trade and mining drones will also interact with player owned stores resulting a more stable player driven economy.

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. You can also join us on our public discord  [url=https://discord.gg/M4btnDA]here[/url] , feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!


Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

You will be able to choose from several faces for both genders as well as hairstyles. And all can be completely customized with several color options for each. The armor items are craft-able in the 3D Printer, and can be placed in weapon racks.

We’ve also spend a significant amount of time in completely overhauling how space generation works, from now on, generated stations will be permanent they will not de-spawn and the types of stations that do spawn will be based on the faction influence in the star system. So the higher the influence of one faction in a solar system the more stations aligned with that faction will spawn. We are also working on a new system that will allow players to control what stations are in a system, and help construct new ones. Stay tuned for more on this system over the coming updates.

In addition asteroids will now spawn in gigantic belts around certain planets and around a star system. This means that you will no longer be able to park your ship in an asteroid belt and mine any resource indefinitely. Asteroids will deplete from your current location, but don't worry, there's no chance of running out of asteroids to mine! This means that it will take more effort to find rare resources. Players will need to use their sensors in order to prospect for the resources that they are looking for.

In addition, stations now no longer generate resources out of the blue, instead supply and demand is now met by cargo and mining drones which will mine the resources inside the star system and then supply space station stores with these resources. Stations equipped with a refinery will convert a percentage of these raw resources into refined resources. Then trade drones will ferry these resources between the other stations in the system based on the trade prices and demand of these stations. As a result players who enjoy trading resources will have compete with these drones.
In a future update these trade and mining drones will also interact with player owned stores resulting a more stable player driven economy.

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift ALPHA 0.1.46
notes.content:
[h1]FUNCTIONALITIES[/h1]

--- Armour ---

- added new armour system 

- added new player armour pieces
[list]
[*]Helmet  - costs: 10 Platinum + 50 Carbon + 50 Silicon - (Provides 10 Armour)
[*]Chest - costs: 10 Platinum + 50 Carbon + 50 Stee - (Provides 15 Armour)
[*]Legs - costs: 10 Platinum + 50 Carbon - (Provides 10 Armour)
[*]Arm L - costs: 10 Platinum + 50 Carbon - (Provides 5 Armour)
[*]Arm R - costs: 10 Platinum + 50 Carbon - (Provides 5 Armour)
[*]Feet - costs: 10 Platinum + 50 Carbon - (Provides 5 Armour)
[/list]

- armour pieces can be created in the 3d Printer

- armour pieces be placed in weapon racks

- added new player equipment screen in GRIP under Status > Equipment

- added light to helmet

- helmet visor is now colorable and transparent

--- Solar systems --- 

- Mineable asteroids now spawn mainly in planetary rings (just fly into them or follow the markers)

- Resource rarity is determined by system resource abundancies

- Added initial spawn delays for events, (10 to 20 minutes for trade/mining drones, 1 to 2 hours for stations)

- new stations added to world gen
[list]
[*]S3 - Weapons Production Plant
[*]S3 - Refinery Outpost
[/list]

--- Characters --- 

- added face customization mode
[list]
[*]adds 3 new faces for each gender
[*]adds 6 new hairstyles
[/list]

- added ability to remove helmet

--- Drones --- 

- added Mining Drones
[list]
[*]will find stations with stores, and look up the prices of mineable resources
[*]will gather mineable resources from asteroids
[*]when their cargo hold is full they will sell to the stations
[*]will repeat until every station has their demands filled
[*]has a chance of being escorted by a maximum of two combat drones
[*]will drop a percentage of their cargo as debris and crates on destroy
[/list]

- added Trade Drones
[list]
[*]will find stations with stores, and look for the best deals with other stations
[*]will buy resources from stations
[*]will fly to other stations to sell it's goods
[*]has a chance of being escorted by a maximum of two combat drones
[*]will drop a percentage of their cargo as debris and crates on destroy
[/list]

--- Resource scanners --- 

- adjusted resource scanners
[list]
[*]scanners will now turn green per segment when an asteroid containing selected resource is in mining range
[/list]

- added hotkey to Cockpit UI to switch between scanners and flight UI (Default key: V)

--- Stores --- 

- store pricing is now calculated based on supply and demand

- store demand increases when a resource is bought (decreasing demand of all other resources)

- store now refine resources when no players are on the ship for an hour

- stores now have a minimum demand of 5 crates per resource instead of 1

--- Misc --- 

- moved player camera up by 5 centimeters so it aligns with the characters eyes

- add outer deadzone option to options menu

- when targetting an entity in shipcontrol, target is set for every weapon group

- gravitational anchor now respects device on/off state

- gravitational anchor now drops the ship out of warp

- 0 crates should no longer be added to your inventory when picking them up

- ammo tank now auto-inserts when placing a crate

- life support now auto-inserts when placing a crate

- added a zoom function, by default it is bound to middle mouse button. 

- added secondary FOV slider to control zoom level

- moved FOV slider from Graphics Options to Game Options

- keybindings can now also use mouse buttons

[h1]GRAPHICS[/h1]

- added additional options to the player screen in main menu
[list]
[*]added ability to colorize the character's body and armour pieces
[/list]

- added new space dust graphics

- added new graphics for skrill debris

[h1]BALANCING[/h1]

- changed Hydrogen consumption of generators
[list]
[*]Generator TI - from 0.125 / tick to 0.025 / tick
[*]Generator TII - from 0.1 / tick to 0.02 / tick
[/list]

- changed range of several devices:
[list]
[*]Extractor - from 500m to 1000m
[*]Protection Terminal - from 500m to 1000m
[*]Cargo Teleporter - from 500m to 1000m
[*]Ship Construction terminal - from 500m to 1000m
[*]HPX Service Depot - from 500m to 1000m
[*]GT Trade Terminals - from 500m to 1000m
[/list]

- skrill check mass before deciding to ram or shoot at a ship

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- fixed bug where network disconnect timeout would not return the player to the main menu

- fixed resource scanner button label

- fixed bug where ship upgrade would not take resources in some buffers into account such as ammo tank, oxygen generator, refinery and stripminer

- hydrogen tank hover now shows hydrogen tank contents when hydrogen is selected in your inventory

- fixed bug where hydrogen would dupe when teleporting into an almost full hydrogen tank

- thrusters now display particles when strafing

- fixed crash in defense drone UI

- fixed crash in ship editor device edit mode

- fixed bug where molecular assembler would show as in-use when it actually isn't

- fixed crash on selecting invalid item in inventory

- fixed crash in holo table

- toggling shadows does not restart the game anymore

- reputation is now handled correctly for point defense drones

- fixed bug where cross-system teleport from the admin menu (F8) would not work correctly and kill the player

- fixed some bugs where loading a rebuilt save would not work correctly

- fixed bug where bottom of life support piston did not show

- some windows no longer suggest they have devices

- fixed bug where ship validator would alter device state differently based on whether or not it has validated once before

- fixed LogiCorp printing station belonging to HydroPEX for some reason

- fixed crash in 3d printer when two or more people would pick up an item in the same frame

- fixed rare crash in cargo pad

- fixed bug where the player could get stuck in exterior view if you switch to it while exiting the cockpit

- fixed possible crash on depositing crate

- fixed hacking terminal hover text using the wrong localization ID

- fixed bug where large shield generator would stop generating past 5000 shield points

- fixed crash when user's FOV was set between 60 and 69

[h1]NOTES[/h1]

- due to the extreme amount of changes in this patch, older saves will have to be rebuilt using option 3 in your F8 Admin menu. (Or type "rebuildServer 2" in the server's console)

notes.title: More head space - Interstellar Rift Development Update 096
notes.content:
[b]Because our new update is fairly large, we have decided to keep it on the experimental branch a little longer while we finish up most of its features![/b]

So for a change we have pushed another version to the experimental branch that includes more character customization, and more changes to the world generation, and how the new drones influence its economy. 

New in this patch are heads and hair styles for characters, the ability to take your helmet off, and a more varied way of spawning the asteroid rings. 

More details can be found in the patch notes:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/2592234299574541475/

Please also leave your feedback about this patch there.

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you star side!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: A Whole new world! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 095
notes.content:
[b]Today we release one of the biggest change to universe generation in Interstellar Rift to date. On the experimental branch stations will be in permanent locations all of which are visible from the cockpit and the holo- table. These stations will spawn based on the faction influence in the system.[/b]

In addition Mining, trade and the general in game economy is going to have a major update! Asteroids now spawn in belts and planetary rings, and they do not re-spawn. Which means that you will no longer be able to sit in one spot to mine resources. In addition stations will no longer generate their own resources every hour, from now on each system is supplied by mining and trade drones. Mining drones will mine resources and trade drones buy resources from one station and sell it to another. This should cause some major changes to trade prices across the galaxy making resource trading more interesting across the board.

And last but not least, the first phase of character customization is here. You will now be able to set the colors of your characters suit as well as equip armor pieces to your character. In this first phase we will have just one set of armor but in the near future we will add several armor sets that you can mix and match with each other and each will have its own stats so that you can make your character exactly like you want!

Note that over the coming week we will be modifying spawn rates, and other values to make this new system more balanced and fun to play with.

A new experimental thread with patch notes can be found here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/2592234299546140499/

Please leave your feedback about this patch there.

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you star side!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift ALPHA 0.1.45
notes.content:
[h1]FUNCTIONALITIES[/h1]

- added Automated Cargo Transfer Relay (ACTR)
[list]
[*]can teleport cargo from and to multiple devices
[*]a single ACTR can only be set to a single resource or item (multiple ACTRs will be needed to transport multiple resource types)
[*]requires at least one heatsink to operate
[*]will start to damage itself when run without heatsinks
[*]can teleport to all cargo accepting and/or supplying devices
[*]can teleport to all tool/weapon accepting and/or supplying devices except other ACTRs
[*]costs: 400 Aluminium, 250 Steel, 250 Silicon, 125 Copper, 200 lead
[*]has a power buffer of 120,000
[*]one teleport requires 40,000 power
[/list]

- Items on cargo pads can now also be retrieved by clicking their icon on the cargo pad's screen

- added new particle effects to combat drones

- exit to menu key (F10) is now rebindable

[h1]GRAPHICS[/h1]

- optimized the rendering of inactive screens

- added a tiny bit of ambient lighting to the game to make it a bit brighter

- fixed bug where blue tables shader would glitch on certain Nvidia driver versions

[h1]BALANCING[/h1]

- Skrill are now more inclined to use bullets instead of ramming for lower mass targets

- Changed Heatsink costs
[list]
[*]TI Heatsink: 100 Aluminium, 10 Deuterium
[*]TII Heatsink: 100 Aluminium, 5 Beryllium, 20 Deuterium
[*]TIII Heatsink: 100 Aluminium, 10 Beryllium, 40 Deuterium
[/list]

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- fixed bug where drones wouldnt warp towards astroid fields if an player was nearby

- game no longer tries to request ghost clients every frame when game is frozen

- fixing bug where aliens did not target defense drones
 
- player data is now saved when a ship is stored instead of waiting for server save

- fixed repair beam completed sound

[h1]NOTES[/h1]

- servers should be updated and restarted, no rebuilds required

notes.title: Fiddling with automation - Interstellar Rift Development Update 094
notes.content:
[b]The second part of industry automation is now ready for prime time! This week we are introducing the Automated Cargo Teleportation Relay or A.C.T.R. for short. This device will allow you to automatically teleport cargo from one device to another. This will allow players to set up their own automated assembly lines![/b]
 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/2857c4cc939f75c4c29d53529c3a1b8645ff00fa.png[/img]

ACTRs generate heat in a similar way to the nuclear reactor so in keeping with that the ACTRs require heatsinks in order to function properly. Using the ACTR players will be able to teleport items and cargo crates from one or multiple devices to one or multiple destinations. These devices can only teleport one resource at a time. So in order to set up a fully realised assembly line players will need to use multiple ACTRs combined with mining equipment refineries and production equipment.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/e5e3c45dccb26c905e1b5a5b7686e4965c82cc94.png[/img]
 
As a balancing measure we’ve also changed the costs of heat sinks, since they are mainly used in more advanced equipment they now cost rarer resources and more of them. Since the heat sinks are also used by the nuclear reactor this will also be a slight nerf to the nuclear reactor as you will require more resources to build the heat sinks for them.
 
Today we are also releasing the Interstellar Rift soundtrack, composed by Curtis Schweitzer and produced by The Otherworld Agency! Enjoy!
 
You can buy the soundtrack now! Right here: 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/648690/Interstellar_Rift__Official_Sound_Track/ 
As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join [url=https://discord.gg/M4btnDA]here![/url] Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion.
 
Thank you all for playing and see you starside!
 
-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift ALPHA 0.1.44
notes.content:
[h1]FUNCTIONALITIES[/h1]

- added Sentinel Security Desk
[list]
[*]manned by Keith the Security Droid
[*]can be found on all starter stations (except the Black Pit), static S3 Stations, and the Vaultron Galactic Bank
[*]can be used by players to hire security drones for 175k per drone per hour (with a discount if more are hired for longer), which results in the player gaining the same protection
[/list]

- added NPC Drones
[list]
[*]will warp in to protect stations against damage or hacking
[*]will attack Skrill
[*]will attack player ships if wanted level is greater than 0
[*]will try to fly in formation if there's enough of them
[*]capable of warping
[*]incapable of rifting
[/list]

- reworked no firing zones around stations
[list]
[*]No firing zones are now enforced by drones, in addition to the station's stationary defense turrets
[*]firing any type of weapon within no firing zones will result in an increase in wanted level (with just one shot meaning that you'll only be wanted for a few seconds)
[*]no firing zones are now displayed on the top screen of the cockpit interface, next to the system name
[*]no firing zones are currently only located around the starter stations
[/list]

- added wanted mechanism
[list]
[*]wanted level is bound to a ship, not the player
[*]wanted level is increased when firing at or hacking a neutral station/ship/drone
[*]max wanted level is 5
[*]if player is on a ship that is wanted, a counter will display in the top right corner of the screen, indicating current wanted level
[*]wanted level will slowly decrease over time (a wanted level of 5 will decrease to 0 in approximately 5 minutes)
[/list]

- added new protection status screen to GRIP (located under Status > Protection status)

- client will now automatically reconnect if a critical desync is detected

- added chat messages when players get reconnected for desyncs

- increased range of small teleporter to 1000 instead of 500

- added social media buttons to main menu

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- added check if saving succeeds before writing to the database

- some better handling when systems fail to load

- fixed bug where point defense drone AI would crash on factionless targets

- fixed bug where ghost clients would not close themselves down after they crashed or desynced

- players are now actually disconnected when removed from player manager

- fixed crash in repairgun

- fixed crash while upgrading ship

- fixed several crashes in character controller

- fixed crash in sensors screen

[h1]NOTES[/h1]

- For older saves, world will have to be rebuilt with the second rebuild option in the F8 menu (or "rebuildServer 1" in server console)

notes.title: Droning on! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 092
notes.content:
[b]Update time! This week we are pushing the new Sentinel Security Systems security drones into the live servers! [/b]

These new drones will be patrolling all faction stations except those of the drifters. The security drones will from now on be enforcing the no fire zones, which means that your weapons will no longer be locked when you are near one of the starter stations. Which brings us to the wanted level, when a player violates a no fire zone, attacks a protected station or player the player will receive a wanted level which determines how the security drones will respond to you. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/cc8abc2fb161f97e28c2fb9c7740d2585a36b378.png[/img]

Your wanted level ranges from 0 stars to 5 stars and will decay slowly over time. If you fight back against the security drones your wanted level will increase, however if you stop attacking or damaging the drones your wanted level will decrease. When you’re at max wanted level it will take roughly 5 minutes to completely decay. Oh and these drones can chase you through warp so good luck :)
 
The security drones can also be hired to protect your ships and stations, on the major faction stations you will find a new sentinel security systems service desk manned by Keith the droid.
Here you can hire a up to 9 drones to come and protect you for up to 72 hours for a nominal fee.

When you are attacked these drones will warp in and destroy any threat that was made against you.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/9f42315b4e3821dd038a7df6e8ccbae0a3e5239b.png[/img]
 
In addition we have fired a new volley in the fight against desyncs. While it is not a true fix but more a stopgap to prevent major issues which result from desyncs. The game will now automatically reconnect you when you’re desyncing, however this should not take nearly as long as when you’re connecting to a server normally. And when the entire server is desyncing and a reconnect doesn't fix it. It will automatically reload the server save and reconnect everyone.
 
As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better.
 
Thank you all for playing and see you starside!
 
-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: A Protection racket! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 091
notes.content:
[b]Experiment time! This time we are introducing new protection combat drones that will be patrolling starter stations. [/b]

This means that the no fire zone around the starter stations will no longer prevent you from shooting, however it does mean that if you violate the no fire zone by firing inside of it, you will be met with a response in kind from the local defense drones. If there are no drones in the local area they will warp in from around the system, and they can chase anyone who warps away by entering warp themselves. 

Additionally the drones can also be hired by players to protect their ships for a limited time. However this protection doesn't come cheap. You can acquire this temporary protected status by going to one of the new S3 Ship protection service desks found in most major stations.

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide it will only help us make the game better. A new experimental thread can be found here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1291816569118355664/
 
Please leave your feedback about this patch there.

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

[i]Thank you all for playing and see you starside![/i]

-The Split Polygon Team
