notes.title: Tabula Rasa – Interstellar rift development update 052
notes.content:
[i]Since we started development of Interstellar Rift we have had a bit of a problem with the game’s first impression. We spawn you on an unknown station and then we left you to your fate in the hopes that you’d figure out what you were supposed to do. With patch 0.1.19 we hope to start to remedy that. Today when you join a server or start a game, you will be asked what you would like your starting role to be.[/i]

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/IR-2016-03-22-22-08-23-54-1024x576.png[/img]

We have given you 4 options that we feel would best represent what you will be doing. When picking one of these roles you will be given access to starting resources and the option of purchasing a starting ship at the Store-o-Tron.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/IR-2016-03-22-22-08-58-89-1024x576.png[/img]

The first of these options is to ally yourself with the galactic trade network. You have likely seen the trade kiosks on stations in the past. This organization prides itself on commerce. The acquisition of goods and commodities to trade and sell on one of the many galactic trade hubs. When joining the galactic trade network you will be given access to some resources and a cargo hauling vessel with which you can start on your mercantile journeys. Your journey will begin on a GT trade hub

The second option is to join the ranks of the Hurles co. miners. Hurles co is massive conglomerate whose many endeavours can’t have escaped your notice in the world of Interstellar Rift. By joining Hurles co. you will gain access to a small mining vessel as well as some starting resources and money. Your journey will begin on a Hurles co. Industrial complex.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/IR-2016-03-22-22-06-11-72-1024x576.jpg[/img]

The third option is to join the proud and mighty ranks of the Sentinel Security Systems Corporation. This weapons manufacturer and private military force provides security and local law enforcement in the vast reaches of space. By joining Sentinel Security Systems you will gain access to a small fighter some money and starting resources. Your journey will begin onboard Fort Bragg

And last but not least the fourth option is that of the Drifters. This lawless faction is not so much a faction as it is a collection of free spirited individuals that would rather do as they please than to be locked to a single role. Choosing this faction will give you a set of resources and access to a ship construction terminal. Your journey will begin onboard the Black Pit station.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/IR-2016-03-22-22-06-11-73-1024x576.jpg[/img]

In addition to the new starting locations we also made some changes to the ship movement system. We have completely overhauled the way we do ship movement in preparation for our upcoming ship AI. However that said we need your input. Because our new system is extremely physics driven there are going to be several iterations to get it to a point where the flight model feels enjoyable so please let us know what you think of this new ship movement and feel free to share any suggestions that you feel would improve the way ships handle.

An added bonus of this new system is that we can now display how fast a ship will go in the editor, as well as its turn rate. Allowing you greater control over fine tuning your ship designs.

Another feature we’ve added that has been a long time coming is the ability to respawn on nearby friendly ships and stations. Before you were only able to respawn on your own ship or the starter station. Now if you have friends nearby like someone in your crew or fleet you will be given the option to spawn there as well. Ofcourse these ships do need to have a molecular printer onboard in order to allow you to respawn. 

Well that’s it for this week, we hope you enjoy this new update and as always please let us know what you think on our forums facebook or twitter. And we will be back in two weeks with another Interstellar Rift update. We’ve got some big things in the pipeline so stay tuned!

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift ALPHA 0.1.18
notes.content:
[h1]FUNCTIONALITIES[/h1]

- added hacking terminal to game and editor, can be found under prop edit mode > systems
	with these terminals you can hack:
[list]
		[*][b]access[/b] 			- gives temporary access to all teleporters and doors on a ship
		[*][b]engines[/b] 		- temporarily disables all engines
		[*][b]thrusters[/b]		- temporarily disables all thrusters
		[*][b]generators[/b] 		- temporarily disables all power generators
		[*][b]weapons[/b] 		- temporarily disables all weapon systems
		[*][b]shields[/b] 		- temporarily disables all shields
		[*][b]life support[/b] 	- temporarily disables all life support systems
	[/list]
- players will receive a message on their hud when a hack is initialized
	hacking terminals can be used to both hack into other ships or defend your ship from incoming hackers
	
- hacking effects reputation

- added hacking chipsets, can be found on stations in lockers and crafted with a 3D printer
[list]
	[*]chipsets require 10 gold, 10 silicon and either 10 iridium for draining firewalls or 10 platinum for repairing and boosting firewalls

		chipsets can have the following stats:
 
[list]
		[*][b]break firewall[/b]				- applies a set drain rate on a firewall 
		[*][b]break firewall[/b] percentage 	- drains a percentage of the firewall per tick (faster when the firewall is stronger)
		[*][b]break firewall pulse[/b] 		- drains a set amount of firewall hitpoints after a set amount of ticks
		
		[*][b]repair firewall[/b] 			- applies a set regeneration rate to a firewall
		[*][b]repair firewall percentage[/b] 	- applies a percentage based regeneration rate on a firewall (faster when the firewall is stronger)
		[*][b]repair firewall pulse[/b] 		- applies a set amount of firewall hitpoints after a set amount of ticks
		
		[*][b]repair hacked system[/b]		- applies a set regeneration rate to a hacked firewall
[/list]
	[/list]
- added crews, for short term co-op play
	[list]
[*]players can create a crew, and invite other players to their crew
	the crew has a shared vault
	only the creator can kick people out of a crew and disband the crew
	everyone can invite other people into the crew
	if someone is offline for more than 5 minutes he/she gets kicked out of the crew
[/list]	
- shared vaults
[list]
	[*]vaults can now be shared between players that are in the same crew, or in the same fleet with the proper permissions
[/list]
- item support in vaults, chipsets and cartridges can now be stored in the vault, (vault matches inventory state)

- ship editor terminals can now be used to build ships from the fleet and crew vault. 

- updated advanced statistics screen. now displays much more information such as:
[list]
	[*]total available generation rate
	[*]solar power generation rate
	[*]hydrogen power generation rate 
	[*]battery output rate
	[*]capacitor output rate
	[*]total current drain rate
	[*]total stored power
	[/list]
- added anonymous data gathering, this option is on by default but can be disabled in the options menu
	we used this feature to gather stats about player activity and game stability, to get a better insight in how to improve the game
	
- added hacking drone
	[list]
[*]can be found in some asteroid fields together with combat drones, will initiate hacks on random systems when players get close[/list]
	
- by default players can now only teleport to ships they made. other players now need to receive proper permissions to board. 
	[list][*]if your diplomatic standing with factions is hostile you will not be able to board their stations anymore
	if your diplomatic standing with factions is very good some areas on stations will now unlock[/list]

- power system now has a different preference order, now: solar > hydrogen > stored > capacitor, instead of solar > stored/capacitor > hydrogen

- turret now also shows max ammo

- increased the pick up range for crates 

- search functionality added to player and ship list in the admin menu (F8)
	
[h1]GRAPHICS[/h1]

- vault now has green pulsing indicators and a new screen inside the input hatch

- when a connection is being established or when your are being hacked messages will now display in your hud

[h1]BUGFIXES[/h1]

- faction drones can no longer do friendly fire damage

- drones turret now once again visually aims at target

- insert cartridge animation no longer plays when the device is full and players try to insert more

- delete message button now works in the main message centre screen

- negative stats should no longer linger when a cartridge breaks

[h1]NOTES[/h1]

- servers need to be updated and rebuilt, using the F8 admin menu

notes.title: Hack your way through – Interstellar Rift development Update 051
notes.content:
Time for another Interstellar Rift update, This time we’ve included a highly requested feature, shared vaults. For a long time you guys have been requesting more co-op features when it comes to the collection of resources. Well from now on you will be able to share a vault inventory with your fleet and crew mates. You’ll notice a new button on the vault screen called “personal” If you’re in a fleet or crew you will be able to click this button and switch to the fleet/crew vault. Storing resources or items in here will make them available to everyone in your crew/fleet that has vault permissions. Vault permissions can be given by any member of the fleet which has the appropriate permissions to do so. With this functionality we also updated the ship construction terminal, on the top screen in the upper right you can now find a button that allows switching between which vault you want to construct your ship from.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/IR-2016-03-09-18-32-38-06.png[/img]
[i]Vaults now have modes[/i]

But wait there’s more, as mentioned above we’ve also added in the ability to form crews. These small crew groups will allow you to form a short co-op group with other players. You will also have access to the crew vault so you can easily gather resources together to build a ship.

In addition to the shared vaults we have also added in a new cyber warfare mechanic. In the ship editor you’ll find the new cyber warfare suite. This device is the centre of both your ship’s defensive and offensive capabilities.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/IR-2016-03-09-18-03-58-23.png[/img]
[i]A new hacking drone with several point defense drones[/i]

Using specialised chipsets which you will be able to find and craft you can assault ships and stations by reducing their engine output. Unlocking their teleporters and more. However you will also be able to sacrifice offensive capabilities to bolster your own firewall. This will make it more difficult for attackers to gain access to your ship’s systems and reduce or disable their effectiveness. However using these hacking chipsets will slowly consume them, and once the cartridge break you will no longer be able to use it.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/IR-2016-03-09-18-22-54-12.png[/img]
[i]The new hacking chipsets[/i]

We have also reworked a lot of the permission mechanics, you now need appropriate diplomatic standing with several factions to use their stations and facilities. This works within a station as well, where certain areas are no longer accessible unless you have a good reputation.

Teleporters now by default only grant access to the owner of a ship. If you want to give other people access to your ship you can either give them permission individually or have them join your crew or fleet for easy access. Onboard systems still require special permission to use however.   

Additionally, we have reworked some of the GUI’s concerning power usage. You can now track the power usage of your ship in real time.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/IR-2016-03-09-18-25-33-15.png[/img]
[i]Reworked Power Graphs[/i]

Finally, we’ve also added a new weapon to our arsenal in the ongoing war on bugs. We now have the ability to log bugs and crashes automatically. This will allow us to track when there are crashes and it will hopefully make it easier for us to find their cause. This data is gathered anonymously but if you do not wish to be tracked you can turn this function off in the options menu.

We hope you enjoy this new patch and as always, if you would like to know more or would like sneak previews of upcoming features and patches please follow us on Twitter, Facebook and our own and Steam forums.

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift ALPHA 0.1.17
notes.content:
[h1]FUNCTIONALITY[/h1]

combat mode, players can now activate/deactivate their weapons
[list][*]when combat mode is on, weapons use a lot more power, (10 per tick per weapon)
[*]when combat mode is off, weapons do not use any power
[*]default key “H”
[/list]
reputation with factions
[list][*]you can gain and lose reputation with factions, Hurles Co, VaulTron, Logicorp, HydroPEX and Sentinel Security Systems
[*]having a friendly reputation will give you trade bonuses with the company
[*]being unfriendly or hostile with a faction will make them attack you
[*]reputation can be negatively affected by attacking a ship, station or defense drone of a faction 
[*]reputation can be positively affected by trading with a faction, or repairing your ship on a station that belongs to a faction, or by attacking a competing faction 
[*]you can pay a bounty to reduce your negative standings
[/list]
added multi lined text edit fields to the game
Hurles co now has small mining station that can be found throughout the galaxy
Logicorp now has a 3D printing facility that can be found in the galaxy
some of these stations are guarded by drones that will react to your diplomatic standing
pressing “C” or center camera in the editor now also resets the zoom level

[h1]BALANCE[/h1]

cartridges have been rebalanced
[list][*]cartridges now have a lifespan of between 2 and 4 hours
[*]there will now only be 1 positive and 1 negative effect on a single cartridge
[*]the positive effects of a cartridge have been greatly improved, some can go up to 50% bonus 
[*]cartridges now have a minimum positive bonus of 5%
[/list]
drone health increased from 200 to 800 
debris lifetime increased from 1 minute to 5 minutes

[h1]GRAPHICS[/h1]

weapon screen now indicates how many weapons are ready to fire

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

fixed a bug where the Omni tool would not work as intended
fixed a bug where players could place engines on the same location as the class 2 Ion engine
players are now allowed to change the creator name of fleet
in the editor, ceiling lights now show on the floor below 
you can now use a flashlight with the default hotkey “F” when shadows are turned off 
fixed a bug where you could click through the resolution select drop down list in the options menu
fixed a bug where the game would crash if the exit to menu option was used from the menu on several devices (Life Support Systems, Helm Terminal)

[h1]BEHIND THE SCENES STUFF[/h1]

a lot of work done on hacking mechanics
a lot of work done on enemy AI and physically correct thruster output
fixed forum, we migrated the server and broke some forum functionalities in the process, our apologies for the inconvenience

[h1]NOTES[/h1]

servers need to be updated and rebuilt with the rebuild tool in the F8 admin menu

notes.title: Your reputation precedes you - Interstellar Rift development Update 050
notes.content:
This week we have added combat mode to the game, this means that you can now turn your weapon systems on and off in the cockpit. You can also do this with “H” default. When out of combat mode the ship weapons will not use any power. But while they are active they will use a lot more power than usual. This will lead to more diverse gameplay and decision making with creating ships.

Combat mode is also partially added to avoid unnecessary conflict after an accidental weapon discharge. Because this update brings part two of our reputation, factions and fleet mechanics:

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/02/IR-2016-02-23-17-42-36-43.png[/img]
[i]a Hurles co mining outpost with neutral reputation[/i]

You can now gain reputation with factions, there are currently 5 factions in the game:
[list]
[*]Hurles Co.
[*]HydroPEX
[*]LogiCorp
[*]Sentinel Security Systems
[*]VaulTron
[/list]
[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/02/IR-2016-02-23-18-13-02-12.png[/img]
[i]a player with negative reputation[/i]

We felt this was a necessary change to make the use of cartridges more viable. For example in a combat scenario you can now temporarily boost your weapons and shields with a substantial amount, instead of having a constant bonus that was almost neglectable.

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift ALPHA 0.1.16b
notes.content:
[h1]FUNCTIONALITY[/h1]

- added message open and delete buttons to message centre

- added hull health and shield health bars to targeted ships

- oxygen flow now equalizes between rooms dependent on room max oxygen level

[h1]BALANCE[/h1]

- shields rebalanced, now recharge faster but use more power, use less power when idle

[list]
[*] small shield generator charge power usage per tick from 30 to 120
[*] large shield generator charge power usage per tick from 250 to 750
[*] decay rate of shield gens reduced by a factor of 20 (decay rate is how much shield power generators lose when idle)
[/list]

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- fixed an issue with message read/unread indicators

- fixed an issue with fleet members not being visible in the invite list 
(when you want to invite someone who has been on the server before the update with fleets, you need to log out and back in to see those people in the list)

[h1]NOTES[/h1]

- servers need to be restarted after update, no rebuilds required

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift ALPHA 0.1.16
notes.content:
[h1]FUNCTIONALITY[/h1]

- added message system, located on the GRIP, can send and receive messages from everyone who has ever been on a server

- added basics of fleet mechanics, you can:
[list]
	[*] create and disband fleets
	[*] invite and remove members
	[*] set basic ranks
	(more features planned)
[/list]

- you can no longer click on the interface when in mouse flight mode

- added target lead indicators

- added slight auto-aim when firing at a selected target and aiming at the lead indicator

- camera in mouse flight mode now auto centers

- added click and drag to room edit mode in the editor
[list]
	[*] click and drag left mouse places a room
	[*] click and drag right mouse deletes part of a room
[/list]

- right clicking outside your ship in the editor now deselects your current selection

- the camera in the editor can now be rotated by holding "left Alt" and moving the mouse

- middle mouse button is now linked to "left Alt"

- the camera in the editor can now be zoomed with - and +

- the editor now supports scrolling in the content browser

- target indicator now loses focus upon target death

- when escape is pressed in main menu you will now quit the game 

- when performing a destructive action (quitting the game/discarding saved changes) you will now get a confirmation check.

- you can now start over with your blueprint with the new blueprint button, this will erase your current unsaved progress.

- added flashlight, default key “F,” can be rebound in the options menu

[h1]BALANCE[/h1]

- rebalanced large hydrogen tank resource costs and weight,
[list] 
[*] resource:
[*] from: 250 iron, 250 copper, 1500 steel
[*] to 200 iron, 150 copper, 750 steel 
[*] weight:
[*] from 4800 
[*] to 1600
[/list]

- added resource costs to juke box: 185 iron, 25 copper

- buffed small shield recharge rate from 1 per tick to 3 per tick

[h1]GRAPHICS[/h1]

- added friendly droids to the stalls (turing tested in five systems)

- added particles to shield generator (work in progress)

- extractors now display the correct asteroid while mining

[h1]SOUNDS[/h1]

- added new charge sound to small teleporter

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- target indicator is now always visible even when points of interest are turned off

- turret now turns at render fps, instead of server tick rate (no longer locked to 20 fps)

- fixed a bug where impact sounds were not audible.

- fixed a bug that caused severe performance issues when a lot of data cores were placed

- Fixed a bug where the server would crash when a player was shooting while being destroyed at the same time.

- fixed bug where game would try to output debug values in player names causing game to crash when teleporting to a ship with a player with a  “{}” in his or hers name.

notes.title: Message for you Sire! - Interstellar Rift development Update 049
notes.content:
[b]With this update we are introducing the first parts of our fleet mechanics. For now this only means that you can set up your own fleet and invite people to join your fleet through the new message system.[/b]

As we expand on the features of the fleet mechanics we will allow you to set a capital ship, have shared vaults for fleet members, set automatic permissions for ranks in your fleet, and more. 

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/02/_d_improd_/IR-2016-02-09-20-55-38-95_f_improf_640x360.png[/img]

We changed the GRIP around to incorporate these new features, the new message system allows you to send messages to other players in an email like fashion, and will tie into a lot of the fleet managing systems we are implementing. 

The engineers at Sentinel Security Systems have been improving their targeting software since the weapon systems were released some time ago, This past week they finally found the time to fix some of the issues which were plaguing the manned turret and their forward mounted counterparts.The weapon systems now converge towards the ship's centre crosshair. Also thanks to a breakthrough in momentum prediction technology the helm’s now displays a lead indicator on all targeted ships to better assist you in your combat activities.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/02/_d_improd_/IR-2016-02-09-21-18-54-05_f_improf_640x360.png[/img]

Additional new advances in smart weapons have progressed to the point where weapons can now automatically aim for targets if the crosshair is close enough. This new “auto aim” feature is still being tested and would greatly benefit from your feedback.

The ship editor has also received some improvements, One of the most requested features since the start of Interstellar Rift’s development has been implemented. Click & drag to build rooms is now available in the editor. Simply hold left mouse button while in room mode and drag across the screen to create a new room. The maximum room size which you can make in a single drag is 10x10 tiles.  

There are some other small improvements to the ship editor:
When the right mouse button is pressed outside of your ship you will deselect the currently selected prop/system and allow you to create new rooms.
The camera can now be rotated by holding the left alt and moving the mouse.
You can now use the + and - buttons to zoom in or out while in the editor.
You can now scroll in the editor content browser.

We have rebalanced the large hydrogen tank to make it cheaper in resource cost and weight, this means that the large hydrogen tank will be more efficient in weight and resource cost than the small hydrogen tanks. Additionally the jukebox now costs resources.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/02/IR-2016-02-09-20-53-31-84.png[/img]

The trade stands in the game will now have a friendly robot to serve you, he is the vendor at the stand, and one of the things we’re doing to make the universe feel more alive. 

We hope you enjoy this new patch and as always, if you would like to know more or would like sneak previews of upcoming features and patches please follow us on Twitter, Facebook and our own and Steam forums.

When the right mouse button is pressed outside of your ship you will deselect the currently selected prop/system and allow you to create new rooms.
The camera can now be rotated by holding the left alt and moving the mouse.
You can now use the + and - buttons to zoom in or out while in the editor.
You can now scroll in the editor content browser.

We have rebalanced the large hydrogen tank to make it cheaper in resource cost and weight, this means that the large hydrogen tank will be more efficient in weight and resource cost than the small hydrogen tanks. Additionally the jukebox now costs resources.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/02/IR-2016-02-09-20-53-31-84.png[/img]

The trade stands in the game will now have a friendly robot to serve you, he is the vendor at the stand, and one of the things we’re doing to make the universe feel more alive. 

We hope you enjoy this new patch and as always, if you would like to know more or would like sneak previews of upcoming features and patches please follow us on Twitter, Facebook and our own and Steam forums.

tags.feature: With this update we are introducing the first parts of our fleet mechanics. For now this only means that you can set up your own fleet and invite people to join your fleet through the new message system.

The engineers at Sentinel Security Systems have been improving their targeting software since the weapon systems were released some time ago, This past week they finally found the time to fix some of the issues which were plaguing the manned turret and their forward mounted counterparts.The weapon systems now converge towards the ship's centre crosshair. Also thanks to a breakthrough in momentum prediction technology the helm’s now displays a lead indicator on all targeted ships to better assist you in your combat activities.

Additional new advances in smart weapons have progressed to the point where weapons can now automatically aim for targets if the crosshair is close enough. This new “auto aim” feature is still being tested and would greatly benefit your feedback.

Click & drag to build rooms is now available in the editor. Simply hold left mouse button while in room mode and drag across the screen to create a new room. The maximum room size which you can make in a single drag is 10x10 tiles.

notes.title: There be gold in dem roids! – Interstellar Rift development Update 048
notes.content:
[b]LogiCorp has once again developed a new piece of hardware, this new device is a 3D printer that will let you create your own cartridges, these are the cartridges that will go into the data cores that were introduced with the last update. [/b]

The 3d printer will use newly introduced rare resources such as gold, silver and more. The crack team of LogiCorp engineers have also made modifications to your ship’s sensors as well as the extractor, to allow you to find and mine these new minerals.
Different resources create different cartridges, you will have to find out what resource is needed for which Upgrade and how to make the best cartridge you need! Gold and silicon are needed to make a default cartridge.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/01/_d_improd_/IR-2016-01-26-21-26-01-47-1024x576_f_improf_640x360.png[/img]
[i]the new 3D printer[/i]

The 3D printer will come into play a lot more in upcoming updates. Right now it is only able to make ship upgrade cartridges but this machine will be used for more players items such as weapons and tools in the future.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/01/_d_improd_/IR-2016-01-26-21-36-30-06-1024x576_f_improf_640x360.png[/img]
[i]Gold and Platinum on a cargo pad[/i]


Additionally, we have also added some brand new effects to the main menu and loading screens.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/01/_d_improd_/IR-2016-01-26-21-27-53-28-1024x576_f_improf_640x360.png[/img]
[i]The new main menu[/i]

This update we have also been hard at work on improving performance and fixing bugs. Players might have noticed that we were extensively testing on the Split Polygon server and we are sorry for any inconvenience this might have caused over the past week. However, it did help us improve the game’s quality. The game should now run smoother in general and we have removed some of the lag spikes and memory leaks that were present. However like any game in alpha stage this is an ongoing process. Therefore we would like to ask the players to keep posting about any issues and they encounter on the forum. We run into quite a few ourselves but it’s impossible to account for every hardware combination and settings so any feedback in this regard that you are willing to provide will help us make a much more stable and enjoyable game.

We hope you enjoy this new patch and as always, if you would like to know more or would like sneak previews of upcoming features and patches please follow us on Twitter, Facebook and our own and Steam forums.

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift ALPHA 0.1.14
notes.content:
[h1]FUNCTIONALITY[/h1]

- player items inventory added (switch inventories with "Q" (default key))

- upgrade data cartridges added, can randomly be found in lockers on stations

- reworked lockers to allow player item storage

- old data core replaced with data core terminal and data core expansion bay
	place cartridges in the data core terminal to receive upgrades for systems aboard your ship

- crash course alert (sounds an alarm when your ship is heading for an obstacle)

- power-cell, power-battery and generators can now be turned off and on (with your GRIP)

- you can now scroll through some lists in the game (more coming soon)

- you can no longer move the camera if your game is not active

- moving/scrolling the camera in the ship editor has been improved, and doing so with keyboard or mouse gives the same results

- when in ship editor and esc is pressed you will no longer move the camera when moving your mouse to the edge of the screen

- whenever you mouse-over most gui elements your mouse will now be disabled in the ship editor

- you can now search in salvage mode

- buffed shields
[list]   
	[*][b]small shield now:  [/b]   
[list]
		[*]power consumption per tick 30
		[*]shield strength regeneration per tick 1
		[*]max shield strength 600
		[*]max down time 10 sec
[/list]
	[*][b]large shield now: [/b]  
[list]  
		[*]power consumption per tick 250
		[*]shield strength regeneration per tick 25
		[*]max shield strength 5000
		[*]max down time 10 sec
[/list]
[/list]
- reduced weight of tech 2 ion engine, from 3800 to 1600

- added new ceiling air vent, ceiling light, ceiling, wall and floor for server rooms

- ships now take cargo weight into account

- added lockers to refinery station

- added lockers to assembly station

- added lockers to vaultron station

- added datacore terminal to refinery station

- added datacore terminal to assembly station

- lockers now stay open when players are near 

- server list now shows number of players in a server

- editor now shows tooltips for most devices plus resource costs for everything. 

[h1]GRAPHICS[/h1]

- item locker update

- new bookcase shader

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- game will no longer crash when you have deleted your workshop ship and are trying to re-upload a newer version of the same ship

- when searching for a ship to build in the ship editor terminal you can now use capitals

- resource display in salvage mode has been fixed, will now return all resources except for those in your tank(also those on cargo pads)

- tier 2 hydrogen generator now only plays one sounds instead of two at the same time

- the supply depot now spawns again

- fixed duping bug with crates

- egine sound now stops when exiting to menu

[h1]NOTES[/h1]

- servers need to be rebuilt, this will update all randomly spawning stations with the new additions of this update.

notes.title: Getting an upgrade! – Interstellar Rift development Update 047
notes.content:
[b]A happy new year to all of the longtime players and the new players that have come in during the holiday sale![/b]

During the Christmas and new year holidays the employees of Logicorp have been working hard on some new hardware that will improve your ship’s performance in many different ways. These new systems are the data core terminals and data core expansion bays. These systems will need data cartridges to work, which you can find randomly on stations, these cartridges hold the upgrades to your ship, you can add a cartridge to your data core terminal to make them active. Each data core terminal starts with 2 open slots, you can increase this to a maximum of 8 by building data core expansion bays, each bay will allow for 1 more cartridge in the data core terminal when assigned to a data core terminal.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/01/serverroom.png[/img]
[i]The new datacore terminal + datacore expansion bays[/i]

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/01/lockerwithcartridges.png[/img]
[i]Cartridges inside a locker[/i]

Upgrades can vary from faster refine speeds, to engine upgrades or faster shield regeneration. Upgrades stack with each other and can completely turn the performance of your ship around.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/01/upgrades-closeup1.png[/img]
[i]Some of the upgrades that can be installed[/i]

The cockpit software has also received another update, the cockpit will now alert you when you are on a crash course. When you are sitting in the cockpit the crash course alert will occur 5 seconds before impact, when you are not sitting in the cockpit the crash course alert will occur 30 seconds before impact. We have also greatly improved the shields, as we found with the addition of point defense drones, shields did far too little to stop the incoming projectiles. Both shields have received a very substantial buff. See the patch notes for more details.

We have added a new feature where cargo will now add mass to your ship, this means that when you are hauling a lot of cargo your speed calculation will be different and make your ship slower and harder to turn around.

Lastly, You can now turn more systems on or off using your GRIP tool, such as power batteries and power cells. This gives players more control over the in and out-flow of electricity between systems.

We hope you enjoy this new patch and as always, if you would like to know more or would like sneak previews of upcoming features and patches please follow us on twitter, facebook and our own and steam forums.

- fixed bug where game would desync when point defense drone started to fire

notes.title: Santa’s Workshop – Interstellar Rift development Update 046
notes.content:
[b]Workshop support was on a lot of wish lists as a requested feature for Interstellar Rift, and today the shipyard will open to allow ship and station sharing![/b]

You can access the Steam Workshop from the store page, ships that you subscribe to are downloaded right away and available ingame in seconds! Ships will automatically show up in the load menu of the ship editor and in your available ships in the ship editor terminal. To delete ships simply unsubscribe from them on the workshop page.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/Workshop.png[/img]
[i]Share your ships and stations via the workshop.[/i]

In the options menu of the ship editor you can now find a new menu that will open up the Steam Workshop exporter. Here you are able to set several options for your files and add tags, descriptions and a default screenshot.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/IR-2015-12-23-17-44-08-20.png[/img]
[i]The game will generate some basic information about your ship automatically![/i]

Also in this patch, the software engineers at SenCorp have upgraded your cockpit software. In this new update you can target your enemies or any point of interest. You can do this by pressing “T” (default key), doing this will select the closest point of interest it can find, when the targeting button is pressed again the targeting system will continue on to the point of interest that is closest after the first one. The maximum range of targeting any point or object of interest is 4 kilometres.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/IR-2015-12-23-17-43-56-95.png[/img]
[i]New service depots can be found in space.[/i]

When you’ve found the right enemy to target and are done annihilating the enemy ship, the wreckage will now leave scrap behind to salvage, that is if you have a salvager!

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/IR-2015-12-23-17-47-55-28.png[/img]
[i]The salvager can retrieve cargo and wreckage from space.[/i]

However, not all ships will give the same resources, for example, a ship that was created without silicon and does not have silicon on board will not give any scrap that can be salvaged into silicon. With your salvaging system you will receive scrap from a certain resource, this scrap can be refined into the resource in the refinery. using the salvager you will also be able to reclaim crates that have been ejected from other ships as well as beacons.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/IR-2015-12-23-17-47-08-01.png[/img]
[i]Salvaged metal scraps can be refined into processed materials.[/i]

Our friends at HydroPEX have designed a new type of station. The refueling station, this is a station that you can randomly encounter in space and will allow you to buy vast amounts of hydrogen, these stations will also allow you to repair your ship while on your travels!

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/IR-2015-12-23-17-44-58-24.png[/img]
[i]You can repair and refuel your ship at the new HydroPEX service depots.[/i]

We hope you enjoy this new patch and as always, if you would like to know more or would like sneak previews of upcoming features and patches please follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/SplitPolygon]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/SplitPolygon/]Facebook[/url] and our [url=http://www.interstellarrift.com/phpBB3/index.php]own[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/]Steam[/url] forums.

 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FHeiOeBqJPY
[b]From all of us at Split Polygon, happy holidays and we look forward to bringing a lot of new content to Interstellar Rift in the new year![/b]

[i]P.S. The next patch will be in three weeks instead of two, due to a holiday break![/i]

- added scanners

[list]
[*] small 10, large 60
[/list]

- Store-o-tron can now repair your ship for a fee.

- added retrieve buttons in refinery.

- message of the day for server admins (use the /motd command).

- reworked the refinery resource input screen.

- reworked refinery model

- unification of the display of resources in all GUIs.

- new mining station 

- updated vault GUI

- resources in screens now also show where the resource is made.

- added tutorial button in the main menu

[h1]SOUNDS[/h1]

- input buffer on refinery now plays a sounds when full and players attempt to add more

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- removed the word credits from the trade terminal.

- fixed a bug with the U-Nit icon spacing.

- fixed crash in the salvage menu, when no salvageable ships were in range.

- refinery hatch now stays closed when refinery input is full.

- fixed crash when no ship selected in SET.

- fixed hand animation when combining resources.

- scrolling through your inventory should now be smoother

- repositioned the pop-up messages on several in-game GUI’s.

- secondary pilot screen does not turn off when leaving the exit game menu

- fixed a bug where the ship editor would throw an error when you only have a quantum oxygen generator on board (admin model).

- player positions on the map now show on the correct level

- molecular assembler now obeys rights

[h1]NOTE FOR SERVER OWNERS[/h1]

- server save will need to be rebuilt to allow for the new world generation (use F8 Menu)

notes.title: Scanning for enemies – Interstellar Rift development Update 045
notes.content:
[i][b]Today, we introduce the basics of PvE in Interstellar Rift. From now on, when you explore the galaxy and stumble upon an asteroid field, you might find that it will be defended by drones. The further one gets from the spawning area, the higher this chance will be. So raise your shields and stock up on ammo, they will be packing a punch.[/b][/i]

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/_d_improd_/IR-2015-12-08-21-13-45-42-1024x576_f_improf_640x360.png[/img]
[i]Defense Drones[/i]

If your ship happens to get damaged, you are now able to repair your ship at your nearest Store-o-Tron terminal for a fee.

Additionally, you will now be able to scan the universe for resources. If your ship is equipped with sensors (these can be built in the exterior part of the ship editor), you can set it to find resources from the main terminal on your cockpit. Each scanner you add to your ship will give your ship more scanning strength. Scanning strength will reduce static on your scanners and let you scan further away from your ship. You can set which resources you want to scan for, or just look for all of them at the same time!

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/_d_improd_/IR-2015-12-08-21-09-23-45-1024x576_f_improf_640x360.png[/img]
[i]New scanner gui[/i]

To make your travels easier, the company supplying the ship construction terminal and the refinery has improved their design and reworked their looks. There's no need to worry you don't need to do a thing, as soon as you log on again they have already been replaced by the Hurles co. engineers, yes they even went into your own ships and replaced them there, creepy! These engineers have also installed new software on all systems that show resources, with resource icons to create more symmetry across all GUI’s.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/_d_improd_/IR-2015-12-08-21-04-58-28-1024x576_f_improf_640x360.png[/img]
[i]Ship construction terminal[/i]

We have also added a new tutorial button to the main menu. When clicked, you will enter a preliminary version of the tutorial. We are listening to player feedback for this tutorial to find out how to make the game easier to understand for new players.

Finally, we’ve added a couple of little things. For instance, server owners can now set a welcome message on their servers, scrolling through your inventory should no longer skip items, and brand new mining station.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/_d_improd_/IR-2015-12-08-21-05-44-61-1024x576_f_improf_640x360.png[/img]
[i]The new mining station[/i]

We hope you enjoy this new patch and as always, if you would like to know more or would like sneak previews of upcoming features and patches please follow us on twitter, facebook and our own and steam forums.

notes.title: Colourful profits! - Interstellar Rift development Update 044
notes.content:
Colourful profits! – Interstellar Rift development Update 044

[b][i]This week’s update will introduce the basis of trading and an ingame economy. The first part of this, which is introduced in this patch, is PVE trading. [/i][/b] 

You will now be able to trade resources for U-nits with trade stands. These trade stands can be found on randomly spawned stations around the galaxy, and you can buy and sell a variety of resources at these stands. Resources will be taken from either your inventory or one of your ships, and the trade stand also teleports your purchases aboard a selected ship as part of the deal. Just walk up to any trade stand on a trade station and start selling.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/11/_d_improd_/IR-2015-11-24-17-39-02-09-1024x576_f_improf_640x360.png[/img]
[i]The new Trade Station[/i]

We are going to add extra features to this system in upcoming updates, such as player vs player trading and selling ships to other players.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/11/_d_improd_/IR-2015-11-24-17-45-56-85-1024x576_f_improf_640x360.png[/img]
[i]The new trade station GUI[/i]

As part of the introduction of a currency we have rebalanced some resources to get a more normalized view on the trade stands. This means that water, oxygen and hydrogen crates now have 10 times less capacity. To account for this we rebalanced every device in the game that used these resources, to effectively balance it out to the same ratios as before.

The second major mechanic we have added is exterior painting, you can now personalize your ship even more by adding colour to the exterior. There are 32 colours to choose from and every individual piece can be painted separately. So start colouring and don’t hesitate to show us your new designs!

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/11/_d_improd_/IR-2015-11-24-17-42-06-36-1024x576_f_improf_640x360.png[/img]
A newly coloured ship

We hope you enjoy this new patch and as always, if you would like to know more or would like sneak previews of upcoming features and patches please follow us on Twitter, Facebook and our own and Steam forums.

notes.title: Don’t get cocky kid! – Interstellar Rift development Update 043
notes.content:
Multiple people manning a single ship is one the main features of Interstellar Rift, and this week we are adding turrets that you can place on your ship that can be manned by your crew.

These turrets have been in the works for a while, and some of you might have caught a glimpse of them as we released an early version of them by accident last week.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/11/_d_improd_/IR-2015-11-10-19-07-45-04-1024x576_f_improf_640x360.png[/img]

[b][i]The new turret[/i][/b]

Manned turrets can be added to the sides of your vessel and can used by everyone on your ship. Turrets work mostly the same as mounted weapons but have no weapon group. You have to connect them to an ammo loader aboard the ship, and it will fire ammo from this chamber. Multiple ammo loaders will increase the amount of bullets you can fire before reloading the turret.

In feature updates we will allow you to create different weapon types that can be fitted to these turrets.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/11/_d_improd_/IR-2015-11-10-19-24-05-88-1024x576_f_improf_640x360.png[/img]

[b][i]New Signs[/i][/b]

We also added a whole bunch of new signs to the editor to choose from. Multiline wall and prop signs that can display up to four lines of text. And direction signs that can be placed in the middle of rooms instead of on walls.

We also have a list of other small features that we brought to the game, such as; new shield impact effects, new sound effects for weapons, showing exterior parts of devices in the editor and signs on cargo pads. These signs will list what is on your cargo pads on displays at the front and back of the pads.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/11/_d_improd_/IR-2015-11-10-19-33-30-88-1024x576_f_improf_640x360.png[/img]

[b][i]New cargo pad screens[/i][/b]

We have also been working on improving game stability a lot over the last couple weeks. Teleporting from ship to ship should be way less if not completely free of crashes, and we have done a lot to make better use of our memory. This means you can build bigger ships in the editor. We are working on a 64bit version of the game to allow you guys to build even bigger, but this will take a couple more months.

We hope you enjoy this new patch and as always, if you would like to know more or would like sneak previews of upcoming features and patches please follow us on Twitter, Facebook and Steam forums.

notes.title: Creepy Features and Spooky Ads - Interstellar Rift Development Update 042
notes.content:
[i]This week’s update contains a number of quality of life improvements while we work on some bigger features, but that doesn’t mean we don’t have a bunch of new stuff to share.[/i]

We have updated the ship editor to have an extra mode called “device edit mode.” This mode will allow you to set up your devices before you construct a ship in the game world. What this means, is that you can click on devices and set stuff like permissions, shield levels and more, and the game will transfer these settings to your ship when you actually built it. This will also allow you to set up your signage around the ship once, instead of having to do this again every time you construct your ship.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/10/_d_improd_/IR-2015-10-28-00-29-57-07-1024x576_f_improf_640x360.png[/img]
[i]Editing a sign's properties[/i]

We have also added strobe lights that you can place on the outside of your ship, these blinky lights will make you more visible against the dark backdrop of space!

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/10/_d_improd_/IR-2015-10-28-00-52-49-49-1024x576_f_improf_640x360.png[/img]
[i]Blinking strobe lights on a station[/i]

There are currently six different colours to choose from, just note that they don’t show up in the editor yet, only in the game world. There are more lights though, the ammo loader that got introduced last update will now have working sound and indicator lights. These lights will indicate the status of your ammo storage, and alert you if you’re running low. You might also find some new stations in space, as we have added a couple extra which have functionalities that were lacking in the stations already available. A new apparition next to the starting station is something you will see more of as we fill space, ads. No real ads, but ads for ingame companies. These will update with coming updates to show you, for example, new devices added to the game, or special features that might be introduced.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/10/_d_improd_/IR-2015-10-28-00-34-56-46-1024x576_f_improf_640x360.png[/img]
[i]Billboard in space[/i]

We also got multiple requests to add in more admin options, and although they are far from finished, we have added a couple more. Admins now have the option to teleport to any ship, any player, and teleport any player to them. They can also toggle ships to be invulnerable to damage.

It will be Halloween soon and even space becomes extra scary around this time of the earthly year. Watch out for some spooky pumpkins that you can find in the universe, maybe you’ll find some on the various stations, or is there a pumpkin stuck in your extractor? No one knows for sure! These pumpkins will be in the game for a short time only, but hold on to them if you come across some.

Like always thank you for playing Interstellar Rift, and we hope you enjoy these new features. As always if you’d like to keep up to date with the latest Interstellar Rift news and previews of upcoming updates please follow us on Twitter, Facebook or drop by our Steam forums.

and happy halloween!

notes.title: Blow em up! - Interstellar rift development update 041
notes.content:
[i]Welcome to patch 0.1.8, The first incarnation of combat is introduced today!

In the editor you will find a new category in exterior mode called Weapons. Here you will find the first projectile based weapon in Interstellar Rift.[/i] 

In order to fire it, you will require an ammo loader onboard as well as ammo crates.
With the Introduction of combat we are also adding the ability to build ammo, and it marks the first multi-stage tech tree in Interstellar Rift. In order to create ammunition you will need to go out into the universe and explore to find new raw materials like zinc and nitrogen. 

These new resources together with some of the ones already found in the game will allow you to create ammo.  You will need to combine oxygen and nitrogen to create nitrous oxide. Combine zinc and copper to create brass, combine brass and Iron to create shells in the assembler and then combine nitrous oxide and shells to create ammunition. In the future we will be adding different kinds of ammo which behave differently from these standard rounds.

[url=http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/10/IR-2015-10-14-00-28-05-60.png][img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/10/IR-2015-10-14-00-28-05-60-1024x576.png[/img][/url] New Ammo crates with Shells and Nitrous Oxide.

When in the editor, you also have the option to create weapon groups. These groups can contain multiple weapons and ammo loaders. You can switch between the first 10 weapon groups by pressing the number keys whilst sitting in a cockpit. In this update we can only allow you to make changes to these groups in the ship editor. But in the near future you will be able to do this on the fly when piloting a ship.

Now that you’ve built ammo, there is one more step which is needed for your ship to be combat ready. In order to use your ammo you will need to put it in the new ammo loader which you can find in the editor under prop edit mode. When you’ve added your ammo loader to your ship you can continue to the exterior editor and put the mounted turret on your ship. 

This is the first weapon available and it only fires in the direction it was placed in. Gimbaled and manned turrets are coming in future updates, together with missiles and energy weapons.

[url=http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/10/IR-2015-10-14-00-37-49-13.png][img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/10/IR-2015-10-14-00-37-49-13-1024x576.png[/img][/url] A close-up of the new Ammunition Loader.

We have also made several new additions to the cockpits to allow for a more expanded combat UI. As with combat itself expect to see many more additions to these GUI’s in the coming weeks and months.This is the first iteration of combat that we are ready to show to you guys but this is by no means finished. We need your feedback and suggestions as we attempt to balance weapons while maintaining your creative freedom in the construction of your ships.

[url=http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/10/IR-2015-10-14-00-21-24-11.png][img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/10/IR-2015-10-14-00-21-24-11-1024x576.png[/img][/url] A ship, firing it's weapons.
 
We are already looking at new weapons and weapon convergence as well as turrets. But every bit of feedback is welcome. We have our own ideas on how to improve, but ultimately we answer to you guys. So please don’t hesitate to let us know what you think of the new changes.

notes.title: It’s a Sign! – Interstellar Rift Development Update 040
notes.content:
[i]Today Interstellar Rift will allow you, the players, to communicate better in game through the ancient but highly efficient use of signs.[/i]

Above every door you will now find a sign stating what room lies beyond that door. Each door will do this automatically based on the name that you assign to the room inside the ship editor. This also means that for the time being these signs cannot be changed unless you rename the room inside of the editor and salvage and rebuild your ship ingame.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/_d_improd_/IR-2015-09-29-19-41-41-84-1024x576_f_improf_640x360.png[/img]
[i]New door signs[/i]

But that’s not all. We’re also adding several new wall building blocks to the interior editor. Including a new wall section with a screen embedded in it. This screen will allow you to write a small piece of text and add arrows to either side. You can also customise the text color to one of 8 different colors. This sign is primarily added as a way to give directions aboard ships. More signs will be added in upcoming updates which will allow more text.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/_d_improd_/IR-2015-09-29-19-27-36-04-1024x576_f_improf_640x360.png[/img]
[i]Directional Sign[/i]

In addition to the new sign system, we have also been working on adding more effects to the game. Every engine now has a visible beam of particles coming out of it, and thrusters will emit little jets every time you turn your ship.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/_d_improd_/IR-2015-09-29-19-29-48-24-1024x576_f_improf_640x360.png[/img]
[i]New engine effects[/i]

Most of our efforts have been concentrated on getting the multiplayer into a much more stable state than it has been over the last month. Last patch you might have noticed a significant improvement to the overall stability of servers and much fewer desynchronization events such as bumping into invisible asteroids and the like. With this patch most of these issues have been resolved. This allows us to proceed with some major features again such as combat.

We sincerely thank you, our fans, for your patience over the past month while we worked on fixing these issues. We now have the proper tools that will allow us to quickly identify and squash these bugs as soon as they show their ugly faces.

On another note we would like to make everyone aware that Split Polygon is offering internships for tools, gameplay and engine programmers, if you’re interested please visit: http://www.interstellarrift.com/jobs/ for more Information.

We hope you enjoy this new patch and as always, if you would like to know more or would like sneak previews of upcoming features and patches please follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/SplitPolygon]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/SplitPolygon]Facebook[/url] and  [url=http://interstellarrift.com/phpBB3/index.php]our own[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/]Steam[/url] forums.

We sincerely thank you, our fans, for your patience over the past month while we worked on fixing these issues. We now have the proper tools that will allow us to quickly identify and squash these bugs as soon as they show their ugly faces.

tags.feature: Above every door you will now find a sign stating what room lies beyond that door. Each door will do this automatically based on the name that you assign to the room inside the ship editor. This also means that for the time being these signs cannot be changed unless you rename the room inside of the editor and salvage and rebuild your ship ingame.

We’re also adding several new wall building blocks to the interior editor. Including a new wall section with a screen embedded in it. This screen will allow you to write a small piece of text and add arrows to either side. You can also customise the text color to one of 8 different colors. This sign is primarily added as a way to give directions aboard ships. More signs will be added in upcoming updates which will allow more text.

In addition to the new sign system, we have also been working on adding more effects to the game. Every engine now has a visible beam of particles coming out of it, and thrusters will emit little jets every time you turn your ship.

notes.title: Information warfare – Interstellar Rift Development Update 039
notes.content:
[i][b]We’ve spent the last few weeks mostly working on fixing bugs with the multi-player. This time we feel that we’ve made a lot of progress in getting multi-player back on track.[/b][/i]

However, the work on fixing bugs is not done yet, and we will continue getting to the bottom of any issue that may present itself. We believe that this patch will significantly improve the the viability of the multiplayer, and we sincerely apologize for the major issues we’ve had these past few weeks. In addition to fixing a lot of problems we have also improved performance across the board.

Besides fixing bugs and improving performance we have also spent the past two weeks working on a new Information Kiosk (among other stuff for upcoming updates). Which will display information about devices and resources, and will also allow you to access some tutorials. Many of you have been inquiring about tutorials, and this kiosk is a first step to make the game easier for new players.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/_d_improd_/IR-2015-09-15-18-43-41-52-1024x576_f_improf_640x360.png[/img]
[i]The new Information Kiosk[/i]

This new kiosk can be found on the starter stations and will be updated in the coming months as new features are added. The kiosk can be found under admin models in the editor. It does not require unobtainium, allowing players to place it on their own ships and station. To see admin models in the editor, you will have to enable them in the options menu under editor settings.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/_d_improd_/IR-2015-09-15-18-44-56-10-1024x576_f_improf_640x360.png[/img]
[i]Information Kiosk Interface[/i]

We’ve also added new admin commands for server owners. You will be able to assign administrator rights to other players, in addition to the ability to kick and ban players from the server. These new functionalities are located in the admin menu which you can access by pressing F8 while in game.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/_d_improd_/IR-2015-09-15-18-51-45-97-1024x576_f_improf_640x360.png[/img]
[i]Admin Menu[/i]

As always we hope you enjoy this update. And we’d like to ask that if you find any more bugs or if you’d simply like to follow us for more info and previews of upcoming updates please visit our Steam forums or follow us on Twitter and Facebook.

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift ALPHA 0.1.5
notes.content:
[h1]FUNCTIONALITIES[/h1]

[b]- added new device, assembling machine[/b]
[i][list]
 [*]works in the same way as a refinery, resources go in the left slot and via the terminal you can select what to craft
 [*]can be found in the editor under prop edit mode > systems
 [*]will be used in the future for drones and other devices that can be placed in the world
[/list][/i]
[b]- added new item to craft with the assembling machine, beacon[/b]
[i][list]
 [*]beacons can be ejected through a disposer into space and are visible for 150km
 [*]beacons can be altered through the sensors on any AGOS terminal
 [*]beacons will return to their original spawn position when bumped
 [*]beacons take 2 minutes to craft, provided the assembling machine receives enough power
 [*]as of 0.1.5 beacons cannot be destroyed (this will change in a future update)
 [*]beacons require 75 refined iron, 50 refined silicon and 100 refined copper to craft
 [/list][/i]
[b]- reworked cargo screen on AGOS terminals and the GRIP[/b]
[i][list]
 [*]now shows available cargo space and what is stored on the ship
[/list][/i]
[b]- reworked sensor screen on AGOS terminals and the GRIP[/b]
[i][list]
 [*]now shows categories instead of one long list
[/list][/i] 
[b]- crates ejected from the disposer now float around in space for a while[/b]

[b]- added button to the f8 administrator menu to give more detailed information in the console about issues[/b]

[b]- server browser now only lists servers that are running on the same version as the client[/b]

[h1]GRAPHICS[/h1]

[b]- reworked icons in space[/b]
[i][list]
 [*]now scale differently on distance and display more information the closer you get to them
[/list][/i]
[b]- coloured owned ships in the teleporter list[/b]

[b]- coloured sever spawned ships in the teleporter list[/b]

[h1]BUGFIXES[/h1]

[b]- fixed bug where molecular assemblers could no longer be selected[/b]

[b]- fixed several bugs with network de-synchronizations[/b]

[b]- fixed bug with sitting in the helm while disconnecting[/b]

[b]- small rotating meshes are no longer visible when more than one cell away[/b]

[h1]KNOWN ISSUES[/h1]

[b]- refineries may leave crates floating in mid-air [/b]

[b]- exterior editor might freeze on extreme amounts of exterior tiles[/b]

[b]- joining your own server no longer works by clicking the local server (127.0.0.1)[/b]
[i][list]
 [*]you should still be able to join over internal or external IP
[/list][/i]

notes.title: Push button receive beacon – Interstellar Rift Development Update 038
notes.content:
[i][b]It has been an interesting two weeks, our addition of the infinite galaxy caused a few problems in multi-player. For this patch we have been hard at work resolving the major visual desync issues which were caused by the last patch, AKA the invisible asteroids that were destroying your ships.[/b][/i]

As for new features, we are adding a new Assembling Machine. This device will be used to make smaller devices. Devices such as the new signal beacon.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/_d_improd_/scrNewMachine-1024x576_f_improf_640x360.jpg[/img]
Assembling Machine

Similar to the refinery, in order to use the Assembling Machine you will have to put refined resources into the hopper and select which device you wish to have it construct. In the future this machine will be used for similar devices such as repair drones, combat drones and more.

The new signal beacon allows you to mark locations in the galaxy. It can be detected from 150 kilometers away. Using the sensor menu on terminals, you will be able to change the transponder message of the beacon.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/_d_improd_/IR-2015-09-02-20-15-38-89-1024x576_f_improf_640x360.png[/img]
Multiple beacons in Space

To deploy a beacon, simply put it into the disposer and eject it from your ship. It will then unfold into its beacon form and begin transmitting. Using the sensors you can find your beacon and change it’s transponder message. Using the same menu you will also be able to deactivate it. Similar to NPC stations beacons will drift back to their original position.

We’ve also updated the way the cargo manifest works. You can now see what cargo is currently on board your ship, how many cargo spaces you have in total and, how many are occupied.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/_d_improd_/IR-2015-09-02-19-56-27-34-1024x576_f_improf_640x360.png[/img]
The new Cargo Manager

you can access this screen from the GRIP and the wall terminals. With the sensor list you can also check the cargo holds of other ships.

We hope you enjoy this new patch and as always, if you would like to know more or would like sneak previews of upcoming features and patches please follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/SplitPolygon]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/SplitPolygon]Facebook[/url] and our [url=http://interstellarrift.com/phpBB3/index.php]own[/url] or [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/]Steam[/url] forums.

notes.title: Distress signal detected! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 037
notes.content:
[b]Exploration has been one of our biggest objectives when we started Interstellar Rift. Today we take the first step to realising that goal. Today we implement the first version of infinite universe generation. Up to this patch there were no asteroid fields beyond 100 kilometers from the starting station. Now the game will start to continuously generate new asteroid fields and stations the further you fly out.[/b]

This first iteration will have several space stations, mineable asteroid fields and large asteroids. But now that the system is online we can gradually start to add new things to the universe generator to fill your universes with cool new stuff.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/08/IR-2015-08-18-21-00-00-41.png[/img]

In addition to the universe generator we are also adding a new resource recipe. You will now be able to create steel by combining 2 units of iron and 1 unit of carbon. Steel has been added to the required resources of all tech 2 devices and some of the smaller devices. But don’t worry you wont need stand next to your life support huffing as much oxygen as possible in order to acquire carbon. Since carbon is now abundant in all asteroid fields as it can be found as an additional resource found in most asteroid types.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/08/IR-2015-08-18-20-57-36-90.png[/img]

But wait there’s more. Because you can now spend much more time and fly much further trying to find new stations and resources it may be hard for your friends to find you, therefore we are adding a new ship device, the transponder. The transponder allows you to send out a signal which can be picked up from 150 kilometers away when activated. You can set the transponder to transmit any message you want.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/08/IR-2015-08-18-21-07-33-54.png[/img]

There has also been a revamp to the engine display in the cockpit to make it a little clearer which engines are online, or are functioning at a lower capacity.

Please note that you will have to rebuild your server from the admin menu so that the universe generator will engage. however this means that all of the ships that are stored in the Store-o-Tron will be removed and the resources will be refunded to the individual players

NOTE: to continue with an old galaxy the world has to be rebuild, to do this the Admin can press F8 and hit rebuild world. This might take a couple of minutes. 

As always we hope that you enjoy this weeks update and if you would like to know more and  see sneak peeks at upcoming patches please follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/SplitPolygon]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/SplitPolygon]Twitter[/url], our own [url=http://interstellarrift.com/phpBB3/index.php]forums[/url] or right here, on our Steam forums.

notes.title: Storage wars! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 036
notes.content:
[i]Are you sick and tired of finding your ship all banged up after a good night's sleep. or waking up to an empty cargo hold? Well fear no longer! Introducing the Vaultron Store-o-Tron Ship storage kiosk![/i] 

[img=http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/08/IR-2015-08-03-18-24-37-52-1024x576.png][/img]

This week we are introducing a somewhat smaller update than usual because this patch has to go out a little early. On the starter station you will find a new Kiosk brightly labeled as the Store-o-Tron. This new kiosk will enable you to put your ship into safe storage, so when you are logged out you can rest assured that your ship will not be damaged or destroyed. 
In order to store a ship it will have to be within 500 meters of the starter station.

Like the vault the ship storage kiosk is only available under dev models and requires unobtanium.
it is not intended for player construction use.

[img=http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/08/IR-2015-08-03-20-18-33-95-1024x576.png][/img]

Upcoming week we will also be at Gamescom in Cologne Germany, showcasing Interstellar Rift at the holland pavilion in the business area. So for all of you attending gamescom, if you see us walking the floor feel free to say hi. You’ll recognize us by the Interstellar Rift t-shirts. This also means that in the coming week we’ll be a little less active on the forums.

[img=http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/08/gamescom-logo-1024x576.png][/img]

Note: As an admin, if there are stored ships in the Store-o-Tron on your server please note that if you rebuild your server via the admin menu all stored ships will be deleted. We will update the kiosk so it survives server resets in the near future. 

We hope you’ll enjoy this patch and if you want to see previews of things to come, follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/SplitPolygon]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/SplitPolygon']Facebook[/url] or drop by our [url=http://interstellarrift.com/phpBB3/index.php]own[/url] or our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions]Steam forums[/url].

notes.title: Raise shields! – Interstellar Rift Development Update 035
notes.content:
Death, destruction and all of that good stuff. Ship destruction hits Interstellar Rift in patch 0.1.2!

As of today, asteroid mining has become a whole lot more dangerous. Asteroids impacting your ship will now cause damage and if you’re not careful it will destroy your ship and everything and everyone on it. But don’t worry too much, we do have some new defensive technology ready to help protect you.

[img=http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/07/IR-2015-07-21-23-36-43-07.png][img]

Introducing the Sentinel Security Systems Shield Generators. These new shield generators will allow you to protect your ship from incoming damage. When an object impacts your shield bubble, it will decrease its strength for a moment and deflect whatever object hit you. Then it will quickly regenerate back up to full strength. Shields require a constant power supply in order to remain operational. Therefore we recommend that you do not run your shields at full strength when you are not near an asteroid field or not playing a destruction derby with another ship.

[img=http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/07/IR-2015-07-21-23-52-22-02.png][img]

If the shield strength falls to zero, it will take a while before the shields regenerate enough again to form a bubble. When your shields are down and an object impacts your ship you will start to take hull damage, hull damage does not regenerate. The only way to repair your ship for the time being, will be to salvage it and rebuild it.

With this patch, we will also be introducing particles. The only particle effect we are shipping in this patch will be the explosions when ships receive fatal damage. In the future we will be adding more particle effects in both interior as well as exterior to make the game feel a whole lot more spectacular.

The introduction of the new power system in the previous patch was missing a device, a proper battery. So we are adding these as well. The battery works in such a way that it’s actually a battery and it discharges its power slowly rather than all at once which is what the power cells did before. This means you can leave your ship to charge its power cells for a while and you’ll be able to fly it for a while until the power cells are empty. So in theory solar powered ships should once again be somewhat viable.

[img=http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/07/IR-2015-07-21-23-39-17-13.png][img]

We hope you enjoy this Interstellar Rift patch and if you want to know more feel free to drop by our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions]Steam Forums[/url] our own [url=http://interstellarrift.com/phpBB3/index.php]Forums[/url] or follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/SplitPolygon]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/SplitPolygon]Facebook.[/url]

notes.title: Electrifying – Interstellar Rift Development Update 034
notes.content:
Today we are releasing the much coveted powergrid revamp. This is a major change as to how ships are powered and how devices behave under low power conditions.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/07/IR-2015-07-08-21-28-12-73-1024x576.png[/img]

For example, your ship produces 1500 power but your consumption is at 1700. That means that devices will function at a lower efficiency. Engines will not produce their maximum thrust output unless they are fully powered. The amount of thrust will be relative to the amount of power they receive. In a future patch we will be adding proper power management features such as the ability to divert power from one system to another.

This new power system has many benefits. One of the main advantages is that it is far more efficient, meaning the server should be able to handle far more ships and ships and stations with lots and lots of devices. Players in the past have made gigantic space stations that were almost completely powered by solar panels. When spawned, these stations would lag the entire server. The new power grid should alleviate this problem substantially. Keep in mind though, that solar panels are meant as a supplement to your generators, not a replacement. Be prepared to put a lot of solar panels on your ship or station if you want to go green.

Power cells have also been updated and are now required to help keep your ship at a more stable power level. For example when a teleporter is used, it instantly takes a big bite out of your available power, usually more than generators and solar panels can generate. Charged power cells act as a buffer between the device and your generators which handle large power spikes like this accordingly.

Another very notable effect of the new power system is that devices don’t need to charge anymore. Before today’s update, every device had its own power buffer which needed to be charged before the device would operate. This caused devices to appear underpowered where in fact they were waiting for other devices to be charged. The new power system only powers devices when they are used and divides its power equally over all those devices.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/07/IR-2015-07-08-21-33-39-77-1024x576.png[/img]


The new power system makes it a lot more predictable compared to its predecessor. This allows us to put some information in the ship editor indicating how much power a ship generates, how much it drains and how big your spikes can possibly get. This should give you an idea on how your ship is going to perform. In the G.R.I.P. and on terminals you should now find some graphs which can be used to find out how much power is drained when certain devices are being used.

[img]http://www.interstellarrift.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/07/IR-2015-07-08-19-33-11-88-1024x576.png[/img]

We’ve also done a balance pass on the power consumption of several devices. So dont be surprised to find that your ships go faster or slower than you’re used to. Additionally, we have added some new control functions like mouse sensitivity and mouse Y-axis inversion.

We’ve also fixed most of the performance problems that were plaguing the map. When you activate the regular or cargo teleporter your performance should no longer be affected as much by the loading the map.

We hope you’ll enjoy this update, and as always, if you want to know more feel free to ask us anything on our [url=http://interstellarrift.com/phpBB3/index.php]Forums[/url], the Steam forums or follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/SplitPolygon]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/SplitPolygon]Twitter.[/url]
